<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" class="dark">
<head><script id="offline-storage-fallback">
// Some restrictive local-file viewers block localStorage entirely.
// Keep every mini-game playable in that case using temporary in-memory saves.
try { const k='__arcade_storage_check__';window.localStorage.setItem(k,'1');window.localStorage.removeItem(k); }
catch(e){
  const memory=new Map();
  const shim={getItem(k){return memory.has(String(k))?memory.get(String(k)):null},
    setItem(k,v){memory.set(String(k),String(v))},removeItem(k){memory.delete(String(k))},
    clear(){memory.clear()},key(i){return Array.from(memory.keys())[i]||null},get length(){return memory.size}};
  try {Object.defineProperty(window,'localStorage',{configurable:true,value:shim});}catch(e){}
}
</script>

    <!-- Canvas Confetti Library -->
    <script>
function confetti(opts={}){
  const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
  canvas.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;width:100%;height:100%';
  canvas.width=innerWidth;canvas.height=innerHeight;document.body.appendChild(canvas);
  const c=canvas.getContext('2d');const n=Math.min(160,opts.particleCount||65);
  const x=(opts.origin?.x??.5)*canvas.width,y=(opts.origin?.y??.5)*canvas.height;
  const colors=['#fbbf24','#ec4899','#0ea5e9','#a78bfa','#22c55e','#fff'];
  const parts=Array.from({length:n},()=>({x,y,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*16,vy:-Math.random()*12-2,
      size:Math.random()*5+3,a:Math.random()*6.28,color:colors[Math.floor(Math.random()*colors.length)]}));
  let frame=0;function draw(){c.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
    for(const p of parts){p.vy+=.22;p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;p.a+=.13;
      c.save();c.translate(p.x,p.y);c.rotate(p.a);c.fillStyle=p.color;c.fillRect(-p.size/2,-p.size/2,p.size,p.size*.7);c.restore();}
    if(++frame<110)requestAnimationFrame(draw);else canvas.remove();}
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
</script>

    

    <style>
        body {
            font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
            background-color: #0f172a;
            color: #f8fafc;
            user-select: none;
            touch-action: manipulation;
        }

        .font-fredoka { font-family: "Trebuchet MS", system-ui, sans-serif; }
        .font-outfit { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; }

        .aidan-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff007f, #7928ca, #00dfd8, #f59e0b, #ff007f);
            background-size: 400% 400%;
            animation: aidanGradient 4s ease infinite, aidanGlow 1.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
            border: 3px solid #fbbf24 !important;
            box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.6), inset 0 0 15px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
        }

        @keyframes aidanGradient {
            0% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
            50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
            100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
        }

        @keyframes aidanGlow {
            from { transform: scale(1); filter: brightness(1); }
            to { transform: scale(1.03); filter: brightness(1.25); }
        }

        ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #0f172a; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #334155; border-radius: 4px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #475569; }

        .glow-common { box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.3); }
        .glow-uncommon { box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.4); }
        .glow-rare { box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.5); }
        .glow-epic { box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.6); }
        .glow-legendary { box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.7); }
        .glow-chroma { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(236, 72, 153, 0.8); }
        .glow-mystical { box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.9); }

        #game-container {
            position: relative;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 800px;
            height: 550px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border-radius: 20px;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #0f2027, #203a43, #2c5364);
            margin: 0 auto;
        }

        #gameCanvas { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; }

        .hud {
            position: absolute;
            top: 15px;
            left: 15px;
            right: 15px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 5;
        }

        .hud-card {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
            backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
            padding: 8px 14px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .hud-card span { color: #4ecca3; }

        .energy-bar-container {
            width: 110px;
            height: 10px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 6px;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: 4px;
        }

        .energy-bar {
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff416c, #ff4b2b, #f9d423);
            transition: width 0.1s linear;
        }

        .quiz-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.95);
            backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 20px;
            z-index: 25;
        }

        .quiz-overlay.hidden { display: none !important; }

        .quiz-card {
            background: #1e293b;
            border: 2px solid #3b82f6;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 24px;
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 440px;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
        }

        .options-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 10px;
            margin-top: 16px;
        }

        .btn-opt {
            background: #334155;
            color: white;
            border: 2px solid #475569;
            padding: 12px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }

        .btn-opt:hover {
            background: #2563eb;
            border-color: #60a5fa;
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        #quiz-btn {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 20px;
            right: 20px;
            background: #e94560;
            color: white;
            border: none;
            padding: 12px 22px;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
            border-radius: 30px;
            cursor: pointer;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(233, 69, 96, 0.4);
            transition: all 0.2s;
            z-index: 5;
        }

        #quiz-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.05); background: #ff5277; }

        .controls-tip {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 20px;
            left: 20px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            padding: 8px 14px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #ccc;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .cookie-active { transform: scale(0.93) !important; }
        .buy-card { touch-action: manipulation; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
        .buy-card:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

        /* NATIVE BLOCK BLAST STYLES */
        .bb-cell {
            background-color: #1e293b;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.1s ease, opacity 0.1s ease;
        }

        .bb-cell.filled { box-shadow: inset 0 0 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); }
        .bb-cell.preview {
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
            border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        }

        .bb-draggable-piece {
            display: grid;
            gap: 2px;
            cursor: grab;
            position: absolute;
            transition: transform 0.1s ease;
            z-index: 10;
            touch-action: none;
        }

        .bb-draggable-piece:active { cursor: grabbing; }

        .bb-piece-block {
            width: 20px;
            height: 20px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 5px rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
        }

        .bb-dragging {
            z-index: 1000 !important;
            opacity: 0.9;
            transform: scale(1.1);
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        /* CRYSTAL SPIRE ARCANA STYLES */
        .glass-panel {
            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.8);
            backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }
        
        .floating-damage {
            position: absolute;
            animation: floatUpFade 1.2s forwards ease-out;
            pointer-events: none;
            font-weight: 900;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
        }

        @keyframes floatUpFade {
            0% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(0.8); }
            30% { transform: translateY(-30px) scale(1.3); }
            100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-70px) scale(1); }
        }

        .perspective-1000 { perspective: 1000px; }
        .transform-style-3d { transform-style: preserve-3d; }
        .backface-hidden { backface-visibility: hidden; }
        .rotate-y-180 { transform: rotateY(180deg); }
        .card-inner {
            transition: transform 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.175, 0.885, 0.32, 1.275);
        }
        .card-inner.is-flipped {
            transform: rotateY(180deg);
        }
    </style>
<style id="offline-custom-effects">
/* Original arcade special animation classes preserved without the Tailwind CDN. */
@keyframes arcadeFloatUp {from{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}to{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-60px) scale(1.1)}}
@keyframes arcadeShimmer {to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes arcadeGolden {0%,100%{transform:scale(1) rotate(0);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 15px rgba(251,191,36,.8))}50%{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(5deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 25px rgba(251,191,36,1))}}
@keyframes arcadeWave {0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
@keyframes arcadeGlow {0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(168,85,247,.6))}50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(236,72,153,.9))}}
@keyframes arcadeFloat {0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
@keyframes arcadeWobble {0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}25%{transform:rotate(-10deg)}75%{transform:rotate(10deg)}}
@keyframes arcadeShake {10%,90%{transform:translate3d(-2px,0,0)}20%,80%{transform:translate3d(4px,0,0)}30%,50%,70%{transform:translate3d(-6px,0,0)}40%,60%{transform:translate3d(6px,0,0)}}
@keyframes arcadeBounce {0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-15px)}}
.animate-float-up{animation:arcadeFloatUp 1s ease-out forwards}
.animate-spin-slow{animation:arcadeShimmer 25s linear infinite}
.animate-golden-glow{animation:arcadeGolden 2s ease-in-out infinite}
.animate-milk-wave{animation:arcadeWave 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.animate-pulse-glow{animation:arcadeGlow 2s infinite}
.animate-float{animation:arcadeFloat 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.animate-wobble{animation:arcadeWobble .6s ease-in-out infinite}
.animate-shake{animation:arcadeShake .4s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97) both}
.animate-bounce-short{animation:arcadeBounce .5s ease-in-out 2}
.border-bakery-600{border-color:#5c3828}
.bg-bakery-600{background-color:#5c3828}
.bg-bakery-500{background-color:#7a4b35}
.bg-bakery-400{background-color:#9e6246}
</style>
<style id="offline-preserved-fonts-and-soccer-controls">@font-face{font-family:'Arcade Nunito';font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Arcade Nunito';font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Arcade Nunito';font-weight:900;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Arcade Round';font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Arcade Round';font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Arcade Clean';font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Arcade Clean';font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
@font-face{font-family:'Arcade Clean';font-weight:900;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2')}
:root {--font-fredoka:'Arcade Round',sans-serif;--font-outfit:'Arcade Clean',sans-serif;--font-nunito:'Arcade Nunito',sans-serif;--font-sans:'Arcade Nunito',sans-serif;}
body{font-family:'Arcade Nunito',sans-serif!important;}
.font-fredoka{font-family:'Arcade Round',sans-serif!important;}
.font-outfit{font-family:'Arcade Clean',sans-serif!important;}
.font-nunito{font-family:'Arcade Nunito',sans-serif!important;}
/* Soccer-only controls. All other sections retain their original design. */
.soccer-presets{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.35rem;margin-top:.55rem}
.soccer-preset{background:rgba(51,65,85,.7);color:#e2e8f0;border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.28);border-radius:.65rem;padding:.3rem .65rem;font-family:'Arcade Nunito',sans-serif;font-size:.74rem;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,border .15s}
.soccer-preset:hover{background:rgba(71,85,105,.9)}
.soccer-preset[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#b45309;border-color:#fbbf24;color:white}
.soccer-preset:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #fbbf24;outline-offset:2px}
</style>
</head>
<body class="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 selection:bg-purple-500 selection:text-white relative">

    <canvas id="particleCanvas" class="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 w-full h-full"></canvas>
    <div id="goldenCookieContainer" class="fixed z-40"></div>

    <!-- TOP HEADER BAR -->
    <header class="sticky top-0 z-40 bg-slate-900/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800 px-4 py-3 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300">
        <div class="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3">
            
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between w-full sm:w-auto gap-3">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-purple-600 to-pink-500 flex items-center justify-center font-fredoka text-2xl font-bold shadow-md shadow-purple-500/20">
                        👑
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <h1 class="font-fredoka text-2xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-400 via-pink-400 to-amber-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                            BLOOKET 1K SIM
                        </h1>
                        <p id="header-subtitle" class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-semibold">1,001 Blooks • Arcade Games • Supreme "Aidan" & "Maxim"</p>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <button onclick="toggleHeaderCollapse()" class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-fredoka text-xs font-bold transition-all border border-slate-700">
                    <span id="header-toggle-text">Collapse</span>
                    <svg aria-hidden="true" class="inline-block align-middle text-xs" style="width:1em;height:1em;fill:currentColor;vertical-align:-0.1em" viewbox="0 0 512 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><!--!                 </button>
            </div>

            <div id="header-stats-container" class="flex items-center gap-3 transition-all duration-300">

                    <span class="text-xl">🪙</span>
                    <span id="stat-tokens" class="font-fredoka text-xl font-bold text-amber-400">5,000</span>
                    <span class="text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold">Tokens</span>
                </div>

                <div class="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-800/90 border border-slate-700/80 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-2xl shadow-inner">
                    <span class="text-xl">🎒</span>
                    <div>
                        <div class="font-fredoka text-base font-bold text-sky-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <span id="stat-unlocked">0</span> / 1001
                            <span id="stat-percent" class="text-xs text-slate-400 font-normal">(0%)</span>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>

    <!-- MAIN CONTENT AREA -->
    <main class="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6">
        
        <!-- ================= TAB 1: SHOP ================= -->
        <section id="tab-shop" class="space-y-6">
            <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-900/60 to-slate-900 border border-purple-500/30 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-xl flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                    <h2 class="font-fredoka text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span>📦</span> Open Packs & Collect Blooks
                    </h2>
                    <p class="text-slate-300 text-sm mt-1">Explore 50 themed packs! Pull the mythical 0.001% Supreme Blooks: <strong class="text-amber-300">Aidan & Maxim 👑✨</strong></p>
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">
                    <div class="relative w-full md:w-64">
                        <svg aria-hidden="true" class="inline-block align-middle absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" style="width:1em;height:1em;fill:currentColor;vertical-align:-0.1em" viewbox="0 0 512 512" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><!--!                         <input type="text" id="shop-search" oninput="renderShop()" placeholder="Search packs..." class="w-full bg-slate-950 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl pl-10 pr-4 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:border-purple-500 text-white placeholder-slate-500">
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <div id="packs-container" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-4"></div>
        </section>

        <!-- ================= TAB 2: INVENTORY ================= -->
        <section id="tab-inventory" class="hidden space-y-6">
            <div class="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-xl space-y-4">
                <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4">
                    <div>
                        <h2 class="font-fredoka text-2xl font-bold text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span>🎒</span> My Blooks Collection
                        </h2>
                        <p class="text-slate-400 text-sm">Manage, search, and sell duplicate Blooks for tokens.</p>
                    </div>

                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto">

                        </div>
                        <div class="text-right shrink-0">
                            <div id="soccer-score-text" class="text-sm font-bold text-amber-300">GOALS: 0 | SAVES: 0</div>
                            <button onclick="resetSoccerGame()" class="mt-1 px-3 py-1.5 bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl border border-slate-700 text-slate-200">Reset Shootout</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="relative w-full max-w-[700px] mx-auto aspect-[16/10] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-4 border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 cursor-crosshair">
                        <canvas id="soccerCanvas" width="700" height="430" class="w-full h-full block" aria-label="Soccer shooting field. Move pointer to aim, and click to shoot."></canvas>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-left bg-slate-950/80 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-700">
                        <label class="block text-sm font-bold text-slate-200" for="soccer-aim">↔ Side to side <span id="soccer-aim-value" class="float-right text-amber-300">Center</span>
                            <input id="soccer-aim" aria-label="Horizontal shot direction" class="w-full mt-2 accent-amber-400" type="range" min="-100" max="100" step="1" value="0" oninput="soccerControlsChanged()">
