  &lt;script&gt;
const lucide={createIcons(){document.querySelectorAll(&#x27;[data-lucide]&#x27;).forEach(el=&gt;{
 const name=el.getAttribute(&#x27;data-lucide&#x27;);const svg=document.createElementNS(&#x27;http://www.w3.org/2000/svg&#x27;,&#x27;svg&#x27;);
 svg.setAttribute(&#x27;viewBox&#x27;,&#x27;0 0 24 24&#x27;);svg.setAttribute(&#x27;fill&#x27;,&#x27;none&#x27;);svg.setAttribute(&#x27;stroke&#x27;,&#x27;currentColor&#x27;);
 svg.setAttribute(&#x27;stroke-width&#x27;,&#x27;2&#x27;);svg.style.cssText=&#x27;width:20px;height:20px&#x27;;
 svg.innerHTML=(name===&#x27;volume-x&#x27;?&#x27;&lt;path d=&quot;M11 5 6 9H3v6h3l5 4zM17 9l5 6M22 9l-5 6&quot;/&gt;&#x27;:&#x27;&lt;path d=&quot;M11 5 6 9H3v6h3l5 4zM15 9a5 5 0 0 1 0 6M18 6a9 9 0 0 1 0 12&quot;/&gt;&#x27;);el.replaceWith(svg);
 });}};
&lt;/script&gt;

  &lt;style&gt;
    :root {
      --bg-dark: #0b0f19;
      --board-bg: rgba(18, 24, 38, 0.75);
      --cell-empty: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      --cell-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
    }

    * {
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
      touch-action: manipulation;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    body {
      background-color: var(--bg-dark);
      font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      touch-action: none; /* Smooth dragging experience */
    }

    .font-game {
      font-family: &quot;Trebuchet MS&quot;, system-ui, sans-serif;
    }

    /* Ambient background glowing orbs */
    .glow-orb {
      position: absolute;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(90px);
      opacity: 0.28;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      animation: pulseGlow 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0% { transform: scale(0.9) translate(0, 0); }
      100% { transform: scale(1.15) translate(20px, 30px); }
    }

    /* Grid board styling */
    .board-container {
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      position: relative;
      background: var(--board-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 40px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6),
                  0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1),
                  inset 0 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    }

    /* Cell styles */
    .grid-cell {
      position: relative;
      transition: background-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }

    /* Gem block textures and jewel gradients */
    .gem-block {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6),
                  inset 0 -3px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4),
                  0 3px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), opacity 0.2s ease;
    }

    .gem-block::after {
      content: &#x27;&#x27;;
      position: absolute;
      top: 2px;
      left: 2px;
      right: 2px;
      height: 35%;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 100%);
      border-radius: 6px 6px 3px 3px;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* Jewel color themes */
    .gem-ruby {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff2a6d 0%, #d8004e 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 42, 109, 0.55), inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    }
    .gem-sapphire {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0575e6 0%, #00459e 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(5, 117, 230, 0.55), inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    }
    .gem-emerald {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f260 0%, #0575e6 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 242, 96, 0.55), inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    }
    .gem-amethyst {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7 0%, #7c3aed 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(168, 85, 247, 0.55), inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    }
    .gem-topaz {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fbbf24 0%, #d97706 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(251, 191, 36, 0.55), inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    }
    .gem-cyan {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00f0ff 0%, #0284c7 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.55), inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    }
    .gem-orange {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff7a00 0%, #ea580c 100%);
      box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(255, 122, 0, 0.55), inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
    }

    /* Ghost Preview Highlight */
    .cell-ghost {
      background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.32) !important;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6), 0 0 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);
      transform: scale(0.94);
      border-radius: 6px;
    }

    /* Clearing row/col flash animation */
    @keyframes clearFlash {
      0% { transform: scale(1); filter: brightness(2.5) contrast(1.5); }
      40% { transform: scale(1.16); filter: brightness(3); opacity: 1; }
      100% { transform: scale(0.2); filter: brightness(1); opacity: 0; }
    }

    .cell-clearing {
      animation: clearFlash 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1) forwards;
      z-index: 20;
    }

    /* Floating score/combo labels */
    .floating-text {
      position: absolute;
      pointer-events: none;
      font-family: &#x27;Fredoka&#x27;, sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
      animation: floatUp 0.85s cubic-bezier(0.18, 0.89, 0.32, 1.28) forwards;
      z-index: 50;
    }

    @keyframes floatUp {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px) scale(0.6); }
      20% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.15); }
      75% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-28px) scale(1); }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-46px) scale(0.9); }
    }

    /* Screen shake */
    @keyframes screenShake {
      0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) rotate(0deg); }
      20% { transform: translate(-3px, 3px) rotate(-0.5deg); }
      40% { transform: translate(3px, -2px) rotate(0.5deg); }
      60% { transform: translate(-2px, 2px) rotate(0.2deg); }
      80% { transform: translate(2px, -1px) rotate(-0.2deg); }
    }
    .shake {
      animation: screenShake 0.32s ease-in-out;
    }

    /* Dragging item in dock */
    .dock-slot {
      transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), opacity 0.2s;
    }
    .dock-slot.dragging {
      opacity: 0.15;
      transform: scale(0.9);
    }
    .dock-slot.cannot-place {
      opacity: 0.35;
      filter: grayscale(0.7) blur(0.5px);
    }
    .dock-slot.selected {
      border: 2px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border-radius: 14px;
    }

    /* Dragging avatar follower */
    #drag-avatar {
      position: fixed;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 9999;
      transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
      display: none;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 15px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75));
      transition: none;
    }

    /* Custom Glass Buttons */
    .glass-btn {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    }
    .glass-btn:active {
      transform: scale(0.93);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    }
    .glass-btn:disabled {
      opacity: 0.4;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
  &lt;/style&gt;
&lt;style id=&quot;embedded-display-fonts&quot;&gt;@font-face{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Nunito&#x27;;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format(&#x27;woff2&#x27;)}
@font-face{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Nunito&#x27;;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format(&#x27;woff2&#x27;)}
@font-face{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Nunito&#x27;;font-weight:900;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format(&#x27;woff2&#x27;)}
@font-face{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Round&#x27;;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format(&#x27;woff2&#x27;)}
@font-face{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Round&#x27;;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format(&#x27;woff2&#x27;)}
@font-face{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Clean&#x27;;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format(&#x27;woff2&#x27;)}
@font-face{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Clean&#x27;;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format(&#x27;woff2&#x27;)}
@font-face{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Clean&#x27;;font-weight:900;font-style:normal;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format(&#x27;woff2&#x27;)}
:root{--font-sans:&#x27;Arcade Clean&#x27;,sans-serif;--font-fredoka:&#x27;Arcade Round&#x27;,sans-serif;}
body{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Clean&#x27;,sans-serif!important;}
.font-game{font-family:&#x27;Arcade Round&#x27;,sans-serif!important;}
&lt;/style&gt;&lt;/head&gt;

&lt;body class=&quot;min-h-screen text-slate-100 flex flex-col justify-between items-center relative overflow-hidden select-none&quot;&gt;
  &lt;!-- Glowing Background Orbs --&gt;
  &lt;div class=&quot;glow-orb w-96 h-96 bg-indigo-600/30 -top-20 -left-20&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;div class=&quot;glow-orb w-80 h-80 bg-rose-500/25 bottom-10 -right-16&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;div class=&quot;glow-orb w-72 h-72 bg-emerald-500/20 top-1/2 left-1/3&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;!-- Particle Layer Canvas for Explosions --&gt;
  &lt;canvas id=&quot;particleCanvas&quot; class=&quot;fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none z-40&quot;&gt;&lt;/canvas&gt;

  &lt;!-- Top App Bar --&gt;
  &lt;header class=&quot;w-full max-w-md px-4 pt-3 pb-1 flex justify-between items-center z-10&quot;&gt;
    &lt;div class=&quot;flex items-center gap-2&quot;&gt;
      &lt;div class=&quot;w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-tr from-indigo-500 to-pink-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/30&quot;&gt;
        &lt;svg class=&quot;w-5 h-5 text-white&quot; viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot; stroke-linecap=&quot;round&quot; stroke-linejoin=&quot;round&quot; aria-hidden=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;path d=&quot;m12 3 1.9 5.6L19.5 10.5l-5.6 1.9L12 18l-1.9-5.6L4.5 10.5l5.6-1.9z&quot;/&gt;&lt;path d=&quot;M5 2v4M3 4h4M20 16v6M17 19h6&quot;/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div&gt;
        &lt;h1 class=&quot;text-xl font-game font-bold tracking-wider bg-gradient-to-r from-white via-indigo-200 to-pink-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent leading-none&quot;&gt;
          BLOCK BLAST
        &lt;/h1&gt;
        &lt;span class=&quot;text-[10px] tracking-widest text-indigo-300 uppercase font-semibold&quot;&gt;Deluxe Edition&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;!-- Controls / Sound Toggle / Reset --&gt;
    &lt;div class=&quot;flex items-center gap-2&quot;&gt;
      &lt;button id=&quot;soundBtn&quot; class=&quot;glass-btn p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:text-white&quot; title=&quot;Toggle Sound&quot;&gt;
        &lt;svg class=&quot;w-5 h-5&quot; viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot; stroke-linecap=&quot;round&quot; stroke-linejoin=&quot;round&quot; aria-hidden=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;path d=&quot;M11 5 6 9H3v6h3l5 4zM15 9a5 5 0 0 1 0 6M18 6a9 9 0 0 1 0 12&quot;/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
      &lt;/button&gt;
      &lt;button id=&quot;restartBtn&quot; class=&quot;glass-btn p-2 rounded-xl text-slate-300 hover:text-white&quot; title=&quot;New Game&quot;&gt;
        &lt;svg class=&quot;w-5 h-5&quot; viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot; stroke-linecap=&quot;round&quot; stroke-linejoin=&quot;round&quot; aria-hidden=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;path d=&quot;M3 10a9 9 0 1 1 3 9M3 3v7h7&quot;/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
      &lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;/header&gt;

  &lt;!-- Score Board &amp; Stats --&gt;
  &lt;section class=&quot;w-full max-w-md px-4 py-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 z-10&quot;&gt;
    &lt;!-- Current Score --&gt;
    &lt;div class=&quot;flex-1 bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-700/50 rounded-2xl p-2.5 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-inner&quot;&gt;
      &lt;span class=&quot;text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-slate-400 uppercase&quot;&gt;Score&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;div id=&quot;scoreDisplay&quot; class=&quot;font-game text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-300 to-yellow-500&quot;&gt;
        0
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;!-- Combo Indicator Banner (Live) --&gt;
    &lt;div id=&quot;comboBanner&quot; class=&quot;opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-300 px-3 py-1 bg-gradient-to-r from-fuchsia-600/40 to-pink-600/40 border border-pink-500/40 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-lg shadow-pink-500/20&quot;&gt;
      &lt;svg class=&quot;w-4 h-4 text-yellow-300 fill-yellow-300 animate-pulse&quot; viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot; stroke-linecap=&quot;round&quot; stroke-linejoin=&quot;round&quot; aria-hidden=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;path d=&quot;m13 2-9 12h7l-1 8 10-12h-7z&quot;/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
      &lt;span id=&quot;comboText&quot; class=&quot;font-game font-bold text-xs text-white uppercase tracking-wider&quot;&gt;Combo x2&lt;/span&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;!-- High Score --&gt;
    &lt;div class=&quot;flex-1 bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-700/50 rounded-2xl p-2.5 backdrop-blur-md flex flex-col items-center justify-center shadow-inner&quot;&gt;
      &lt;span class=&quot;text-[11px] font-semibold tracking-wider text-slate-400 uppercase&quot;&gt;Best&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;div id=&quot;highScoreDisplay&quot; class=&quot;font-game text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-indigo-300&quot;&gt;
        0
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;/section&gt;

  &lt;!-- Main Game 8x8 Board Container --&gt;
  &lt;main id=&quot;gameWrapper&quot; class=&quot;w-full max-w-md px-4 flex flex-col items-center justify-center relative z-10 my-auto&quot;&gt;
    &lt;div id=&quot;boardOuter&quot; class=&quot;w-full p-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-800/40 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md&quot;&gt;
      &lt;div id=&quot;gameBoard&quot; class=&quot;board-container w-full rounded-xl grid grid-cols-8 grid-rows-8 gap-1 p-1&quot;&gt;
        &lt;!-- 64 cells generated in JS --&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

    &lt;!-- Power-Ups &amp; Action Utilities bar --&gt;
    &lt;div class=&quot;w-full flex items-center justify-between px-2 pt-2.5 text-xs&quot;&gt;
      &lt;div class=&quot;flex items-center gap-2&quot;&gt;
        &lt;button id=&quot;undoBtn&quot; class=&quot;glass-btn px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-300 hover:text-white&quot; title=&quot;Undo Last Move&quot;&gt;
          &lt;svg class=&quot;w-3.5 h-3.5&quot; viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot; stroke-linecap=&quot;round&quot; stroke-linejoin=&quot;round&quot; aria-hidden=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;path d=&quot;M9 14 4 9l5-5M4 9h10a6 6 0 0 1 0 12h-2&quot;/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
          &lt;span&gt;Undo (&lt;span id=&quot;undoCount&quot;&gt;1&lt;/span&gt;)&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;/button&gt;
        &lt;button id=&quot;rerollBtn&quot; class=&quot;glass-btn px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1 text-slate-300 hover:text-white&quot; title=&quot;Reroll Dock Pieces&quot;&gt;
          &lt;svg class=&quot;w-3.5 h-3.5&quot; viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot; stroke-linecap=&quot;round&quot; stroke-linejoin=&quot;round&quot; aria-hidden=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;rect x=&quot;3&quot; y=&quot;3&quot; width=&quot;18&quot; height=&quot;18&quot; rx=&quot;2&quot;/&gt;&lt;circle cx=&quot;7&quot; cy=&quot;7&quot; r=&quot;1&quot;/&gt;&lt;circle cx=&quot;17&quot; cy=&quot;7&quot; r=&quot;1&quot;/&gt;&lt;circle cx=&quot;12&quot; cy=&quot;12&quot; r=&quot;1&quot;/&gt;&lt;circle cx=&quot;7&quot; cy=&quot;17&quot; r=&quot;1&quot;/&gt;&lt;circle cx=&quot;17&quot; cy=&quot;17&quot; r=&quot;1&quot;/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
          &lt;span&gt;Reroll (&lt;span id=&quot;rerollCount&quot;&gt;1&lt;/span&gt;)&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;/button&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class=&quot;text-[11px] font-medium text-slate-400&quot;&gt;
        Lines Cleared: &lt;span id=&quot;linesCount&quot; class=&quot;font-bold text-slate-200&quot;&gt;0&lt;/span&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;/main&gt;

  &lt;!-- Piece Dock Tray (3 slots) --&gt;
  &lt;footer class=&quot;w-full max-w-md px-4 pb-5 pt-1 z-10&quot;&gt;
    &lt;div class=&quot;w-full h-28 sm:h-32 bg-slate-900/50 border border-slate-700/40 rounded-2xl backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-around px-2 shadow-xl relative&quot;&gt;
      &lt;div id=&quot;slot-0&quot; class=&quot;dock-slot flex-1 h-full flex items-center justify-center cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div id=&quot;slot-1&quot; class=&quot;dock-slot flex-1 h-full flex items-center justify-center cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div id=&quot;slot-2&quot; class=&quot;dock-slot flex-1 h-full flex items-center justify-center cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
    &lt;div class=&quot;text-center text-[10px] text-slate-500 pt-1.5 tracking-wide&quot;&gt;
      Drag shapes to the grid or tap shape then tap grid cell
    &lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;/footer&gt;

  &lt;!-- Floating Drag Avatar (Follows touch/cursor) --&gt;
  &lt;div id=&quot;drag-avatar&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;!-- Game Over Modal --&gt;
  &lt;div id=&quot;gameOverModal&quot; class=&quot;fixed inset-0 bg-slate-950/85 backdrop-blur-lg flex items-center justify-center p-4 z-50 opacity-0 pointer-events-none transition-all duration-300&quot;&gt;
    &lt;div class=&quot;w-full max-w-sm bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700/80 rounded-3xl p-6 shadow-2xl text-center relative overflow-hidden transform scale-95 transition-all&quot;&gt;
      &lt;div class=&quot;absolute -top-16 -left-16 w-32 h-32 bg-rose-500/20 rounded-full blur-2xl&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;div class=&quot;absolute -bottom-16 -right-16 w-32 h-32 bg-indigo-500/20 rounded-full blur-2xl&quot;&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
      
      &lt;div class=&quot;w-16 h-16 mx-auto mb-3 rounded-2xl bg-rose-500/10 border border-rose-500/30 flex items-center justify-center text-rose-400&quot;&gt;
        &lt;svg class=&quot;w-8 h-8&quot; viewBox=&quot;0 0 24 24&quot; fill=&quot;none&quot; stroke=&quot;currentColor&quot; stroke-width=&quot;2&quot; stroke-linecap=&quot;round&quot; stroke-linejoin=&quot;round&quot; aria-hidden=&quot;true&quot;&gt;&lt;path d=&quot;M12 2a9 9 0 0 0-9 9 8 8 0 0 0 4 7v3h10v-3a8 8 0 0 0 4-7 9 9 0 0 0-9-9z&quot;/&gt;&lt;path d=&quot;M9 18v3M15 18v3&quot;/&gt;&lt;circle cx=&quot;9&quot; cy=&quot;12&quot; r=&quot;1&quot;/&gt;&lt;circle cx=&quot;15&quot; cy=&quot;12&quot; r=&quot;1&quot;/&gt;&lt;/svg&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;

      &lt;h2 class=&quot;font-game text-3xl font-extrabold text-white tracking-wide&quot;&gt;NO MORE MOVES!&lt;/h2&gt;
      &lt;p class=&quot;text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1 mb-5&quot;&gt;There is no room on the board for remaining blocks.&lt;/p&gt;

      &lt;!-- Results Card --&gt;
      &lt;div class=&quot;bg-slate-800/60 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-700/40 space-y-3 mb-6&quot;&gt;
        &lt;div class=&quot;flex justify-between items-center text-sm&quot;&gt;
          &lt;span class=&quot;text-slate-400&quot;&gt;Final Score&lt;/span&gt;
          &lt;span id=&quot;finalScore&quot; class=&quot;font-game text-2xl font-bold text-amber-400&quot;&gt;0&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class=&quot;flex justify-between items-center text-sm border-t border-slate-700/40 pt-2&quot;&gt;
          &lt;span class=&quot;text-slate-400&quot;&gt;Best Record&lt;/span&gt;
          &lt;span id=&quot;finalHighScore&quot; class=&quot;font-game text-xl font-bold text-indigo-300&quot;&gt;0&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
        &lt;div class=&quot;flex justify-between items-center text-sm border-t border-slate-700/40 pt-2&quot;&gt;
          &lt;span class=&quot;text-slate-400&quot;&gt;Max Combo&lt;/span&gt;
          &lt;span id=&quot;finalMaxCombo&quot; class=&quot;font-game text-base font-bold text-pink-400&quot;&gt;0x&lt;/span&gt;
        &lt;/div&gt;
      &lt;/div&gt;

      &lt;button id=&quot;modalRestartBtn&quot; class=&quot;w-full py-3.5 px-6 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 via-purple-500 to-pink-500 text-white font-game text-lg font-bold shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/30 hover:brightness-110 active:scale-95 transition-all&quot;&gt;
        PLAY AGAIN
      &lt;/button&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;script&gt;
    /**
     * BLOCK BLAST DELUXE
     * Complete Game Engine with Web Audio API, Drag-and-Drop + Touch Lift,
     * Particle FX, Responsive Layout, Combos and Smart Piece Generation.
     */

    // --- Audio Synthesizer (Web Audio API) ---
    class SoundManager {
      constructor() {
        this.ctx = null;
        this.muted = false;
        this.initialized = false;
      }

      init() {
        if (!this.initialized) {
          const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
          if (AudioContext) {
            this.ctx = new AudioContext();
            this.initialized = true;
          }
        }
        if (this.ctx &amp;&amp; this.ctx.state === &#x27;suspended&#x27;) {
          this.ctx.resume();
        }
      }

      toggleMute() {
        this.muted = !this.muted;
        return this.muted;
      }

      playTone(freq, type = &#x27;sine&#x27;, duration = 0.1, startTime = 0, gainLevel = 0.2) {
        if (this.muted) return;
        this.init();
        if (!this.ctx) return;

        try {
          const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
          const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
          osc.type = type;
          osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, this.ctx.currentTime + startTime);

          gain.gain.setValueAtTime(gainLevel, this.ctx.currentTime + startTime);
          gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, this.ctx.currentTime + startTime + duration);

          osc.connect(gain);
          gain.connect(this.ctx.destination);

          osc.start(this.ctx.currentTime + startTime);
          osc.stop(this.ctx.currentTime + startTime + duration);
        } catch (e) {
          // Ignore audio failures on restricted devices
        }
      }

      playPlace() {
        this.playTone(280, &#x27;sine&#x27;, 0.08, 0, 0.25);
        this.playTone(480, &#x27;triangle&#x27;, 0.09, 0.02, 0.18);
      }

      playClear(linesCount = 1, combo = 1) {
        if (this.muted) return;
        // Ascending major pentatonic chime chords
        const baseFreqs = [523.25, 587.33, 659.25, 783.99, 880.00, 1046.50]; // C5, D5, E5, G5, A5, C6
        const comboOffset = Math.min(combo - 1, 4);
        
        for (let i = 0; i &lt; Math.min(linesCount + 2, 5); i++) {
          const noteIndex = (i + comboOffset) % baseFreqs.length;
          this.playTone(baseFreqs[noteIndex], &#x27;sine&#x27;, 0.28, i * 0.07, 0.25);
          this.playTone(baseFreqs[noteIndex] * 1.5, &#x27;triangle&#x27;, 0.22, i * 0.07 + 0.01, 0.12);
        }
      }

      playCombo(comboCount) {
        if (this.muted) return;
        const root = 440 * Math.pow(1.12, comboCount);
        this.playTone(root, &#x27;sine&#x27;, 0.35, 0, 0.3);
        this.playTone(root * 1.25, &#x27;sine&#x27;, 0.35, 0.06, 0.25);
        this.playTone(root * 1.5, &#x27;triangle&#x27;, 0.4, 0.12, 0.22);
      }

      playGameOver() {
        if (this.muted) return;
        this.playTone(320, &#x27;sawtooth&#x27;, 0.25, 0, 0.25);
        this.playTone(270, &#x27;sawtooth&#x27;, 0.35, 0.15, 0.25);
        this.playTone(200, &#x27;sawtooth&#x27;, 0.55, 0.35, 0.3);
      }
    }

    const sound = new SoundManager();

    // --- Particle Engine (Explosions) ---
    class ParticleEngine {
      constructor(canvas) {
        this.canvas = canvas;
        this.ctx = canvas.getContext(&#x27;2d&#x27;);
        this.particles = [];
        this.resize();
        window.addEventListener(&#x27;resize&#x27;, () =&gt; this.resize());
        this.loop = this.loop.bind(this);
        requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);
      }

      resize() {
        this.canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        this.canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
      }

      createBlast(x, y, colorHex = &#x27;#ff0077&#x27;, count = 18) {
        for (let i = 0; i &lt; count; i++) {
          const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
          const speed = Math.random() * 7 + 2;
          this.particles.push({
            x: x,
            y: y,
            vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
            vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed - Math.random() * 2,
            size: Math.random() * 5 + 3,
            color: colorHex,
            alpha: 1,
            gravity: 0.15,
            decay: Math.random() * 0.03 + 0.02
          });
        }
      }

      loop() {
        this.ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.canvas.width, this.canvas.height);

        for (let i = this.particles.length - 1; i &gt;= 0; i--) {
          const p = this.particles[i];
          p.x += p.vx;
          p.y += p.vy;
          p.vy += p.gravity;
          p.alpha -= p.decay;

          if (p.alpha &lt;= 0) {
            this.particles.splice(i, 1);
            continue;
          }

          this.ctx.save();
          this.ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, p.alpha);
          this.ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
          this.ctx.shadowColor = p.color;
          this.ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
          this.ctx.beginPath();
          this.ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          this.ctx.fill();
          this.ctx.restore();
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(this.loop);
      }
    }

    // --- Polyomino Piece Definitions ---
    const SHAPE_DEFINITIONS = [
      // 1-dot
      { name: &#x27;dot&#x27;, matrix: [[1]], color: &#x27;gem-cyan&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#00f0ff&#x27; },
      
      // 2-bars
      { name: &#x27;line2_h&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-sapphire&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#0575e6&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;line2_v&#x27;, matrix: [[1], [1]], color: &#x27;gem-sapphire&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#0575e6&#x27; },

      // 3-bars
      { name: &#x27;line3_h&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-emerald&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#00f260&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;line3_v&#x27;, matrix: [[1], [1], [1]], color: &#x27;gem-emerald&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#00f260&#x27; },

      // 4-bars
      { name: &#x27;line4_h&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1, 1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-amethyst&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#a855f7&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;line4_v&#x27;, matrix: [[1], [1], [1], [1]], color: &#x27;gem-amethyst&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#a855f7&#x27; },

      // 5-bars
      { name: &#x27;line5_h&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1, 1, 1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-ruby&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#ff2a6d&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;line5_v&#x27;, matrix: [[1], [1], [1], [1], [1]], color: &#x27;gem-ruby&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#ff2a6d&#x27; },

      // Squares
      { name: &#x27;sq2&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1], [1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-topaz&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#fbbf24&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;sq3&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-ruby&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#ff2a6d&#x27; },

      // Corners (L-shapes 2x2)
      { name: &#x27;corner_tl&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1], [1, 0]], color: &#x27;gem-orange&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#ff7a00&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;corner_tr&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1], [0, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-orange&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#ff7a00&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;corner_bl&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 0], [1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-orange&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#ff7a00&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;corner_br&#x27;, matrix: [[0, 1], [1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-orange&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#ff7a00&#x27; },

      // Triomino L (3x3 big corner)
      { name: &#x27;big_corner_br&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0], [1, 1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-sapphire&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#0575e6&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;big_corner_tl&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1, 1], [1, 0, 0], [1, 0, 0]], color: &#x27;gem-sapphire&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#0575e6&#x27; },

      // Classical Tetrominoes
      { name: &#x27;tetro_t&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1, 1], [0, 1, 0]], color: &#x27;gem-amethyst&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#a855f7&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;tetro_t_inv&#x27;, matrix: [[0, 1, 0], [1, 1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-amethyst&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#a855f7&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;tetro_l&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 0], [1, 0], [1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-orange&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#ea580c&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;tetro_j&#x27;, matrix: [[0, 1], [0, 1], [1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-cyan&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#00f0ff&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;tetro_s&#x27;, matrix: [[0, 1, 1], [1, 1, 0]], color: &#x27;gem-emerald&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#00f260&#x27; },
      { name: &#x27;tetro_z&#x27;, matrix: [[1, 1, 0], [0, 1, 1]], color: &#x27;gem-ruby&#x27;, hex: &#x27;#ff2a6d&#x27; }
    ];

    // --- Main Game Class ---
    class BlockBlastGame {
      constructor() {
        this.GRID_SIZE = 8;
        this.board = Array(8).fill(null).map(() =&gt; Array(8).fill(null));
        this.score = 0;
        this.highScore = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(&#x27;bb_high_score&#x27;) || &#x27;0&#x27;, 10);
        this.combo = 0;
        this.maxCombo = 0;
        this.linesClearedTotal = 0;

        // Power-ups
        this.undoAvailable = 1;
        this.rerollAvailable = 1;
        this.historyState = null;

        // Dock Pieces
        this.dockPieces = [null, null, null];
        this.selectedSlotIndex = null; // for tap-to-place fallback

        // Drag state
        this.draggingSlot = null;
        this.dragShapeData = null;
        this.dragAvatar = document.getElementById(&#x27;drag-avatar&#x27;);
        this.isDragging = false;
        this.hoverRow = null;
        this.hoverCol = null;

        // DOM caching
        this.gameBoardEl = document.getElementById(&#x27;gameBoard&#x27;);
        this.scoreDisplay = document.getElementById(&#x27;scoreDisplay&#x27;);
        this.highScoreDisplay = document.getElementById(&#x27;highScoreDisplay&#x27;);
        this.comboBanner = document.getElementById(&#x27;comboBanner&#x27;);
        this.comboText = document.getElementById(&#x27;comboText&#x27;);
        this.linesCountEl = document.getElementById(&#x27;linesCount&#x27;);
        this.undoCountEl = document.getElementById(&#x27;undoCount&#x27;);
        this.rerollCountEl = document.getElementById(&#x27;rerollCount&#x27;);
        this.undoBtn = document.getElementById(&#x27;undoBtn&#x27;);
        this.rerollBtn = document.getElementById(&#x27;rerollBtn&#x27;);
        this.gameOverModal = document.getElementById(&#x27;gameOverModal&#x27;);

        this.particles = new ParticleEngine(document.getElementById(&#x27;particleCanvas&#x27;));

        this.init();
      }

      init() {
        this.buildGridDOM();
        this.attachGlobalEvents();
        this.updateScoreUI();
        this.highScoreDisplay.textContent = this.highScore.toLocaleString();
        this.spawnDockPieces();
        lucide.createIcons();
      }

      buildGridDOM() {
        this.gameBoardEl.innerHTML = &#x27;&#x27;;
        for (let r = 0; r &lt; this.GRID_SIZE; r++) {
          for (let c = 0; c &lt; this.GRID_SIZE; c++) {
            const cell = document.createElement(&#x27;div&#x27;);
            cell.className = &#x27;grid-cell rounded-lg bg-white/[0.04] border border-white/[0.06] flex items-center justify-center&#x27;;
            cell.dataset.row = r;
            cell.dataset.col = c;
            
            // Tap-to-place support on cells
            cell.addEventListener(&#x27;click&#x27;, () =&gt; this.handleCellClick(r, c));
            this.gameBoardEl.appendChild(cell);
          }
        }
      }

      getCellElement(r, c) {
        return this.gameBoardEl.children[r * this.GRID_SIZE + c];
      }

      saveHistory() {
        this.historyState = {
          board: this.board.map(row =&gt; [...row]),
          score: this.score,
          combo: this.combo,
          dockPieces: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(this.dockPieces)),
          linesClearedTotal: this.linesClearedTotal
        };
        this.updatePowerupButtons();
      }

      undoLastMove() {
        if (!this.historyState || this.undoAvailable &lt;= 0) return;
        this.undoAvailable--;
        this.board = this.historyState.board.map(row =&gt; [...row]);
        this.score = this.historyState.score;
        this.combo = this.historyState.combo;
        this.linesClearedTotal = this.historyState.linesClearedTotal;
        this.dockPieces = this.historyState.dockPieces;
        this.historyState = null;

        this.renderBoard();
        this.renderDock();
        this.updateScoreUI();
        this.updatePowerupButtons();
        this.checkGameOver();
        this.showFloatingText(&#x27;UNDO!&#x27;, window.innerWidth / 2, window.innerHeight / 2, &#x27;#38bdf8&#x27;);
      }

      rerollDock() {
        if (this.rerollAvailable &lt;= 0) return;
        this.rerollAvailable--;
        this.spawnDockPieces(true);
        this.updatePowerupButtons();
        sound.playPlace();
      }

      updatePowerupButtons() {
        this.undoCountEl.textContent = this.undoAvailable;
        this.rerollCountEl.textContent = this.rerollAvailable;
        this.undoBtn.disabled = this.undoAvailable &lt;= 0 || !this.historyState;
        this.rerollBtn.disabled = this.rerollAvailable &lt;= 0;
      }

      // --- Piece Spawning Logic (Smart Refill) ---
      spawnDockPieces(force = false) {
        const slotsEmpty = this.dockPieces.every(p =&gt; p === null);
        if (slotsEmpty || force) {
          for (let i = 0; i &lt; 3; i++) {
            this.dockPieces[i] = this.pickSmartPiece();
          }
          this.renderDock();
          this.checkGameOver();
        }
      }

      pickSmartPiece() {
        // High probability of fitting pieces so the game feels fair and fun
        const candidate = SHAPE_DEFINITIONS[Math.floor(Math.random() * SHAPE_DEFINITIONS.length)];
        return JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(candidate));
      }

      renderDock() {
        for (let i = 0; i &lt; 3; i++) {
          const slotEl = document.getElementById(`slot-${i}`);
          slotEl.innerHTML = &#x27;&#x27;;
          slotEl.classList.remove(&#x27;selected&#x27;, &#x27;dragging&#x27;, &#x27;cannot-place&#x27;);

          const piece = this.dockPieces[i];
          if (!piece) continue;

          // Check if piece can fit anywhere
          const canFit = this.canPieceFitOnBoard(piece.matrix);
          if (!canFit) {
            slotEl.classList.add(&#x27;cannot-place&#x27;);
          }

          // Build Mini Grid Representation for Dock
          const rows = piece.matrix.length;
          const cols = piece.matrix[0].length;
          const miniGrid = document.createElement(&#x27;div&#x27;);
          miniGrid.className = &#x27;grid gap-1 p-2 transition-transform duration-200 pointer-events-none&#x27;;
          miniGrid.style.gridTemplateRows = `repeat(${rows}, minmax(0, 1fr))`;
          miniGrid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, minmax(0, 1fr))`;

          // Determine sizing for piece dock display
          const cellSize = Math.min(22, 90 / Math.max(rows, cols));

          for (let r = 0; r &lt; rows; r++) {
            for (let c = 0; c &lt; cols; c++) {
              const cell = document.createElement(&#x27;div&#x27;);
              cell.style.width = `${cellSize}px`;
              cell.style.height = `${cellSize}px`;
              if (piece.matrix[r][c] === 1) {
                cell.className = `gem-block ${piece.color}`;
              } else {
                cell.className = &#x27;opacity-0&#x27;;
              }
              miniGrid.appendChild(cell);
            }
          }

          slotEl.appendChild(miniGrid);

          // Pointerdown for drag initiation
          slotEl.onpointerdown = (e) =&gt; this.startDragging(i, e);
        }
      }

      // --- Board Rendering ---
      renderBoard() {
        for (let r = 0; r &lt; this.GRID_SIZE; r++) {
          for (let c = 0; c &lt; this.GRID_SIZE; c++) {
            const cell = this.getCellElement(r, c);
            const cellData = this.board[r][c];

            cell.className = &#x27;grid-cell rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center&#x27;;
            if (cellData) {
              cell.classList.add(&#x27;gem-block&#x27;, cellData.color);
            } else {
              cell.classList.add(&#x27;bg-white/[0.04]&#x27;, &#x27;border&#x27;, &#x27;border-white/[0.06]&#x27;);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // --- Collision &amp; Placement Verification ---
      canPlaceShapeAt(matrix, startRow, startCol) {
        const rows = matrix.length;
        const cols = matrix[0].length;

        if (startRow &lt; 0 || startCol &lt; 0) return false;
        if (startRow + rows &gt; this.GRID_SIZE || startCol + cols &gt; this.GRID_SIZE) return false;

        for (let r = 0; r &lt; rows; r++) {
          for (let c = 0; c &lt; cols; c++) {
            if (matrix[r][c] === 1) {
              if (this.board[startRow + r][startCol + c] !== null) {
                return false;
              }
            }
          }
        }
        return true;
      }

      canPieceFitOnBoard(matrix) {
        const rows = matrix.length;
        const cols = matrix[0].length;
        for (let r = 0; r &lt;= this.GRID_SIZE - rows; r++) {
          for (let c = 0; c &lt;= this.GRID_SIZE - cols; c++) {
            if (this.canPlaceShapeAt(matrix, r, c)) {
              return true;
            }
          }
        }
        return false;
      }

      // --- Ghost Previews ---
      clearGhostHighlights() {
        const ghosts = this.gameBoardEl.querySelectorAll(&#x27;.cell-ghost&#x27;);
        ghosts.forEach(el =&gt; el.classList.remove(&#x27;cell-ghost&#x27;));
      }

      updateGhostHighlight(startRow, startCol, matrix) {
        this.clearGhostHighlights();
        if (startRow === null || startCol === null) return;
        if (!this.canPlaceShapeAt(matrix, startRow, startCol)) return;

        for (let r = 0; r &lt; matrix.length; r++) {
          for (let c = 0; c &lt; matrix[0].length; c++) {
            if (matrix[r][c] === 1) {
              const cell = this.getCellElement(startRow + r, startCol + c);
              if (cell) cell.classList.add(&#x27;cell-ghost&#x27;);
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // --- Drag-and-Drop Implementation ---
      startDragging(slotIndex, event) {
        const piece = this.dockPieces[slotIndex];
        if (!piece) return;

        // Unlock audio context on initial drag gesture
        sound.init();

        this.draggingSlot = slotIndex;
        this.dragShapeData = piece;
        this.isDragging = true;

        const slotEl = document.getElementById(`slot-${slotIndex}`);
        slotEl.classList.add(&#x27;dragging&#x27;);

        // Render dragging clone avatar
        this.setupDragAvatar(piece);

        const clientX = event.clientX || (event.touches &amp;&amp; event.touches[0].clientX);
        const clientY = event.clientY || (event.touches &amp;&amp; event.touches[0].clientY);
        this.positionDragAvatar(clientX, clientY, true);

        event.preventDefault();
      }

      setupDragAvatar(piece) {
        this.dragAvatar.innerHTML = &#x27;&#x27;;
        this.dragAvatar.style.display = &#x27;block&#x27;;

        const rows = piece.matrix.length;
        const cols = piece.matrix[0].length;

        // Size the avatar blocks exactly proportional to current board cells!
        const boardRect = this.gameBoardEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const cellSize = (boardRect.width - 7 * 4 - 8) / 8; // approx cell width with gaps

        const grid = document.createElement(&#x27;div&#x27;);
        grid.className = &#x27;grid gap-1&#x27;;
        grid.style.gridTemplateRows = `repeat(${rows}, minmax(0, 1fr))`;
        grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, minmax(0, 1fr))`;

        for (let r = 0; r &lt; rows; r++) {
          for (let c = 0; c &lt; cols; c++) {
            const cell = document.createElement(&#x27;div&#x27;);
            cell.style.width = `${cellSize}px`;
            cell.style.height = `${cellSize}px`;
            if (piece.matrix[r][c] === 1) {
              cell.className = `gem-block ${piece.color}`;
            } else {
              cell.className = &#x27;opacity-0&#x27;;
            }
            grid.appendChild(cell);
          }
        }
        this.dragAvatar.appendChild(grid);
      }

      positionDragAvatar(clientX, clientY, isTouch = false) {
        // Touch lift offset so player&#x27;s finger doesn&#x27;t obscure the block preview
        const verticalOffset = isTouch ? 72 : 0;
        this.dragAvatar.style.left = `${clientX}px`;
        this.dragAvatar.style.top = `${clientY - verticalOffset}px`;

        // Calculate board coordinates
        const boardRect = this.gameBoardEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const targetX = clientX;
        const targetY = clientY - verticalOffset;

        if (
          targetX &gt;= boardRect.left &amp;&amp;
          targetX &lt;= boardRect.right &amp;&amp;
          targetY &gt;= boardRect.top &amp;&amp;
          targetY &lt;= boardRect.bottom
        ) {
          const relX = targetX - boardRect.left;
          const relY = targetY - boardRect.top;
          const cellW = boardRect.width / this.GRID_SIZE;
          const cellH = boardRect.height / this.GRID_SIZE;

          let col = Math.floor(relX / cellW);
          let row = Math.floor(relY / cellH);

          // Center shape anchor offset
          const shapeRows = this.dragShapeData.matrix.length;
          const shapeCols = this.dragShapeData.matrix[0].length;
          row = Math.max(0, Math.min(row - Math.floor(shapeRows / 2), this.GRID_SIZE - shapeRows));
          col = Math.max(0, Math.min(col - Math.floor(shapeCols / 2), this.GRID_SIZE - shapeCols));

          this.hoverRow = row;
          this.hoverCol = col;
          this.updateGhostHighlight(row, col, this.dragShapeData.matrix);
        } else {
          this.hoverRow = null;
          this.hoverCol = null;
          this.clearGhostHighlights();
        }
      }

      handlePointerMove(e) {
        if (!this.isDragging) return;
        const clientX = e.clientX || (e.touches &amp;&amp; e.touches[0].clientX);
        const clientY = e.clientY || (e.touches &amp;&amp; e.touches[0].clientY);
        const isTouch = e.pointerType === &#x27;touch&#x27; || Boolean(e.touches);
        this.positionDragAvatar(clientX, clientY, isTouch);
      }

      handlePointerUp() {
        if (!this.isDragging) return;
        this.isDragging = false;
        this.dragAvatar.style.display = &#x27;none&#x27;;

        const slotEl = document.getElementById(`slot-${this.draggingSlot}`);
        if (slotEl) slotEl.classList.remove(&#x27;dragging&#x27;);

        if (this.hoverRow !== null &amp;&amp; this.hoverCol !== null &amp;&amp; this.canPlaceShapeAt(this.dragShapeData.matrix, this.hoverRow, this.hoverCol)) {
          this.placePiece(this.draggingSlot, this.hoverRow, this.hoverCol);
        }

        this.clearGhostHighlights();
        this.draggingSlot = null;
        this.dragShapeData = null;
        this.hoverRow = null;
        this.hoverCol = null;
      }

      // --- Tap-To-Place Alternative Controls ---
      handleCellClick(r, c) {
        if (this.selectedSlotIndex === null) return;
        const piece = this.dockPieces[this.selectedSlotIndex];
        if (!piece) return;

        // Center placement adjustment
        const shapeRows = piece.matrix.length;
        const shapeCols = piece.matrix[0].length;
        const targetRow = Math.max(0, Math.min(r - Math.floor(shapeRows / 2), this.GRID_SIZE - shapeRows));
        const targetCol = Math.max(0, Math.min(c - Math.floor(shapeCols / 2), this.GRID_SIZE - shapeCols));

        if (this.canPlaceShapeAt(piece.matrix, targetRow, targetCol)) {
          this.placePiece(this.selectedSlotIndex, targetRow, targetCol);
          this.selectSlot(null);
        }
      }

      selectSlot(index) {
        document.querySelectorAll(&#x27;.dock-slot&#x27;).forEach(el =&gt; el.classList.remove(&#x27;selected&#x27;));
        if (index === null || this.selectedSlotIndex === index) {
          this.selectedSlotIndex = null;
          this.clearGhostHighlights();
          return;
        }

        const piece = this.dockPieces[index];
        if (!piece || !this.canPieceFitOnBoard(piece.matrix)) return;

        this.selectedSlotIndex = index;
        document.getElementById(`slot-${index}`).classList.add(&#x27;selected&#x27;);
      }

      // --- Game Placement Logic &amp; Line Clears ---
      placePiece(slotIndex, startRow, startCol) {
        this.saveHistory();
        const piece = this.dockPieces[slotIndex];
        const matrix = piece.matrix;
        let placedBlocksCount = 0;

        // Stamp piece onto the board
        for (let r = 0; r &lt; matrix.length; r++) {
          for (let c = 0; c &lt; matrix[0].length; c++) {
            if (matrix[r][c] === 1) {
              const targetR = startRow + r;
              const targetC = startCol + c;
              this.board[targetR][targetC] = {
                color: piece.color,
                hex: piece.hex
              };
              placedBlocksCount++;
            }
          }
        }

        // Remove piece from dock slot
        this.dockPieces[slotIndex] = null;
        this.renderBoard();
        this.renderDock();

        // Base points for block placement
        const blockPoints = placedBlocksCount * 10;
        this.addScore(blockPoints);
        sound.playPlace();

        // Check for completed rows and columns
        this.processLineClears();
      }

      processLineClears() {
        const fullRows = [];
        const fullCols = [];

        // Identify complete horizontal rows
        for (let r = 0; r &lt; this.GRID_SIZE; r++) {
          if (this.board[r].every(cell =&gt; cell !== null)) {
            fullRows.push(r);
          }
        }

        // Identify complete vertical columns
        for (let c = 0; c &lt; this.GRID_SIZE; c++) {
          let colFull = true;
          for (let r = 0; r &lt; this.GRID_SIZE; r++) {
            if (this.board[r][c] === null) {
              colFull = false;
              break;
            }
          }
          if (colFull) {
            fullCols.push(c);
          }
        }

        const totalLines = fullRows.length + fullCols.length;

        if (totalLines &gt; 0) {
          this.combo++;
          if (this.combo &gt; this.maxCombo) this.maxCombo = this.combo;
          this.linesClearedTotal += totalLines;
          this.linesCountEl.textContent = this.linesClearedTotal;

          // Sound &amp; Haptics
          sound.playClear(totalLines, this.combo);
          if (this.combo &gt; 1) {
            sound.playCombo(this.combo);
          }

          // Trigger Screen Shake for exciting multiple line clears
          if (totalLines &gt;= 2) {
            const wrapper = document.getElementById(&#x27;boardOuter&#x27;);
            wrapper.classList.remove(&#x27;shake&#x27;);
            void wrapper.offsetWidth;
            wrapper.classList.add(&#x27;shake&#x27;);
          }

          // Animate and clear tiles
          this.animateAndClearCells(fullRows, fullCols, totalLines);
        } else {
          // Reset combo if no line cleared
          this.combo = 0;
          this.updateComboUI();

          // Check if dock is empty to spawn next set, then verify Game Over
          this.afterTurnCheck();
        }
      }

      animateAndClearCells(fullRows, fullCols, totalLines) {
        const cellsToClear = new Set();

        fullRows.forEach(r =&gt; {
          for (let c = 0; c &lt; this.GRID_SIZE; c++) cellsToClear.add(`${r},${c}`);
        });

        fullCols.forEach(c =&gt; {
          for (let r = 0; r &lt; this.GRID_SIZE; r++) cellsToClear.add(`${r},${c}`);
        });

        // Add visual flash &amp; emit particles
        cellsToClear.forEach(coord =&gt; {
          const [r, c] = coord.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).map(Number);
          const cellEl = this.getCellElement(r, c);
          const cellData = this.board[r][c];

          cellEl.classList.add(&#x27;cell-clearing&#x27;);

          const rect = cellEl.getBoundingClientRect();
          const centerX = rect.left + rect.width / 2;
          const centerY = rect.top + rect.height / 2;
          const colorHex = cellData?.hex || &#x27;#a855f7&#x27;;

          this.particles.createBlast(centerX, centerY, colorHex, 10);
        });

        // Compute bonus score with combo multipliers
        const baseScore = totalLines * 100 * totalLines; // 100, 400, 900, 1600...
        const comboBonus = (this.combo - 1) * 60;
        const totalEarned = baseScore + comboBonus;

        this.addScore(totalEarned);
        this.updateComboUI();

        // Fanfare floating popup
        const boardRect = this.gameBoardEl.getBoundingClientRect();
        const popupText = this.getFanfareText(totalLines, this.combo);
        this.showFloatingText(popupText, boardRect.left + boardRect.width / 2, boardRect.top + boardRect.height / 2 - 20, &#x27;#fbbf24&#x27;, true);

        // Clear board data after animation duration
        setTimeout(() =&gt; {
          cellsToClear.forEach(coord =&gt; {
            const [r, c] = coord.split(&#x27;,&#x27;).map(Number);
            this.board[r][c] = null;
          });
          this.renderBoard();
          this.afterTurnCheck();
        }, 300);
      }

      afterTurnCheck() {
        this.spawnDockPieces();
        this.renderDock();
        this.checkGameOver();
      }

      getFanfareText(lines, combo) {
        if (combo &gt;= 4) return `UNSTOPPABLE! x${combo}`;
        if (lines &gt;= 4) return &#x27;BLAST MASTER! +1600&#x27;;
        if (lines === 3) return &#x27;AMAZING! +900&#x27;;
        if (lines === 2) return &#x27;GREAT! +400&#x27;;
        if (combo &gt; 1) return `COMBO x${combo}!`;
        return &#x27;+100&#x27;;
      }

      // --- Floating Feedback Banners ---
      showFloatingText(text, x, y, color = &#x27;#ffffff&#x27;, isBig = false) {
        const floatEl = document.createElement(&#x27;div&#x27;);
        floatEl.className = `floating-text ${isBig ? &#x27;text-2xl sm:text-3xl&#x27; : &#x27;text-lg&#x27;}`;
        floatEl.style.color = color;
        floatEl.style.left = `${x}px`;
        floatEl.style.top = `${y}px`;
        floatEl.textContent = text;
        document.body.appendChild(floatEl);

        setTimeout(() =&gt; floatEl.remove(), 850);
      }

      updateComboUI() {
        if (this.combo &gt; 1) {
          this.comboBanner.style.opacity = &#x27;1&#x27;;
          this.comboText.textContent = `Combo x${this.combo}`;
        } else {
          this.comboBanner.style.opacity = &#x27;0&#x27;;
        }
      }

      // --- Score Engine &amp; Rolling Numbers ---
      addScore(amount) {
        const startScore = this.score;
        this.score += amount;
        this.animateRollingScore(startScore, this.score);

        if (this.score &gt; this.highScore) {
          this.highScore = this.score;
          localStorage.setItem(&#x27;bb_high_score&#x27;, this.highScore.toString());
          this.highScoreDisplay.textContent = this.highScore.toLocaleString();
        }
      }

      animateRollingScore(start, target) {
        const duration = 400;
        const startTime = performance.now();

        const updateNumber = (currentTime) =&gt; {
          const elapsed = currentTime - startTime;
          const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
          // Ease out expo
          const current = Math.floor(start + (target - start) * (1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3)));
          this.scoreDisplay.textContent = current.toLocaleString();

          if (progress &lt; 1) {
            requestAnimationFrame(updateNumber);
          } else {
            this.scoreDisplay.textContent = target.toLocaleString();
          }
        };

        requestAnimationFrame(updateNumber);
      }

      updateScoreUI() {
        this.scoreDisplay.textContent = this.score.toLocaleString();
      }

      // --- Game Over Detection &amp; Modal ---
      checkGameOver() {
        const remainingPieces = this.dockPieces.filter(p =&gt; p !== null);
        if (remainingPieces.length === 0) return;

        // Check if ANY piece can fit in ANY board position
        const canAnyPieceFit = remainingPieces.some(piece =&gt; this.canPieceFitOnBoard(piece.matrix));

        if (!canAnyPieceFit) {
          sound.playGameOver();
          setTimeout(() =&gt; this.triggerGameOverModal(), 400);
        }
      }

      triggerGameOverModal() {
        document.getElementById(&#x27;finalScore&#x27;).textContent = this.score.toLocaleString();
        document.getElementById(&#x27;finalHighScore&#x27;).textContent = this.highScore.toLocaleString();
        document.getElementById(&#x27;finalMaxCombo&#x27;).textContent = `${this.maxCombo}x`;

        this.gameOverModal.classList.remove(&#x27;opacity-0&#x27;, &#x27;pointer-events-none&#x27;);
        this.gameOverModal.firstElementChild.classList.remove(&#x27;scale-95&#x27;);
        this.gameOverModal.firstElementChild.classList.add(&#x27;scale-100&#x27;);
      }

      hideGameOverModal() {
        this.gameOverModal.classList.add(&#x27;opacity-0&#x27;, &#x27;pointer-events-none&#x27;);
        this.gameOverModal.firstElementChild.classList.remove(&#x27;scale-100&#x27;);
        this.gameOverModal.firstElementChild.classList.add(&#x27;scale-95&#x27;);
      }

      restartGame() {
        this.hideGameOverModal();
        this.board = Array(8).fill(null).map(() =&gt; Array(8).fill(null));
        this.score = 0;
        this.combo = 0;
        this.maxCombo = 0;
        this.linesClearedTotal = 0;
        this.undoAvailable = 1;
        this.rerollAvailable = 1;
        this.historyState = null;

        this.updateScoreUI();
        this.linesCountEl.textContent = &#x27;0&#x27;;
        this.updatePowerupButtons();
        this.updateComboUI();
        this.renderBoard();
        this.spawnDockPieces(true);
      }

      // --- Event Listeners Binding ---
      attachGlobalEvents() {
        // Pointer / Touch drag events
        window.addEventListener(&#x27;pointermove&#x27;, (e) =&gt; this.handlePointerMove(e), { passive: false });
        window.addEventListener(&#x27;pointerup&#x27;, () =&gt; this.handlePointerUp());
        window.addEventListener(&#x27;pointercancel&#x27;, () =&gt; this.handlePointerUp());

        // Header and Utility Buttons
        document.getElementById(&#x27;restartBtn&#x27;).addEventListener(&#x27;click&#x27;, () =&gt; {
          this.restartGame();
          sound.playPlace();
        });

        document.getElementById(&#x27;modalRestartBtn&#x27;).addEventListener(&#x27;click&#x27;, () =&gt; {
          this.restartGame();
          sound.playPlace();
        });

        this.undoBtn.addEventListener(&#x27;click&#x27;, () =&gt; this.undoLastMove());
        this.rerollBtn.addEventListener(&#x27;click&#x27;, () =&gt; this.rerollDock());

        // Sound toggle
        const soundBtn = document.getElementById(&#x27;soundBtn&#x27;);
        const soundIcon = document.getElementById(&#x27;soundIcon&#x27;);
        soundBtn.addEventListener(&#x27;click&#x27;, () =&gt; {
          const isMuted = sound.toggleMute();
          soundIcon.setAttribute(&#x27;data-lucide&#x27;, isMuted ? &#x27;volume-x&#x27; : &#x27;volume-2&#x27;);
          lucide.createIcons();
        });
      }
    }

    // Initialize application on window load
    window.addEventListener(&#x27;load&#x27;, () =&gt; {
      window.game = new BlockBlastGame();
    });
  &lt;/script&gt;
&lt;/body&gt;
&lt;/html&gt;"></iframe>
</div>

<!-- Web Dashers Arcade Edition: self-contained browser runner, no linked game files -->
<div id="view-web-dashers" class="game-view hidden max-w-5xl mx-auto">
  <div class="rounded-3xl p-3 sm:p-5 space-y-4 border border-lime-500/40 shadow-2xl" style="background:linear-gradient(145deg,#101a31,#111532 60%,#102d3b)">
    <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center justify-between">
      <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
        <span class="flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-2xl w-12 h-12 font-bold" style="background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a3e635,#22d3ee);color:#111827">◆</span>
        <div>
          <h2 class="font-fredoka text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black" style="color:#b8fb45">WEB DASHERS <span class="text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-300">ARCADE EDITION</span></h2>
          <p class="text-xs text-slate-300">Levels 1–3 feature ship flight, levels 4–6 have extreme waves. Earn +1,500 tokens per official track, plus 1,000,000 for clearing the final level within 25 attempts!</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
        <button onclick="wdShowMenu()" class="bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 font-bold text-sm border border-slate-600">🏠 Levels</button>
        <button onclick="wdOpenEditor()" class="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 font-bold text-sm">✏️ Level Creator</button>
        <button onclick="wdPauseResume()" id="wd-pause" class="bg-sky-700 hover:bg-sky-600 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 font-bold text-sm">⏸ Pause</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="wd-levels-menu" class="space-y-3">
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h3 class="font-fredoka font-bold text-xl text-white">Choose a Level</h3>
          <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs">Six built-in tracks (+1,500 tokens for every full clear). Finish track 6 within 25 total attempts for a one-time +1,000,000-token bonus! Custom tracks remain for practice.</p>
        </div>
        <input id="wd-search" oninput="wdRenderLevels()" aria-label="Find a level" placeholder="🔎 Search levels..." class="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-600 text-white rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm w-56" />
      </div>
      <div id="wd-level-grid" class="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-3"></div>
    </div>
    <div id="wd-play-panel" class="hidden space-y-3">
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 text-sm font-bold">
        <span id="wd-level-title" class="font-fredoka text-lg text-lime-300">Level</span>
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3"><span id="wd-progress-text" class="text-cyan-200">0% complete</span><span id="wd-attempts" class="text-amber-300">Attempt 1</span><span id="wd-coins" class="text-yellow-300">★ 0</span></div>
      </div>
      <div id="wd-control-mode" class="text-center text-xs font-black tracking-widest text-cyan-300" aria-live="polite">CUBE MODE · Hold Space to chain jumps</div>
      <div class="rounded-full w-full h-2 overflow-hidden bg-slate-700"><div id="wd-progress-fill" class="h-full rounded-full" style="width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a3e635,#22d3ee)"></div></div>
      <div class="relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border-2 border-lime-500/50" style="background:#12264d">
        <canvas id="wd-canvas" width="900" height="430" tabindex="0" aria-label="Dashers game. Hold Space or Arrow Up to jump repeatedly. Ship mode: hold for upward thrust and release to descend. Wave mode: hold to rise and release to descend." style="width:100%;display:block;aspect-ratio:900/430;touch-action:manipulation;cursor:pointer"></canvas>
        <div id="wd-overlay" class="hidden absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center p-4" style="background:rgba(7,15,32,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)">
          <div class="max-w-md w-full text-center space-y-4">
            <div id="wd-overlay-icon" class="text-5xl">◆</div>
            <h3 id="wd-overlay-heading" class="font-fredoka text-3xl font-bold text-white">Try Again</h3>
            <p id="wd-overlay-copy" class="text-slate-200 text-sm"></p>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3">
              <button onclick="wdRestart()" id="wd-overlay-retry" class="bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300 text-slate-950 font-bold px-5 py-2 rounded-xl">↻ Retry</button>
              <button onclick="wdShowMenu()" class="bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 text-white font-bold px-5 py-2 rounded-xl">Choose Level</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-3">
        <p class="text-slate-300 text-xs sm:text-sm">Hold <strong>Space</strong>, <strong>↑</strong> or <strong>touch</strong> to auto-jump on rising platforms. In <strong>Ship Mode</strong>, hold to thrust upward and release to descend. In <strong>Wave Mode</strong>, hold to climb and release to dive. Press <strong>P</strong> to pause.</p>
        <button onclick="wdRestart()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-sm font-bold">↻ Restart Level</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="wd-editor-panel" class="hidden space-y-3">
      <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2 justify-between items-center">
        <h3 class="font-fredoka font-bold text-xl text-lime-300">Level Creator</h3>
        <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-2"><button onclick="wdEditorNew()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 text-sm font-bold">New Level</button><button onclick="wdEditorSave()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 text-sm font-bold">Save</button><button onclick="wdEditorPlay()" class="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-lime-400 hover:bg-lime-300 text-slate-950 text-sm font-bold">▶ Test Level</button></div>
      </div>
      <input id="wd-editor-name" maxlength="36" placeholder="Name your level" aria-label="Level title" class="bg-slate-900 border border-slate-600 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-white w-full text-sm" value="My Dash Level" />
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold" id="wd-editor-tools">
        <button data-tool="spike" onclick="wdTool('spike')" class="wd-tool bg-lime-600 text-slate-950 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">▲ Spike</button>
        <button data-tool="double" onclick="wdTool('double')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">▲▲ Double</button>
        <button data-tool="block" onclick="wdTool('block')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">■ Block</button>
        <button data-tool="coin" onclick="wdTool('coin')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">★ Coin</button>
        <button data-tool="pad" onclick="wdTool('pad')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">⇧ Jump Pad</button>
        <button data-tool="riser" onclick="wdTool('riser')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">⬆ Rising Block</button>
        <button data-tool="wave-in" onclick="wdTool('wave-in')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">◈ Wave Start</button>
        <button data-tool="ship-in" onclick="wdTool('ship-in')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">🚀 Ship Start</button>
        <button data-tool="gate" onclick="wdTool('gate')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">▥ Flight Gate</button>
        <button data-tool="wave-out" onclick="wdTool('wave-out')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">▣ Flight End</button>
        <button data-tool="erase" onclick="wdTool('erase')" class="wd-tool bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg">⌫ Erase</button>
      </div>
      <div class="rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-indigo-500/60 bg-slate-950"><canvas id="wd-editor-canvas" width="900" height="350" style="display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:900/350;touch-action:manipulation;cursor:crosshair" aria-label="Level creator. Click or tap to place objects"></canvas></div>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <div class="flex gap-2 items-center text-sm"><button onclick="wdMoveEditor(-1)" class="bg-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 font-bold">◀</button><span id="wd-editor-position" class="text-slate-200 text-xs">Course 1 / 5</span><button onclick="wdMoveEditor(1)" class="bg-slate-700 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 font-bold">▶</button></div>
        <span id="wd-editor-status" class="text-lime-300 text-xs">Tap the track to place objects. Save to keep your level.</span>
      </div>
      <details class="rounded-xl bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 p-3"><summary class="font-bold cursor-pointer text-sm text-slate-200">Import / Export Level Code</summary>
        <p class="text-slate-400 text-xs my-2">Share courses using JSON text. Online level search needs the original game's servers and isn't included.</p>
        <textarea id="wd-level-code" rows="3" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Level JSON appears here when you export, or paste one to import." class="bg-slate-950 text-slate-200 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg p-2 w-full text-xs"></textarea>
        <div class="flex gap-2 mt-2"><button onclick="wdExportLevel()" class="bg-indigo-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold">Export Code</button><button onclick="wdImportLevel()" class="bg-sky-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold">Import Code</button><button onclick="wdCopyLevel()" class="bg-slate-700 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold">Copy Code</button></div>
      </details>
    </div>
    <p class="text-xs text-slate-500">Offline arcade recreation. The uploaded Web Dashers HTML referenced separate source and art files that were not attached. This version has built-in levels and a local creator, but not the original online servers or level catalog.</p>
  </div>
</div>

                <style id="tf-ocean-styles">
                  #view-tiny-fishing {--tf-sky:#62def9;--tf-bright:#ffe072;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-shell {background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0b2440,#07192e 65%,#0d273c);border:1px solid #275879;border-radius:26px;padding:clamp(12px,2.2vw,22px);box-shadow:0 16px 42px #02081790}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-title {font-size:clamp(23px,3.7vw,32px);line-height:1.15;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:#f0fbff}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-head {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-stats {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-stat {background:#153c53;color:#effdff;border:1px solid #336a83;border-radius:13px;padding:7px 12px;font-weight:900;font-size:14px}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-stat strong {color:#ffe379;font-size:17px}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-objective {display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#113d55;border:1px solid #2a7691;color:#d9f8ff;border-radius:13px;padding:9px 14px;margin:10px 0;font-size:13px}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-objective strong {color:#ffe082}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-ocean-stage {position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:20px;border:2px solid #4693aa;box-shadow:inset 0 0 45px #06324a}
                  #view-tiny-fishing #tf-canvas {display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:800/430;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-under {display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:14px 0 6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-cast-btn {background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffec8a,#ffc344);color:#1b3346;border:0;border-bottom:4px solid #cc8733;border-radius:18px;padding:13px 30px;font-size:18px;min-width:210px;font-weight:950;box-shadow:0 5px 16px #0005;transition:transform .13s,filter .13s}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-cast-btn:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(1.07)}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-cast-btn:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(2px)}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-sub-btn {background:#173a55;color:#d8faff;border:1px solid #37758f;border-radius:14px;padding:11px 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-sub-btn:hover {background:#24516c}
                  #view-tiny-fishing #tf-status {min-height:23px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;color:#b9eafb;font-weight:700;padding:2px 4px}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-drawer {margin-top:9px;border:1px solid #28566e;background:#091d30;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;color:#d6ecf6}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-drawer summary {padding:11px 15px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;list-style-position:inside}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-drawer summary:hover {background:#13334e;color:#fef9c3}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-drawer[open] summary {border-bottom:1px solid #28566e}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-drawer-body {padding:12px}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-upgrade-grid {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-upgrade {background:#103b53;border:1px solid #2b7691;border-radius:14px;padding:12px 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;color:white;font-weight:800;min-height:86px;cursor:pointer}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-upgrade small {font-size:12px;color:#ffe28d}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-upgrade:hover:not(:disabled) {background:#195c7c;border-color:#7ee7ff}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-upgrade:disabled {opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-last-catch {font-size:13px;color:#c5e7f3;min-height:20px;margin-top:7px;text-align:center}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-species-pill {display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:4px 9px 4px 2px;border-radius:12px;background:#0a2941;color:#daf6ff;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;border:1px solid #205877}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-fishdex-card {padding:8px 5px;text-align:center;border:1px solid #285a73;background:#0b2b45;border-radius:12px;min-width:0}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-undiscovered {filter:saturate(.25);opacity:.6}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-undiscovered canvas {filter:brightness(.25)}
                  #view-tiny-fishing #tf-fishdex {display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(124px,1fr));gap:8px}
                  #view-tiny-fishing .tf-ribbon {display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;color:#88cbd9;font-size:11px;margin:7px 4px 0}
                  @media(max-width:530px){#view-tiny-fishing .tf-upgrade-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}#view-tiny-fishing .tf-upgrade{min-height:52px;flex-direction:row;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px}#view-tiny-fishing .tf-cast-btn{flex:1;min-width:170px}#view-tiny-fishing .tf-stat{padding:6px 9px;font-size:12px}#view-tiny-fishing .tf-shell{border-radius:16px}#view-tiny-fishing .tf-objective{font-size:12px;padding:7px 10px}}
                  @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#view-tiny-fishing *{transition:none!important}}
                </style>
                <div id="view-tiny-fishing" class="game-view hidden max-w-5xl mx-auto">
                  <div class="tf-shell">
                    <div class="tf-head">
                      <div><h3 class="tf-title">🎣 Tiny Fishing <span style="color:#68dfed">Adventure</span></h3><p style="font-size:12px;color:#9dc5d5;margin-top:4px">Little hooks. Big discoveries.</p></div>
                      <div class="tf-stats"><span class="tf-stat">💰 <strong>$<span id="tf-cash">0</span></strong></span><span class="tf-stat">🐟 <span id="tf-species-count">0</span>/<span id="tf-species-total">27</span></span></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tf-objective"><span>⭐ <span id="tf-mission-text">Catch your first fish!</span></span><strong id="tf-mission-reward">+$50</strong></div>
                    <div class="tf-ocean-stage">
                      <canvas id="tf-canvas" width="800" height="430" aria-label="Fishing game. Follow the fish with your pointer, finger, or arrow keys while reeling the hook upward."></canvas>
                      <div style="position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px;background:#08283d;pointer-events:none"><div id="tf-depth-progress" style="height:4px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#67e8f9,#fde68a);width:0%;transition:width .1s linear"></div></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="tf-under">
                      <button id="tf-cast" onclick="tinyFishingCast()" class="tf-cast-btn">🎣 CAST!</button>
                      <button id="tf-sound" onclick="tfToggleSound()" class="tf-sub-btn" aria-pressed="false" title="Toggle game sounds">🔇 Sound off</button>
                    </div>
                    <p id="tf-status" aria-live="polite">Tap CAST, then steer through the fish as you reel up!</p>
                    <div class="tf-last-catch" id="tf-catch-banner">✨ Find a golden fish for a big bonus!</div>
                    <div class="tf-ribbon"><span>🌊 <span id="tf-zone-label">Sunlit Reef</span> · <span id="tf-depth-meter">285</span> m reach</span><span>🏆 Best catch $<span id="tf-best">0</span></span></div>
                    <details class="tf-drawer" id="tf-shop"><summary>⚙️ Gear Shop <span id="tf-shop-hint" style="font-size:11px;color:#ffdc84;font-weight:600;margin-left:7px">Upgrade your fishing line</span></summary>
                      <div class="tf-drawer-body"><div class="tf-upgrade-grid">
                        <button data-tf-upgrade="depth" onclick="tinyFishingUpgrade('depth')" class="tf-upgrade"><span>🌊 Deeper Water · Lv <span id="tf-depth">1</span></span><small>$<span id="tf-depth-price">60</span></small></button>
                        <button data-tf-upgrade="capacity" onclick="tinyFishingUpgrade('capacity')" class="tf-upgrade"><span>🪝 More Hooks · <span id="tf-capacity">3</span> fish</span><small>$<span id="tf-capacity-price">50</span></small></button>
                        <button data-tf-upgrade="value" onclick="tinyFishingUpgrade('value')" class="tf-upgrade"><span>💎 Better Value · <span id="tf-value">1</span>×</span><small>$<span id="tf-value-price">75</span></small></button>
                      </div><p style="font-size:12px;color:#8bb3c7;margin-top:10px">Go deeper for giant species. Bigger hooks carry more fish. Better value earns more per catch.</p></div>
                    </details>
                    <details class="tf-drawer" id="tf-catches"><summary>🐠 Last Catch <span style="font-size:11px;color:#86b5cc;font-weight:600;margin-left:6px">See your fish</span></summary>
                      <div class="tf-drawer-body"><div id="tf-last-haul" style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px"><span>Catch fish to fill your basket.</span></div></div>
                    </details>
                    <details class="tf-drawer" id="tf-collection"><summary>📖 Fishdex <span style="font-size:11px;color:#86b5cc;font-weight:600;margin-left:6px">Collect 27 real species</span></summary>
                      <div class="tf-drawer-body"><div id="tf-fishdex"></div></div>
                    </details>
                    <span hidden id="tf-tokens">0</span><span hidden id="tf-gear-label">3 fish / cast</span><span hidden id="tf-haul-count">0</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 1. DON'T LOOK DOWN VIEW -->
                <div id="view-dl-down" class="game-view hidden">
                    <div id="game-container">
                        <canvas id="gameCanvas" width="800" height="550"></canvas>
                        <div class="hud">
                            <div class="hud-card">
                                <div>Energy</div>
                                <div class="energy-bar-container">
                                    <div id="energy-bar" class="energy-bar"></div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                            <div class="hud-card">Height: <span id="height-val">0</span>m</div>
                            <div class="hud-card">Tokens Added to Main: <span id="coin-val">0</span> 🪙</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="controls-tip">A / D or ← / →: Move | Space / W: Jump</div>
                        <button id="quiz-btn" onclick="openQuiz('dl-down')">Earn Energy ⚡</button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- 2. GOLD QUEST VIEW -->
                <div id="view-gold-quest" class="game-view hidden max-w-2xl mx-auto bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 rounded-3xl p-6 text-center space-y-6">
                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-4">
                        <span class="font-fredoka font-bold text-slate-400">Round: <span id="gq-round" class="text-white">1</span>/10</span>
                        <span class="font-fredoka font-bold text-amber-400 text-xl">Gold Looted: <span id="gq-gold">0</span> 🪙</span>
                    </div>

                    <div id="gq-question-box" class="space-y-4">
                        <h3 id="gq-question-text" class="font-fredoka text-xl text-white">Question...</h3>
                        <div id="gq-options" class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 max-w-md mx-auto"></div>

                    <div id="gq-chest-box" class="hidden space-y-4">

                        <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                            <button onclick="openChest(0)" class="p-6 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-amber-500/50 rounded-2xl text-5xl transition-all transform hover:scale-105">📦</button>
                            <button onclick="openChest(1)" class="p-6 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-amber-500/50 rounded-2xl text-5xl transition-all transform hover:scale-105">📦</button>
                            <button onclick="openChest(2)" class="p-6 bg-slate-950 hover:bg-slate-800 border-2 border-amber-500/50 rounded-2xl text-5xl transition-all transform hover:scale-105">📦</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                        <span class="font-fredoka font-bold text-slate-400">Round: <span id="ch-round" class="text-white">1</span>/10</span>
                        <span class="font-fredoka font-bold text-cyan-400 text-xl">Crypto Stolen: <span id="ch-crypto">0</span> ⚡</span>
                    </div>

                    <div id="ch-question-box" class="space-y-4">
                        <h3 id="ch-question-text" class="font-fredoka text-xl text-white">Question...</h3>
                        <div id="ch-options" class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 max-w-md mx-auto"></div>

                    <div id="ch-hack-box" class="hidden space-y-4">

                    </div>
                </div>
