            const icon = document.getElementById("header-toggle-icon");
            const text = document.getElementById("header-toggle-text");

            if (stats.classList.contains("hidden")) {
                stats.classList.remove("hidden");
                if (subtitle) subtitle.classList.remove("hidden");
                icon.className = "fa-solid fa-chevron-up text-xs";
                text.innerText = "Collapse";
            } else {
                stats.classList.add("hidden");
                if (subtitle) subtitle.classList.add("hidden");
                icon.className = "fa-solid fa-chevron-down text-xs";
                text.innerText = "Expand";
            }
        }

        let ALL_BLOOKS = [];

        PACK_DEFINITIONS.forEach((pack) => {

                "Common", "Common", "Common", "Common", "Common", "Common", "Common", "Common",

            ];

            if (pack.id === 50) rarityDistribution.push("Supreme");
            else if (pack.id % 2 === 0) rarityDistribution.push("Chroma");
            else rarityDistribution.push("Mystical");

            for (let i = 1; i <= 20; i++) {
                const rarity = rarityDistribution[i - 1];
                const blookId = blookCounter++;

                if (blookId === 1000 || (pack.id === 50 && i === 20)) {
                    ALL_BLOOKS.push({ id: 1000, name: "Aidan Ali Chunara", packId: 50, packName: pack.name, rarity: "Supreme", emoji: "👑✨", dropChance: 0.001, sellValue: 500000, isSupreme: true });
                    ALL_BLOOKS.push({ id: 1001, name: "Maxim", packId: 50, packName: pack.name, rarity: "Supreme", emoji: "👑✨", dropChance: 0.001, sellValue: 500000, isSupreme: true });
                } else {
                    const emoji = EMOJI_POOL[(pack.id + i) % EMOJI_POOL.length];
                    ALL_BLOOKS.push({
                        id: blookId,
                        name: `${pack.name} ${rarity} #${i}`,
                        packId: pack.id,
                        packName: pack.name,
                        rarity: rarity,
                        emoji: emoji,
                        dropChance: RARITIES[rarity].dropChance,
                        sellValue: RARITIES[rarity].sellValue,
                        isSupreme: false
                    });
                }
            }
        });

        let gameState = {
            tokens: 5000,
            inventory: {},
            lastSpinTimestamp: null,
            soundEnabled: true,
            lastPlayTimestamps: { 'gold-quest': null, 'crypto-hack': null, 'cookie-clicker': null }
        };

        let audioCtx = null;
        function initAudio() {
            if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        }

        function playSound(type) {
            if (!gameState.soundEnabled) return;
            try {
                initAudio();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                const now = audioCtx.currentTime;

                if (type === 'click') {
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(400, now);
                    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(100, now + 0.08);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, now);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.08);
                    osc.start(now);
                    osc.stop(now + 0.08);
                } else if (type === 'pullNormal') {
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(300, now);
                    osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(600, now + 0.2);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, now);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.2);
                    osc.start(now);
                    osc.stop(now + 0.2);
                } else if (type === 'pullRare') {
                    osc.type = 'triangle';
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(523.25, now);
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(659.25, now + 0.1);
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(783.99, now + 0.2);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.3, now);
                    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.01, now + 0.35);
                    osc.start(now);
                    osc.stop(now + 0.35);
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        function loadState() {
            const saved = localStorage.getItem("blooket_sim_1k_v1");
            if (saved) {
                try {
                    const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
                    gameState = { ...gameState, ...parsed };
                    gameState.tokens = Number(gameState.tokens) || 0;
                    if (!gameState.lastPlayTimestamps) {
                        gameState.lastPlayTimestamps = { 'gold-quest': null, 'crypto-hack': null, 'cookie-clicker': null };
                    }
                } catch (e) {}
            }
            updateGlobalHeader();
            updateArcadeHubUI();
        }

        function saveState() {
            updateGlobalHeader();
            updateArcadeHubUI();
            try {
                localStorage.setItem("blooket_sim_1k_v1", JSON.stringify(gameState));
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        setInterval(() => saveState(), 3000);

        function updateGlobalHeader() {
            const tokenEl = document.getElementById("stat-tokens");
            if (tokenEl) tokenEl.innerText = Math.floor(Number(gameState.tokens) || 0).toLocaleString();
            const unlockedCount = Object.keys(gameState.inventory).filter(id => gameState.inventory[id] > 0).length;
            const unlockEl = document.getElementById("stat-unlocked");
            if (unlockEl) unlockEl.innerText = unlockedCount;
            const pctEl = document.getElementById("stat-percent");
            if (pctEl) pctEl.innerText = `(${((unlockedCount / ALL_BLOOKS.length) * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`;

            const soundBtn = document.getElementById("toggle-sound-btn");
            if (soundBtn) {
                soundBtn.innerText = gameState.soundEnabled ? "🔊 ON" : "🔇 OFF";
                soundBtn.className = gameState.soundEnabled 
                    ? "px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-fredoka font-bold bg-purple-600 text-white"
                    : "px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-fredoka font-bold bg-slate-800 text-slate-400";
            }
        }

        function updateArcadeHubUI() {
            arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
        }

        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            const container = document.getElementById("toast-container");
            const toast = document.createElement("div");
            toast.className = `px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl font-fredoka font-bold text-sm shadow-xl flex items-center gap-2 border transition-all duration-300 pointer-events-auto transform translate-y-2 opacity-0 ${
                type === 'success' ? 'bg-emerald-900 border-emerald-500 text-emerald-200' :
                type === 'error' ? 'bg-red-900 border-red-500 text-red-200' :
                'bg-slate-800 border-slate-700 text-white'
            }`;
            toast.innerHTML = message;
            container.appendChild(toast);

            setTimeout(() => toast.classList.remove('translate-y-2', 'opacity-0'), 10);
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.add('opacity-0', 'translate-y-2');
                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);
            }, 3000);
        }

        function switchTab(tabId) {
            if (currentGameMode && tabId !== 'minigame') returnToGameHub();
            playSound('click');
            activeTab = tabId;
            document.querySelectorAll('main > section').forEach(sec => sec.classList.add('hidden'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.nav-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.className = "nav-btn flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-fredoka font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all duration-200 border-b-4 border-slate-800 bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-700";
            });

            document.getElementById(`tab-${tabId}`).classList.remove('hidden');
            const activeNav = document.getElementById(`nav-${tabId}`);
            if (activeNav) {
                activeNav.className = "nav-btn active flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-fredoka font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm transition-all duration-200 border-b-4 border-purple-800 bg-purple-600 text-white shadow-lg";
            }

            if (tabId === 'shop') renderShop();
            if (tabId === 'inventory') renderInventory();
            if (tabId === 'wheel') initWheel();
            if (tabId === 'minigame') updateArcadeHubUI();
        }

        function renderShop() {
            const container = document.getElementById("packs-container");
            const search = document.getElementById("shop-search").value.toLowerCase();
            container.innerHTML = "";

            PACK_DEFINITIONS.forEach(pack => {
                if (search && !pack.name.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return;
                const packBlooks = ALL_BLOOKS.filter(b => b.packId === pack.id);
                const unlockedInPack = packBlooks.filter(b => gameState.inventory[b.id] > 0).length;

                const card = document.createElement("div");
                card.className = "bg-slate-900 border border-slate-800 hover:border-purple-500/50 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 shadow-lg group";
                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="space-y-3">
                        <div class="h-28 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br ${pack.color} flex items-center justify-center text-5xl shadow-inner relative overflow-hidden group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform">
                            <span>${pack.icon}</span>
                            <span class="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-slate-950/80 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-300">
                                ${unlockedInPack}/${packBlooks.length}
                            </span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <h3 class="font-fredoka font-bold text-lg text-white group-hover:text-purple-300 transition-colors">${pack.name} Pack</h3>
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-fredoka font-bold text-amber-400 text-sm">
                                <span>🪙</span> ${pack.cost.toLocaleString()} Tokens
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800">
                        <button onclick="triggerPackOpen(${pack.id}, 1)" class="px-2 py-1.5 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 border-b-2 border-purple-800 rounded-lg font-fredoka text-xs font-bold text-white transition-all active:translate-y-0.5">1x</button>
                        <button onclick="triggerPackOpen(${pack.id}, 5)" class="px-2 py-1.5 bg-purple-700 hover:bg-purple-600 border-b-2 border-purple-900 rounded-lg font-fredoka text-xs font-bold text-white transition-all active:translate-y-0.5">5x</button>
                        <button onclick="triggerPackOpen(${pack.id}, 10)" class="px-2 py-1.5 bg-purple-800 hover:bg-purple-700 border-b-2 border-purple-950 rounded-lg font-fredoka text-xs font-bold text-white transition-all active:translate-y-0.5">10x</button>
                    </div>
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function triggerPackOpen(packId, count) {
            const pack = PACK_DEFINITIONS.find(p => p.id === packId);
            if (!pack) return;
            const totalCost = pack.cost * count;

            const currentTokens = Number(gameState.tokens) || 0;
            if (currentTokens < totalCost) {
                showToast(`⚠ You need 🪙 ${totalCost.toLocaleString()} tokens!`, 'error');
                return;
            }

            gameState.tokens = Math.max(0, currentTokens - totalCost);
            saveState();
            updateGlobalHeader();
            playSound('click');

            const packBlooks = ALL_BLOOKS.filter(b => b.packId === packId);
            let results = [];

            for (let c = 0; c < count; c++) {
                const roll = Math.random() * 100;
                let rarity = 'Common';
                if (roll < 0.001) rarity = 'Supreme';
                else if (roll < 0.5) rarity = 'Mystical';
                else if (roll < 1.5) rarity = 'Chroma';
                else if (roll < 6.0) rarity = 'Legendary';
                else if (roll < 15.0) rarity = 'Epic';
                else if (roll < 30.0) rarity = 'Rare';
                else if (roll < 55.0) rarity = 'Uncommon';

                let candidateBlooks = packBlooks.filter(b => b.rarity === rarity);
                if (candidateBlooks.length === 0) candidateBlooks = packBlooks;

                const pulled = candidateBlooks[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidateBlooks.length)];
                gameState.inventory[pulled.id] = (gameState.inventory[pulled.id] || 0) + 1;
                results.push(pulled);
            }

            saveState();
            showPackOpenModal(pack, results, count);
        }

        function showPackOpenModal(pack, results, count) {
            const modal = document.getElementById("modal-pack-open");
            const display = document.getElementById("pack-cards-display");
            document.getElementById("pack-open-title").innerText = `${pack.name} Pack (${count}x)`;
            document.getElementById("pack-open-subtitle").innerText = `Opened for 🪙 ${(pack.cost * count).toLocaleString()} tokens!`;
            display.innerHTML = "";

            document.getElementById("pack-again-btn").onclick = () => {
                closeModal('modal-pack-open');
                triggerPackOpen(pack.id, count);
            };

            let pulledSupremeBlook = null;
            results.forEach((blook) => {
                if (blook.isSupreme) pulledSupremeBlook = blook;
                const cardWrapper = document.createElement("div");
                cardWrapper.className = `w-32 h-44 sm:w-36 sm:h-48 rounded-2xl p-3 flex flex-col items-center justify-between border-2 text-center transition-all ${
                    blook.isSupreme ? 'aidan-card' : 'bg-slate-950 border-slate-700 glow-' + blook.rarity.toLowerCase()
                }`;

                const rarityMeta = RARITIES[blook.rarity] || RARITIES.Common;
                cardWrapper.innerHTML = `
                    <span class="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold ${rarityMeta.color}">${blook.rarity}</span>
                    <div class="text-4xl my-auto">${blook.emoji}</div>
                    <div class="w-full">
                        <div class="font-fredoka font-bold text-xs truncate text-white">${blook.name}</div>
                        <div class="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-semibold">x${gameState.inventory[blook.id]} owned</div>
                    </div>
                `;
                display.appendChild(cardWrapper);
            });

            modal.classList.remove("hidden");
            if (pulledSupremeBlook) {
                const modalName = document.getElementById("aidan-modal-name");
                if (modalName) modalName.innerText = pulledSupremeBlook.name;
                confetti({ particleCount: 200, spread: 100, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
                setTimeout(() => document.getElementById("modal-aidan").classList.remove("hidden"), 600);
            } else if (results.some(r => ['Legendary', 'Chroma', 'Mystical'].includes(r.rarity))) {
                playSound('pullRare');
                confetti({ particleCount: 70, spread: 60, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
            } else {
                playSound('pullNormal');
            }
        }

        function renderInventory() {
            const container = document.getElementById("inventory-container");
            const packSelect = document.getElementById("inv-filter-pack");
            const raritySelect = document.getElementById("inv-filter-rarity");
            const hideLocked = document.getElementById("inv-hide-locked").checked;
            const search = document.getElementById("inv-search").value.toLowerCase();
            
            if (packSelect.options.length <= 1) {
                PACK_DEFINITIONS.forEach(p => {
                    const opt = document.createElement("option");
                    opt.value = p.id;
                    opt.innerText = p.name;
                    packSelect.appendChild(opt);
                });
            }

            const filterPackId = packSelect.value;
            const filterRarity = raritySelect.value;

            const filtered = ALL_BLOOKS.filter(blook => {
                const count = gameState.inventory[blook.id] || 0;
                if (hideLocked && count === 0) return false;
                if (filterPackId !== 'ALL' && blook.packId != filterPackId) return false;
                if (filterRarity !== 'ALL' && blook.rarity !== filterRarity) return false;
                if (search && !blook.name.toLowerCase().includes(search)) return false;
                return true;
            });

            let totalDuplicateValue = 0;
            ALL_BLOOKS.forEach(blook => {
                const count = gameState.inventory[blook.id] || 0;
                if (count > 1) totalDuplicateValue += (count - 1) * blook.sellValue;
            });
            document.getElementById("sell-all-val").innerText = totalDuplicateValue.toLocaleString();

            container.innerHTML = "";
            if (filtered.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `<div class="col-span-full py-12 text-center text-slate-500 font-fredoka text-lg">No Blooks match filters!</div>`;
                return;
            }

            filtered.forEach(blook => {
                const count = gameState.inventory[blook.id] || 0;
                const isLocked = count === 0;
                const rarityMeta = RARITIES[blook.rarity] || RARITIES.Common;

                const card = document.createElement("div");
                card.className = `relative rounded-2xl p-3 flex flex-col items-center justify-between border-2 text-center transition-all ${
                    isLocked ? 'bg-slate-900/40 border-slate-800 opacity-40 grayscale' :
                    blook.isSupreme ? 'aidan-card' : 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-800'
                }`;

                card.innerHTML = `
                    ${count > 1 ? `<span class="absolute top-2 right-2 bg-purple-600 text-white font-fredoka font-bold text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full shadow">x${count}</span>` : ''}
                    <span class="text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold ${rarityMeta.color} mb-1">${blook.rarity}</span>
                    <div class="text-3xl my-2">${isLocked ? '❓' : blook.emoji}</div>
                    <div class="w-full">
                        <div class="font-fredoka font-bold text-xs truncate text-white">${isLocked ? 'Locked' : blook.name}</div>
                        <div class="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-semibold truncate">${blook.packName} Pack</div>
                    </div>
                    ${!isLocked && count > 1 ? `
                        <button onclick="sellDuplicate(${blook.id})" class="mt-2 w-full py-1 bg-emerald-600/80 hover:bg-emerald-500 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-fredoka font-bold text-white transition-all">
                            Sell 1 (+🪙${blook.sellValue})
                        </button>
                    ` : ''}
                `;
                container.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function sellDuplicate(blookId) {
            const count = gameState.inventory[blookId] || 0;
            if (count <= 1) return;
            const blook = ALL_BLOOKS.find(b => b.id === blookId);
            gameState.inventory[blookId]--;
            gameState.tokens = (Number(gameState.tokens) || 0) + blook.sellValue;
            saveState();
            playSound('click');
            showToast(`🪙 Sold duplicate of <strong>${blook.name}</strong>!`, 'success');
            renderInventory();
        }

        function sellAllDuplicates() {
            let totalTokensEarned = 0;
            let totalSold = 0;

            ALL_BLOOKS.forEach(blook => {
                const count = gameState.inventory[blook.id] || 0;
                if (count > 1) {
                    const extra = count - 1;
                    totalTokensEarned += extra * blook.sellValue;
                    totalSold += extra;
                    gameState.inventory[blook.id] = 1;
                }
            });

            if (totalSold === 0) {
                showToast("ℹ️ No duplicate Blooks available!", 'info');
                return;
            }

            gameState.tokens = (Number(gameState.tokens) || 0) + totalTokensEarned;
            saveState();
            playSound('click');
            showToast(`🎉 Sold ${totalSold} duplicates for +🪙 ${totalTokensEarned.toLocaleString()} tokens!`, 'success');
            renderInventory();
        }

        // HOURLY WHEEL
        const WHEEL_REWARDS = [1000, 2500, 5000, 10000, 25000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000, 1000000];
        const WHEEL_COLORS = ["#ef4444", "#3b82f6", "#10b981", "#f59e0b", "#8b5cf6", "#ec4899", "#06b6d4", "#eab308", "#6366f1", "#f43f5e"];
        let isSpinning = false;

        function initWheel() {
            const canvas = document.getElementById("wheel-canvas");
            const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
            const sliceAngle = (2 * Math.PI) / WHEEL_REWARDS.length;

            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 320, 320);

            for (let i = 0; i < WHEEL_REWARDS.length; i++) {
                const angle = i * sliceAngle;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.fillStyle = WHEEL_COLORS[i % WHEEL_COLORS.length];
                ctx.moveTo(160, 160);
                ctx.arc(160, 160, 155, angle, angle + sliceAngle);
                ctx.lineTo(160, 160);
                ctx.fill();

                ctx.save();
                ctx.translate(160, 160);
                ctx.rotate(angle + sliceAngle / 2);
                ctx.fillStyle = "white";
                ctx.font = "bold 13px Nunito, sans-serif";
                ctx.textAlign = "right";
                ctx.fillText(WHEEL_REWARDS[i] >= 1000000 ? '1M 🪙' : (WHEEL_REWARDS[i] / 1000) + 'K 🪙', 140, 4);
                ctx.restore();
            }

            checkWheelCooldown();
        }

        function checkWheelCooldown() {
            const spinBtn = document.getElementById("spin-btn");
            const statusText = document.getElementById("wheel-status-text");
            const now = Date.now();
            const oneHour = 60 * 60 * 1000;

            if (gameState.lastSpinTimestamp && (now - gameState.lastSpinTimestamp < oneHour)) {
                const remainingMs = oneHour - (now - gameState.lastSpinTimestamp);
                const mins = Math.floor(remainingMs / (1000 * 60));
                const secs = Math.floor((remainingMs % (1000 * 60)) / 1000);
                spinBtn.disabled = true;
                statusText.innerText = `⏳ Hourly spin available in ${mins}m${secs}s`;
            } else {
                spinBtn.disabled = false;
                statusText.innerText = "✨ Wheel is Ready to Spin!";
            }
        }

        function spinWheel() {
            if (isSpinning) return;
            isSpinning = true;
            document.getElementById("spin-btn").disabled = true;

            const canvas = document.getElementById("wheel-canvas");
            const winningIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * WHEEL_REWARDS.length);
            const reward = WHEEL_REWARDS[winningIndex];

            const sliceAngle = 360 / WHEEL_REWARDS.length;
            const targetRotation = (360 * 8) + (360 - (winningIndex * sliceAngle) - (sliceAngle / 2));
            canvas.style.transform = `rotate(${targetRotation}deg)`;

            setTimeout(() => {
                isSpinning = false;
                transferGamePoints(reward);
                gameState.lastSpinTimestamp = Date.now();
                saveState();
                checkWheelCooldown();
                confetti({ particleCount: 100, spread: 80, origin: { y: 0.6 } });
                canvas.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)';
            }, 4000);
        }

        // Other arcade games keep their 15m active-play / 45m renewal settings.
        // Don't Look Down is unlimited. The two ten-question earning modes use
        // a completion-based 45m cooldown, not an active-play timer.
        const ARCADE_PLAY_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;
        const ARCADE_RESET_MS = 45 * 60 * 1000;
        const ARCADE_LIMITS_KEY = 'blooket_arcade_limits_15m_45m_v1';
        const UNTIMED_ARCADE_GAMES = new Set(['dl-down', 'gold-quest', 'crypto-hack']);
        const QUIZ_COOLDOWN_MS = 45 * 60 * 1000;
        const QUIZ_PROGRESS_KEY = 'blooket_arcade_ten_question_cooldowns_v1';
        let quizProgress = {};
        try {
            const stored = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(QUIZ_PROGRESS_KEY) || '{}');
            if (stored && typeof stored === 'object' && !Array.isArray(stored)) quizProgress = stored;
        } catch (e) { quizProgress = {}; }

        function arcadeSaveQuizProgress() {
            try { localStorage.setItem(QUIZ_PROGRESS_KEY, JSON.stringify(quizProgress)); }
            catch (e) { /* Offline / private storage fallback */ }
        }
        function arcadeQuizRecord(id, now = Date.now()) {
            if (id !== 'gold-quest' && id !== 'crypto-hack') return null;
            let rec = quizProgress[id];
            if (!rec || typeof rec !== 'object') rec = {round: 1, earned: 0, lockedUntil: 0};
            if (Number(rec.lockedUntil) > 0 && now >= Number(rec.lockedUntil)) {
                rec = {round: 1, earned: 0, lockedUntil: 0};
            }
            rec.round = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.floor(Number(rec.round) || 1)));
            rec.earned = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(rec.earned) || 0));
            rec.lockedUntil = Math.max(0, Number(rec.lockedUntil) || 0);
            quizProgress[id] = rec;
            return rec;
        }
        function arcadeSaveQuizRound(id, round, earned) {
            const rec = arcadeQuizRecord(id);
            if (!rec || rec.lockedUntil > Date.now()) return;
            rec.round = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, round));
            rec.earned = Math.max(0, Math.floor(earned));
            arcadeSaveQuizProgress();
        }
        function arcadeFinishTenQuestions(id, earned) {
            const rec = arcadeQuizRecord(id);
            rec.round = 1;
            rec.earned = 0;
            rec.lockedUntil = Date.now() + QUIZ_COOLDOWN_MS;
            arcadeSaveQuizProgress();
            returnToGameHub();
            arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
            showToast(`🏆 ${ARCADE_GAME_NAMES[id]} complete! ${earned.toLocaleString()} tokens earned. Play again in 45 minutes.`, 'success');
        }

        const ARCADE_GAMES = [
            'dl-down', 'gold-quest', 'crypto-hack', 'crystal-spire',
            'tiny-fishing', 'block-blast', 'web-dashers', 'mini-soccer', 'cookie-clicker'
        ];
        const ARCADE_GAME_NAMES = {
            'dl-down': 'Don\'t Look Down',
            'gold-quest': 'Gold Quest',
            'crypto-hack': 'Crypto Hack',
            'crystal-spire': 'Crystal Spire Arcana',
            'tiny-fishing': 'Tiny Fishing',
            'web-dashers': 'Web Dashers Arcade Edition',
            'block-blast': 'Block Blast Deluxe',
            'mini-soccer': 'Super Penalty Shootout',
            'cookie-clicker': 'Cookie Clicker: Deluxe'
        };
        const ARCADE_BUTTON_LABELS = {
            'gold-quest': 'PLAY GOLD QUEST 🪙',
            'crypto-hack': 'PLAY CRYPTO HACK ⚡',
            'cookie-clicker': 'PLAY GAME 🍪'
        };

        let currentGameMode = null;
        let arcadeLastTick = null;
        let arcadeGameLimits = {};
        try {
            const raw = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(ARCADE_LIMITS_KEY) || '{}');
            if (raw && typeof raw === 'object' && !Array.isArray(raw)) {
                for (const id of ARCADE_GAMES) {
                    const rec = raw[id];
                    if (rec && Number.isFinite(rec.windowStart) && Number.isFinite(rec.usedMs)
                            && rec.windowStart > 0 && rec.usedMs >= 0) {
                        arcadeGameLimits[id] = {windowStart: rec.windowStart,
                            usedMs: Math.min(ARCADE_PLAY_MS, rec.usedMs)};
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e) { /* Empty or damaged save starts fresh */ }

        function arcadePersist() {
            try { localStorage.setItem(ARCADE_LIMITS_KEY, JSON.stringify(arcadeGameLimits)); }
            catch (e) { /* Private browsing might disallow storage */ }
        }

        function arcadeRecord(gameId, now = Date.now(), create = false) {
            let record = arcadeGameLimits[gameId];
            if (record && (now >= record.windowStart + ARCADE_RESET_MS || now < record.windowStart)) {
                if (now < record.windowStart) {
                    record = null; // Device time changed backwards; start a fresh cycle.
                } else {
                    const cycles = Math.floor((now - record.windowStart) / ARCADE_RESET_MS);
                    record = { windowStart: record.windowStart + cycles * ARCADE_RESET_MS, usedMs: 0 };
                }
                if (record) arcadeGameLimits[gameId] = record;
                else delete arcadeGameLimits[gameId];
                arcadePersist();
            }
            if (!record && create) {
                record = { windowStart: now, usedMs: 0 };
                arcadeGameLimits[gameId] = record;
                arcadePersist();
            }
            return record || null;
        }

        function arcadeRemaining(gameId, now = Date.now()) {
            if (UNTIMED_ARCADE_GAMES.has(gameId)) return Infinity;
            const record = arcadeRecord(gameId, now);
            return record ? Math.max(0, ARCADE_PLAY_MS - record.usedMs) : ARCADE_PLAY_MS;
        }

        function arcadeClock(ms) {
            const seconds = Math.ceil(Math.max(0, ms) / 1000);
            return `${String(Math.floor(seconds / 60)).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2, '0')}`;
        }

        function arcadeConsumeTime(now = Date.now()) {
            if (!currentGameMode || UNTIMED_ARCADE_GAMES.has(currentGameMode) || arcadeLastTick === null) return;
            const record = arcadeRecord(currentGameMode, now, true);
            // If 45 minutes elapsed during a tick, charge only time in the new window.
            const since = Math.max(arcadeLastTick, record.windowStart);
            const elapsed = Math.max(0, now - since);
            if (elapsed > 0) {
                record.usedMs = Math.min(ARCADE_PLAY_MS, record.usedMs + elapsed);
                arcadePersist();
            }
            arcadeLastTick = now;
        }

        function arcadeUpdateGameTimers() {
            const now = Date.now();
            for (const gameId of ARCADE_GAMES) {
                let label, locked = false, untilReset = 0;
                if (gameId === 'dl-down') {
                    label = '∞ Unlimited play • Earned tokens transfer to Main Balance';
                } else if (gameId === 'gold-quest' || gameId === 'crypto-hack') {
                    const rec = arcadeQuizRecord(gameId, now);
                    untilReset = Math.max(0, rec.lockedUntil - now);
                    locked = untilReset > 0;
                    label = locked ? `🔒 Finished 10 questions • Ready in ${arcadeClock(untilReset)}`
                        : `${11 - rec.round} questions left • 45m cooldown after question 10`;
                } else {
                    const record = arcadeRecord(gameId, now);
                    const remaining = record ? Math.max(0, ARCADE_PLAY_MS - record.usedMs) : ARCADE_PLAY_MS;
                    untilReset = record ? Math.max(0, record.windowStart + ARCADE_RESET_MS - now) : 0;
                    locked = remaining <= 0;
                    label = !record ? '15:00 available • 45m refresh begins when you play'
                        : locked ? `🔒 Time used up • Resets in ${arcadeClock(untilReset)}`
                        : `${arcadeClock(remaining)} of 15:00 left • Resets in ${arcadeClock(untilReset)}`;
                }
                const timeLabel = document.querySelector(`[data-arcade-time="${gameId}"]`);
                if (timeLabel) {
                    timeLabel.textContent = label;
                    timeLabel.classList.toggle('text-rose-300', locked);
                    timeLabel.classList.toggle('text-emerald-300', !locked);
                }
                const button = document.querySelector(`#minigame-hub button[data-arcade-play="${gameId}"]`);
                if (button) {
                    button.disabled = locked;
                    button.classList.toggle('opacity-50', locked);
                    button.classList.toggle('cursor-not-allowed', locked);
                    if (locked) button.title = `Ready in ${arcadeClock(untilReset)}`;
                    else button.removeAttribute('title');
                    if (ARCADE_BUTTON_LABELS[gameId]) {
                        button.textContent = locked ? `🔒 READY IN ${arcadeClock(untilReset)}` : ARCADE_BUTTON_LABELS[gameId];
                    }
                }
            }
            if (currentGameMode) {
                const timeLeft = document.getElementById('arcade-time-left');
                const resetLeft = document.getElementById('arcade-reset-left');
                const timeLabel = document.getElementById('arcade-active-label');
                const resetLabel = document.getElementById('arcade-reset-label');
                if (currentGameMode === 'dl-down') {
                    if (timeLabel) timeLabel.textContent = '⏱ Play time:';
                    if (timeLeft) timeLeft.textContent = 'UNLIMITED ∞';
                    if (resetLabel) resetLabel.textContent = '🔄 Cooldown:';
                    if (resetLeft) resetLeft.textContent = 'None';
                } else if (currentGameMode === 'gold-quest' || currentGameMode === 'crypto-hack') {
                    const rec = arcadeQuizRecord(currentGameMode, now);
                    if (timeLabel) timeLabel.textContent = '❓ Questions remaining:';
                    if (timeLeft) timeLeft.textContent = `${11 - rec.round} / 10`;
                    if (resetLabel) resetLabel.textContent = '🔄 Rest after 10 questions:';
                    if (resetLeft) resetLeft.textContent = '45 minutes';
                } else {
                    const rec = arcadeRecord(currentGameMode, now, true);
                    if (timeLabel) timeLabel.textContent = '⏱ Time left:';
                    if (timeLeft) timeLeft.textContent = arcadeClock(ARCADE_PLAY_MS - rec.usedMs);
                    if (resetLabel) resetLabel.textContent = '🔄 Allowance resets in:';
                    if (resetLeft) resetLeft.textContent = arcadeClock(rec.windowStart + ARCADE_RESET_MS - now);
                }
            }
        }

        function arcadeSetUpHubLabels() {
            document.querySelectorAll('#minigame-hub button[onclick^="launchGame("]').forEach(button => {
                const match = button.getAttribute('onclick').match(/launchGame\('([^']+)'\)/);
                if (!match || !ARCADE_GAMES.includes(match[1])) return;
                const gameId = match[1];
                button.dataset.arcadePlay = gameId;
                if (button.nextElementSibling?.dataset.arcadeTime === gameId) return;
                const label = document.createElement('div');
                label.dataset.arcadeTime = gameId;
                label.className = 'mt-2 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-300 text-center font-fredoka';
                label.setAttribute('role', 'status');
                button.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', label);
            });
            arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
        }

        function arcadeTimerTick() {
            if (currentGameMode && !document.hidden) {
                arcadeConsumeTime();
                if (arcadeRemaining(currentGameMode) <= 0) {
                    const finished = currentGameMode;
                    const rec = arcadeRecord(finished);
                    const reset = rec ? Math.max(0, rec.windowStart + ARCADE_RESET_MS - Date.now()) : 0;
                    returnToGameHub();
                    showToast(`⏰ ${ARCADE_GAME_NAMES[finished]}: 15-minute limit reached. Available again in ${arcadeClock(reset)}.`, 'info');
                }
            }
            arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
        }

        function launchGame(gameId) {
            if (!ARCADE_GAMES.includes(gameId)) return;
            const now = Date.now();
            if (gameId === 'gold-quest' || gameId === 'crypto-hack') {
                const rec = arcadeQuizRecord(gameId, now);
                if (rec.lockedUntil > now) {
                    showToast(`🔒 ${ARCADE_GAME_NAMES[gameId]} opens in ${arcadeClock(rec.lockedUntil - now)}.`, 'info');
                    arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
                    return;
                }
            }
            if (currentGameMode) arcadeConsumeTime(now);
            if (arcadeRemaining(gameId, now) <= 0) {
                const rec = arcadeRecord(gameId, now);
                const delay = rec ? rec.windowStart + ARCADE_RESET_MS - now : 0;
                showToast(`⏰ ${ARCADE_GAME_NAMES[gameId]} has used its 15 minutes. Resets in ${arcadeClock(delay)}.`, 'error');
                arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
                return;
            }
            if (!UNTIMED_ARCADE_GAMES.has(gameId)) {
                arcadeRecord(gameId, now, true);
                arcadePersist();
            }
            arcadeLastTick = document.hidden ? null : now;
            currentGameMode = gameId;
            document.getElementById('minigame-hub').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('active-game-wrapper').classList.remove('hidden');
            document.querySelectorAll('.game-view').forEach(v => v.classList.add('hidden'));

            const titleMap = {
                'dl-down': '🧗‍♂️ Don\'t Look Down',
                'gold-quest': '👑 Gold Quest',
                'crypto-hack': '💻 Crypto Hack',
                'cookie-clicker': '🍪 Cookie Clicker: Deluxe Edition',
                'block-blast': '🧱 Block Blast Deluxe',
                'tiny-fishing': '🎣 Tiny Fishing',
                'web-dashers': '◆ Web Dashers Arcade Edition',
                'mini-soccer': '⚽ Super Penalty Shootout',
                'crystal-spire': '🧙‍♂️ Crystal Spire Arcana: Blook Edition'
            };
            document.getElementById('active-game-title').innerText = titleMap[gameId] || 'Mini Game';
            document.getElementById(`view-${gameId}`).classList.remove('hidden');

            if (gameId === 'dl-down') resetDLGame();
            if (gameId === 'gold-quest') startGoldQuest();
            if (gameId === 'crypto-hack') startCryptoHack();
            if (gameId === 'cookie-clicker') initCookieClicker();
            if (gameId === 'block-blast') startDeluxeBlockBlast();
            if (gameId === 'tiny-fishing') initTinyFishing();
            if (gameId === 'web-dashers') wdOpen();
            if (gameId === 'mini-soccer') initSoccerGame();
            if (gameId === 'crystal-spire') initCrystalSpire();
            arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
            // The old hub can leave the browser scrolled past the game, making
            // the opened mode look blank. Bring its canvas / controls into view.
            const activeView = document.getElementById('active-game-wrapper');
            if (activeView) activeView.scrollIntoView({block:'start', behavior:'auto'});
            if (gameId === 'dl-down') renderDLGame();
            if (gameId === 'mini-soccer') renderSoccerGame();
        }

        function returnToGameHub() {
            if (currentGameMode && !document.hidden) arcadeConsumeTime();
            arcadeLastTick = null;
            stopTinyFishing();
            wdStop();
            document.getElementById('active-game-wrapper').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('quiz-modal').classList.add('hidden');
            document.getElementById('minigame-hub').classList.remove('hidden');
            currentGameMode = null;
            saveState();
            updateGlobalHeader();
            updateArcadeHubUI();
            const hub = document.getElementById('minigame-hub');
            if (hub) hub.scrollIntoView({block:'start', behavior:'auto'});
        }

        // Only count time while a game is actually open and the browser tab is visible.
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
            if (document.hidden) {
                arcadeConsumeTime();
                arcadeLastTick = null;
            } else if (currentGameMode) {
                arcadeLastTick = Date.now();
            }
            arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
        });
        window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => {
            if (currentGameMode && !document.hidden) arcadeConsumeTime();
            arcadePersist();
        });
        window.addEventListener('storage', event => {
            if (event.key === ARCADE_LIMITS_KEY && event.newValue) {
                try { arcadeGameLimits = JSON.parse(event.newValue) || {}; } catch (e) {}
                arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
            }
            if (event.key === QUIZ_PROGRESS_KEY && event.newValue) {
                try { quizProgress = JSON.parse(event.newValue) || {}; } catch (e) {}
                arcadeUpdateGameTimers();
            }
        });
        setInterval(arcadeTimerTick, 500);

        window.transferGamePoints = function(amount) {
            if (currentGameMode) {
                if (!document.hidden) arcadeConsumeTime();
                if (arcadeRemaining(currentGameMode) <= 0) {
                    arcadeTimerTick();
                    return;
                }
            }
            const num = Math.floor(Number(amount));
            if (!isNaN(num) && num > 0) {
                gameState.tokens = (Number(gameState.tokens) || 0) + num;
                saveState();
                updateGlobalHeader();
                showToast(`🎉 +${num.toLocaleString()} 🪙 Tokens added to Main Balance!`, 'success');
            }
        };

        // =========================================================================
        // NATIVE CRYSTAL SPIRE ARCANA: BLOOK EDITION (PRODIGY-LIKE RPG GAME)
        // =========================================================================
        const CSA_BLOOKS = [
            { id: 'chick', name: 'Chick', icon: '🐥', rarity: 'Common ⚪', color: 'bg-slate-700 text-slate-200', sellTokens: 50, atk: 15, hp: 80, desc: 'A cheerful baby chick with surprising magic potential.' },
            { id: 'cyber_ninja', name: 'Cyber Ninja', icon: '🥷', rarity: 'Rare 🔵', color: 'bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-300', sellTokens: 150, atk: 25, hp: 90, desc: 'Strikes swift as lightning with plasma blades.' },
            { id: 'frost_yeti', name: 'Frost Yeti', icon: '🦣', rarity: 'Rare 🔵', color: 'bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-300', sellTokens: 150, atk: 20, hp: 110, desc: 'Surrounds master with icy shield absorbing damage.' },
            { id: 'astronaut', name: 'Astronaut', icon: '👨‍🚀', rarity: 'Epic 🟣', color: 'bg-purple-900/60 text-purple-300', sellTokens: 350, atk: 30, hp: 100, desc: 'Uses anti-gravity wave to confuse opponents.' },
            { id: 'megalodon', name: 'Megalodon', icon: '🦈', rarity: 'Epic 🟣', color: 'bg-purple-900/60 text-purple-300', sellTokens: 350, atk: 35, hp: 95, desc: 'Fierce aquatic predator with massive jaw strength.' },
            { id: 'dragon', name: 'Dragon', icon: '🐉', rarity: 'Legendary 🟡', color: 'bg-amber-900/60 text-amber-300', sellTokens: 800, atk: 45, hp: 120, desc: 'Breathes scorching flames that burn turn after turn.' },
            { id: 'unicorn', name: 'Unicorn', icon: '🦄', rarity: 'Legendary 🟡', color: 'bg-amber-900/60 text-amber-300', sellTokens: 800, atk: 38, hp: 130, desc: 'Radiates star magic that continuously heals HP.' },
            { id: 'golden_crown', name: 'Golden Crown', icon: '👑', rarity: 'Chroma 🌈', color: 'bg-pink-900/60 text-pink-300', sellTokens: 1500, atk: 50, hp: 140, desc: 'Royal relic boosting token earnings by 20%.' },
            { id: 'shadow_phantom', name: 'Shadow Phantom', icon: '👻', rarity: 'Chroma 🌈', color: 'bg-pink-900/60 text-pink-300', sellTokens: 1500, atk: 52, hp: 125, desc: 'Phases through attacks with 25% dodge chance.' },
            { id: 'celestial_phoenix', name: 'Celestial Phoenix', icon: '🐦‍🔥', rarity: 'Mystical 🔥', color: 'bg-red-900/60 text-red-300', sellTokens: 3000, atk: 60, hp: 150, desc: 'Ancient firebird capable of auto-reviving once.' }
        ];

        const CSA_BOXES = [
            { id: 'medieval_box', name: 'Medieval Box', cost: 250, icon: '🏰', pool: ['chick', 'cyber_ninja'] },
            { id: 'aquatic_box', name: 'Aquatic Box', cost: 500, icon: '🌊', pool: ['megalodon', 'frost_yeti', 'dragon'] },
            { id: 'space_box', name: 'Space Box', cost: 1000, icon: '🚀', pool: ['astronaut', 'shadow_phantom'] },
            { id: 'mythic_box', name: 'Mythic Box', cost: 2500, icon: '✨', pool: ['unicorn', 'golden_crown', 'celestial_phoenix'] }
        ];

        const CSA_SPELLS = [

            { id: 'hydro_pump', name: 'Hydro Pump', cost: 12, dmg: 24, color: '#06b6d4', icon: '🌊' },
            { id: 'vine_strike', name: 'Vine Strike', cost: 8, dmg: 20, color: '#22c55e', icon: '🌿' },

        const CSA_BIOMES = [

            { id: 'volcano', name: 'Volcanic Peak', icon: '🌋', bg: 'from-orange-950 to-slate-950', wildBlook: 'dragon', levelReq: 3 },

        let csaState = {
            level: 1,

            rp: 1200,

            ownedBlookIds: ['chick'],
