}
function tfBurst(x,y,color='#ffea8a',n=18,power=1){
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
  const a=Math.PI*2*i/n+Math.random()*.3,spd=(65+Math.random()*120)*power;
  tf.fx.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*spd,vy:Math.sin(a)*spd-35,t:0,life:.40+Math.random()*.5,color,r:2.5+Math.random()*3});
 }
}
function tfPopup(label,x,y,color='#fff9bf',size=18){tf.popups.push({label,x,y,color,t:0,life:1.1,size});}
function tfPowerPlacement(){
 // One optional treasure and one rare magnet pearl, separated in depth.
 const range=Math.max(160,tf.reach-145);
 tf.treasure={x:190+Math.random()*425,y:155+range*.32,caught:false,phase:Math.random()*6};
 tf.pearl={x:150+Math.random()*500,y:155+range*.80,caught:false,phase:Math.random()*6};
}
function tfCatchTreasure(){
 tf.treasure.caught=true;tf.treasureCaught++;
 const v=Math.round((tf.depth*32+115)*(1+Math.random()*.5));tf.bonuses+=v;
 tfBurst(tf.treasure.x,tf.treasure.y,'#ffe278',32,1.35);tfPopup('TREASURE! +$'+v,tf.treasure.x,tf.treasure.y-14,'#fff0a2',23);tfSound('chest');tf.shake=5;
 tfStatus('💰 Treasure chest! Bonus cash!');
}
function tfCatchPearl(){
 tf.pearl.caught=true;tf.pearlCaught++;tf.magnet=2.7;tf.fever=Math.max(tf.fever,1.3);
 tfBurst(tf.pearl.x,tf.pearl.y,'#83f5ff',28,1.25);tfPopup('MAGNET POWER!',tf.pearl.x,tf.pearl.y-20,'#adfaff',22);tfSound('fever');
 tfStatus('🫧 Magnet power! Fish swim toward your hook!');
}
function tfDrawPrize(ctx,p,t){
 if(!p||p.caught)return;
 const y=p.y+Math.sin(t*2.6+p.phase)*5;
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(p.x,y);
 if(p===tf.treasure){
  ctx.shadowColor='#ffe17a';ctx.shadowBlur=18+Math.sin(t*5)*5;
  ctx.fillStyle='#7f4a35';ctx.strokeStyle='#fbc65f';ctx.lineWidth=3;
  tfRoundRect(ctx,-22,-15,44,31,6);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#d99842';tfRoundRect(ctx,-24,-17,48,12,5);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fce78a';ctx.fillRect(-4,-14,8,25);ctx.fillRect(-20,-5,40,5);
  ctx.fillStyle='#6e502b';ctx.fillRect(-3,0,6,7);
 }else{
  ctx.shadowColor='#80f5ff';ctx.shadowBlur=19;
  ctx.fillStyle='#76eaff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,14+Math.sin(t*5)*1.5,0,7);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(-4,-5,4,0,7);ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#cbfaff';ctx.lineWidth=1.8;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,18+Math.sin(t*3)*4,0,7);ctx.stroke();
 }
 ctx.restore();
}
function tfDrawEffects(ctx,dt){
 if(dt>0){
  tf.fx=tf.fx.filter(p=>p.t<p.life);tf.popups=tf.popups.filter(p=>p.t<p.life);
  for(const p of tf.fx){p.t+=dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=110*dt;}
  for(const p of tf.popups){p.t+=dt;p.y-=32*dt;}
 }
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-tf.cameraY);
 for(const p of tf.fx){ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,1-p.t/p.life);ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r*(1-p.t/p.life*.4),0,7);ctx.fill();}
 for(const p of tf.popups){ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,1-p.t/p.life);ctx.font=`900 ${p.size}px system-ui`;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.shadowBlur=5;ctx.shadowColor='#08263e';ctx.fillStyle=p.color;ctx.fillText(p.label,p.x,p.y);}
 ctx.restore();ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function tfCheckMission(total,newSpecies){
 const ix=tf.missionIndex%5;
 const ok=ix===0?tf.caught.length>=1:ix===1?tf.luckyCaught>0:ix===2?tf.caught.length>=2:ix===3?newSpecies.length>0:tf.treasureCaught>0;
 if(!ok)return 0;
 const reward=tfMission().prize;tf.missionIndex++;
 tfStatus('⭐ CHALLENGE COMPLETE! +$'+reward+' bonus!');tfPopup('⭐ CHALLENGE +$'+reward,400,140,'#fff2a3',26);tfBurst(400,140,'#ffe596',45,1.8);tfSound('fever');
 return reward;
}
function tfCelebrateFrame(ms){
 if(tf.active||!tf.celebrateUntil||ms>tf.celebrateUntil){tf.celebrateUntil=0;tf.animating=false;tfDraw(ms);return;}
 const dt=Math.min(.045,Math.max(0,(ms-(tf.last||ms))/1000));tf.last=ms;tfDraw(ms,dt);requestAnimationFrame(tfCelebrateFrame);
}
function tfUI(){
 const vals={'tf-cash':tf.cash,'tf-best':tf.best,'tf-tokens':tf.tokens,'tf-depth':tf.depth,'tf-capacity':tf.capacity,'tf-value':tf.value,'tf-depth-price':tfPrice('depth'),'tf-capacity-price':tfPrice('capacity'),'tf-value-price':tfPrice('value'),'tf-species-count':tf.discovered.length,'tf-depth-meter':tfMaxDepth()-95,'tf-haul-count':tf.caught.length};
 for(const [id,val] of Object.entries(vals)){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(el)el.textContent=Number(val).toLocaleString();}
 const cast=document.getElementById('tf-cast');if(cast){cast.disabled=tf.active;cast.style.opacity=tf.active?'.6':'1';cast.textContent=tf.active?(tf.phase==='up'?'🐟 REELING…':'⬇️ DIVING…'):'🎣 CAST!';}
 const label=document.getElementById('tf-zone-label');if(label)label.textContent=TF_ZONES[tfZone(tf.active?tf.hookY:tfMaxDepth())].name;
 const size=document.getElementById('tf-gear-label');if(size)size.textContent=`${tf.capacity} fish / cast`;
 const valid={'depth':tf.depth<14,'capacity':tf.capacity<15,'value':true};
 for(const kind of ['depth','capacity','value']){const el=document.querySelector(`[data-tf-upgrade="${kind}"]`);if(el){el.disabled=tf.active||tf.cash<tfPrice(kind)||!valid[kind];el.title=!valid[kind]?'Maximum upgrade reached':tf.cash<tfPrice(kind)?'Catch fish to afford this upgrade':'Buy gear upgrade';}}
 const hint=document.getElementById('tf-shop-hint');if(hint){const ok=Object.keys(valid).some(k=>valid[k]&&tf.cash>=tfPrice(k));hint.textContent=ok?'✨ Upgrade available!':'Upgrade your fishing line';}
 const dive=document.getElementById('tf-depth-progress');if(dive)dive.style.width=(tf.active?Math.min(100,Math.max(0,(tf.hookY-95)/(tf.reach-95)*100)):0)+'%';
 tfMissionUI();tfUpdateSoundButton();
}

function tfPickSpecies(y){
 const z=tfZone(y),eligible=TF_SPECIES.filter(s=>s.zone===z||(s.zone===z-1&&Math.random()<.13));
 let pool=eligible.length?eligible:TF_SPECIES.filter(s=>s.zone===0);
 let total=pool.reduce((n,s)=>n+s.weight,0),roll=Math.random()*total;
 for(const s of pool){roll-=s.weight;if(roll<=0)return s;}
 return pool[pool.length-1];
}
function tfResetFish(){
 // Sparse, curated fish spacing: around 5 to 8 visible at any moment, not 25+.
 const deep=tf.reach;tf.fish=[];
 let i=0,prevX=400;
 for(let y=175;y<deep-6;y+=65+Math.random()*33){
  const zone=tfZone(y),s=tfPickSpecies(y);
  let x=95+Math.random()*610;
  if(i===0)x=tf.casts<2?396+Math.random()*8:350+Math.random()*105;
  if(Math.abs(x-prevX)<135&&i>0)x=x<400?Math.min(700,x+170):Math.max(110,x-170);
  prevX=x;
  const scale=.79+Math.random()*.42;
  const size=Math.max(9,s.size*scale);
  const vx=i===0&&tf.casts<2?3:(16+Math.random()*30)/(1+s.size/90)*(Math.random()<.5?-1:1);
  tf.fish.push({id:i,s,x,y,baseY:y,size,vx,phase:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,bob:3+Math.random()*5,caught:false,glow:Math.random()*6.28,lucky:false,earned:0});
  i++;
 }
 if(!tf.fish.length){const s=TF_SPECIES[2];tf.fish.push({id:0,s,x:400,y:225,baseY:225,size:s.size,vx:10,phase:0,bob:3,caught:false,glow:0,lucky:true,earned:0});}
 // Guaranteed shiny target in every cast; visually easy to identify.
 const eligible=tf.fish.slice(0,Math.min(tf.fish.length,Math.max(3,Math.ceil(tf.fish.length*.7))));
 eligible[Math.floor(Math.random()*eligible.length)].lucky=true;
 tf.particles=[];tf.fx=[];tf.popups=[];tfPowerPlacement();
}

function tfRoundRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);}
function tfBody(ctx,shape,color,stroke='#132b46'){
 ctx.beginPath();
 if(shape==='disc')ctx.ellipse(0,0,.86,.78,0,0,Math.PI*2);
 else if(shape==='long')ctx.ellipse(0,0,1.15,.33,0,0,Math.PI*2);
 else if(shape==='chunky')ctx.ellipse(0,0,1.08,.67,0,0,Math.PI*2);
 else if(shape==='round')ctx.ellipse(0,0,.82,.80,0,0,Math.PI*2);
 else if(shape==='tall')ctx.ellipse(0,0,.82,.91,0,0,Math.PI*2);
 else ctx.ellipse(0,0,1.02,.52,0,0,Math.PI*2);
 ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fill();ctx.lineWidth=.065;ctx.strokeStyle=stroke;ctx.stroke();
}
function tfTail(ctx,swing,color,mode='fork'){
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(-.94,0);ctx.rotate(swing*.13);ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.strokeStyle='#1b344c';ctx.lineWidth=.06;ctx.beginPath();
 if(mode==='fan'){ctx.moveTo(.04,0);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-.46,-.38,-.8,-.7,-.99,-.64);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-1.2,0,-.99,.64);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-.7,.7,-.43,.32,.04,0);}
 else if(mode==='shark'){ctx.moveTo(.08,0);ctx.lineTo(-.65,-.6);ctx.lineTo(-.61,-1.00);ctx.lineTo(-1.01,-.23);ctx.lineTo(-.75,.84);ctx.lineTo(-.34,.39);}
 else {ctx.moveTo(.05,0);ctx.lineTo(-.78,-.66);ctx.lineTo(-.56,0);ctx.lineTo(-.78,.66);}
 ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function tfEye(ctx,x=.59,y=-.12,r=.115){
 ctx.fillStyle='#f8fafc';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,7);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle='#08172b';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+.023,y,.058,0,7);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x+.043,y-.037,.024,0,7);ctx.fill();
}
function tfFin(ctx,color,scale=1){
 ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(10,31,55,.5)';ctx.lineWidth=.045;
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.4,-.4);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-.05,-1.20*scale,.30,-.38);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.32,.38);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(.04,.83*scale,.28,.35);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
}
function tfStripes(ctx,color,count,width=.16,shape='normal'){
 ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();if(shape==='disc')ctx.ellipse(0,0,.86,.78,0,0,7);else ctx.ellipse(0,0,1.02,.52,0,0,7);ctx.clip();ctx.fillStyle=color;
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const xp=-.52+i*1.1/Math.max(1,count-1);ctx.save();ctx.translate(xp,0);ctx.rotate(-.12);ctx.fillRect(-width/2,-1,width,2);ctx.restore();}ctx.restore();
}
function tfSpots(ctx,color,count=15,size=.055,spreadX=1,spreadY=.4){
 ctx.fillStyle=color;for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
  const a=i*2.39996,rad=Math.sqrt((i+.7)/(count+.7));const sx=Math.cos(a)*rad*spreadX,sy=Math.sin(a)*rad*spreadY;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(sx,sy,size*(.7+(i%3)*.17),0,7);ctx.fill();
 }
}
function tfDrawSpecies(ctx,s,t,scale=1){
 const sh=s.shape,col=s.color,sw=Math.sin(t*7)*.68;
 ctx.save();ctx.scale(scale,scale);ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.lineCap='round';
 if(sh==='ray'||sh==='manta'){
  // Real ray silhouette: two large swept wings, long thin tail and cephalic fins.
  ctx.strokeStyle=sh==='manta'?'#b3c9d8':'#a78865';ctx.lineWidth=.055;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.85,.06);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-1.4,.25,-1.9,.66,-2.45,1.8);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.strokeStyle='#1c324a';ctx.lineWidth=.055;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.86,.03);ctx.bezierCurveTo(.47,-.14,.19,-1.0,.06,-1.16);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-.30,-.93,-.60,-.27,-.74,-.02);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-.35,.20,-.24,.86,.06,1.07);ctx.bezierCurveTo(.32,.70,.52,.20,.86,.03);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle=sh==='manta'?'#dce3e9':'#f4e4cc';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(.15,.05,.28,.35,0,0,7);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#081b30';for(const yy of [-.23,.23]){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(.43,yy,.055,0,7);ctx.fill();}
  ctx.strokeStyle='#162b46';ctx.lineWidth=.06;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.67,-.22);ctx.lineTo(.94,-.40);ctx.moveTo(.67,.22);ctx.lineTo(.94,.4);ctx.stroke();
  if(sh==='manta')tfSpots(ctx,'#d8eafa',16,.038,.6,.64);
 } else if(sh==='seahorse'){
  // Upright, snouted body with curled prehensile tail and dorsal fin.
  ctx.strokeStyle='#b27b34';ctx.lineWidth=.29;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.18,.50);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-.5,1.04,-.33,1.28,.05,1.25);ctx.bezierCurveTo(.58,1.26,.50,.78,.22,.86);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ed9f31';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.46,-.7);ctx.lineTo(-.37,-1.1);ctx.lineTo(-.12,-.82);ctx.bezierCurveTo(.29,-.82,.47,-.58,.43,-.28);ctx.lineTo(.89,-.15);ctx.lineTo(.94,0);ctx.lineTo(.40,.13);ctx.bezierCurveTo(.57,.64,.24,.88,-.20,.70);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-.53,.37,-.59,-.24,-.46,-.7);ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#996525';ctx.lineWidth=.07;ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffdc8f';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(.04,.33,.23,.35,-.15,0,7);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#efbb68';for(let i=0;i<6;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.46,i*.22-.67);ctx.lineTo(-.68,i*.22-.78);ctx.lineTo(-.46,i*.22-.53);ctx.fill();}
  tfEye(ctx,.21,-.51,.09);
 } else if(sh==='puffer'){
  ctx.fillStyle='#e9c486';for(let i=0;i<15;i++){const a=i*2*Math.PI/15;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*.8,Math.sin(a)*.8);ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*1.1,Math.sin(a)*1.1);ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(a+.13)*.74,Math.sin(a+.13)*.74);ctx.fill();}
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,.79,0,7);ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fill();ctx.lineWidth=.06;ctx.strokeStyle='#8f7c4a';ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#f8e8b6';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(.12,.43,.53,.25,0,0,7);ctx.fill();
  tfSpots(ctx,'#b39f5c',14,.06,.56,.5);tfEye(ctx,.40,-.13,.11);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#715c41';ctx.lineWidth=.085;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(.78,.12,.13,1.6,4.4);ctx.stroke();
 } else if(sh==='lion'){
  tfTail(ctx,sw,'#f2a47c','fan');
  ctx.strokeStyle='#edc8a3';ctx.lineWidth=.075;for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const px=-.65+i*.16;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px,-.2);ctx.lineTo(px-.15,-1.05-((i%3)*.16));ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.fillStyle='#b35a52';for(let i=0;i<7;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.48+i*.15,.30);ctx.lineTo(-1.0+i*.26,1.08);ctx.lineTo(-.14+i*.15,.3);ctx.fill();}
  tfBody(ctx,'normal',col,'#784d55');tfStripes(ctx,'#a4413d',6,.13);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f6d3a6';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.0,.12);ctx.lineTo(-.76,.74);ctx.lineTo(.52,.40);ctx.fill();tfEye(ctx,.62,-.13,.1);
 } else if(sh==='angler'){
  tfTail(ctx,sw,'#5a456f','fan');ctx.fillStyle='#573b65';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.7,-.25);ctx.lineTo(-.18,-1.05);ctx.lineTo(.05,-.49);ctx.fill();
  tfBody(ctx,'chunky',col,'#241937');ctx.fillStyle='#251933';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.26,.2);ctx.lineTo(1.08,.12);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(.75,.62,.16,.57);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fef3cc';for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const px=.30+i*.13;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px,.19);ctx.lineTo(px+.05,.40);ctx.lineTo(px+.1,.17);ctx.fill();}
  tfEye(ctx,.38,-.28,.15);ctx.strokeStyle='#b698d3';ctx.lineWidth=.065;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.0,-.5);ctx.bezierCurveTo(.2,-1.44,.88,-1.40,1.03,-1.10);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();ctx.shadowColor='#bdfbff';ctx.shadowBlur=.32;ctx.fillStyle='#bdfbff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(1.03,-1.10,.15,0,7);ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
 } else if(sh==='oarfish'||sh==='dragon'){
  ctx.strokeStyle=sh==='oarfish'?'#dfeaf0':'#34304e';ctx.lineWidth=.48;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-1.95,.2);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-1.0,-.65,.20,.4,1.03,-.07);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.strokeStyle=sh==='oarfish'?'#ea586d':'#9c70d8';ctx.lineWidth=.10;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-1.85,.04);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-.8,-.93,.25,.17,.82,-.32);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle=sh==='oarfish'?'#df5263':'#ca78e2';for(let i=0;i<10;i++){const xp=-1.4+i*.24;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(xp,-.28);ctx.lineTo(xp+.10,-.52-(i%2)*.20);ctx.lineTo(xp+.20,-.22);ctx.fill();}
  if(sh==='dragon'){ctx.save();ctx.shadowBlur=.15;ctx.shadowColor='#33f0ff';tfSpots(ctx,'#43e9ff',15,.052,1.7,.25);ctx.restore();}
  tfEye(ctx,.74,-.14,.085);
  ctx.fillStyle=sh==='oarfish'?'#b8d5e3':'#d1dcfd';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(1.0,0);ctx.lineTo(1.24,.07);ctx.lineTo(1.01,.18);ctx.fill();
 } else if(sh==='sunfish'){
  ctx.fillStyle='#7e9ba9';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.45,-.49);ctx.lineTo(-.23,-1.42);ctx.lineTo(.09,-.62);ctx.lineTo(.08,.66);ctx.lineTo(-.32,1.35);ctx.lineTo(-.45,.4);ctx.fill();
  tfBody(ctx,'tall',col);ctx.fillStyle='#d2e0e9';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(.2,.10,.50,.50,0,0,7);ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle='#536e82';ctx.lineWidth=.06;for(let i=0;i<7;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.74+i*.07,-.4);ctx.lineTo(-.64+i*.08,.46);ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.fillStyle='#7b98a8';ctx.fillRect(-.84,-.58,.12,1.16);tfEye(ctx,.53,-.26,.115);
 } else if(['white','hammer','whaleshark'].includes(sh)){
  tfTail(ctx,sw,col,'shark');ctx.fillStyle=col;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.32,-.28);ctx.lineTo(.11,-1.04);ctx.lineTo(.38,-.28);ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.31,.20);ctx.lineTo(-.66,.72);ctx.lineTo(.18,.29);ctx.fill();
  tfBody(ctx,'long',col);ctx.fillStyle='#dce9ed';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(.20,.21,.85,.12,0,0,7);ctx.fill();
  if(sh==='hammer'){ctx.fillStyle=col;ctx.fillRect(.67,-.72,.22,1.44);for(const yy of [-.63,.63])tfEye(ctx,.81,yy,.09);}
  else tfEye(ctx,.63,-.17,.09);
  if(sh==='whaleshark')tfSpots(ctx,'#cce5ef',37,.05,.88,.30);
  if(sh==='white'){ctx.fillStyle='#f4f5f3';for(let i=0;i<4;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.59+i*.10,.25);ctx.lineTo(.63+i*.10,.37);ctx.lineTo(.67+i*.10,.22);ctx.fill();}}
  ctx.strokeStyle='#375368';ctx.lineWidth=.05;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.13+i*.1,-.21);ctx.lineTo(.1+i*.1,.1);ctx.stroke();}
 } else if(['sword','barracuda','tuna','mahi','flying'].includes(sh)){
  tfTail(ctx,sw,sh==='mahi'?'#1585b5':col,sh==='tuna'?'shark':'fork');
  if(sh==='mahi'){ctx.fillStyle='#2fbaaf';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.70,-.29);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(.0,-.95,.81,-.46);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();}
  else if(sh==='flying'){ctx.fillStyle='#90e4fd';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.38,-.11);ctx.lineTo(-1.10,-1.20);ctx.lineTo(.45,-.35);ctx.fill();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.25,.1);ctx.lineTo(-.65,.98);ctx.lineTo(.38,.25);ctx.fill();}
  else{ctx.fillStyle='#315978';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.3,-.3);ctx.lineTo(.0,-.85);ctx.lineTo(.19,-.29);ctx.fill();}
  tfBody(ctx,sh==='barracuda'?'long':'normal',col);
  if(sh==='mahi'){ctx.fillStyle='#78e9ac';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(.27,.20,.60,.22,0,0,7);ctx.fill();}
  if(sh==='tuna'){ctx.fillStyle='#daeaf7';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(.3,.22,.72,.15,0,0,7);ctx.fill();}
  if(sh==='sword'){ctx.strokeStyle='#90bad4';ctx.lineWidth=.13;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.9,-.11);ctx.lineTo(2.15,-.15);ctx.stroke();}
  if(sh==='barracuda'){ctx.fillStyle='#d8e7e4';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.75,.14);ctx.lineTo(1.32,.21);ctx.lineTo(1.05,.32);ctx.fill();}
  tfEye(ctx,.70,-.14,.09);
 } else if(sh==='grouper'||sh==='coelacanth'){
  tfTail(ctx,sw,sh==='grouper'?'#746d51':'#426187','fan');tfFin(ctx,sh==='grouper'?'#8d8066':'#4f7195',.9);
  tfBody(ctx,'chunky',col);tfSpots(ctx,sh==='grouper'?'#6a644e':'#bbd9ee',sh==='grouper'?21:29,.055,.88,.50);
  if(sh==='coelacanth'){ctx.fillStyle='#456486';for(const [xp,yp] of [[-.4,.43],[.12,.44],[-.12,-.50]]){ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(xp,yp,.23,.19,.2,0,7);ctx.fill();}}
  ctx.fillStyle='#243d52';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(.80,.30,.18,.12,0,0,7);ctx.fill();tfEye(ctx,.63,-.23,.12);
 } else {
  const isDisc=['tang','disc','butterfly'].includes(sh),body=sh==='snapper'?'chunky':isDisc?'disc':sh==='guppy'?'normal':'long';
  tfTail(ctx,sw,sh==='tang'?'#fbe24a':sh==='guppy'?'#ffb3d7':col,sh==='guppy'?'fan':'fork');
  tfFin(ctx,sh==='clown'?'#e85b20':sh==='trout'?'#9fa08b':col,.75);
  tfBody(ctx,body,col);
  if(sh==='clown'){tfStripes(ctx,'#fff8ed',3,.23);tfStripes(ctx,'#202e3f',3,.033);}
  if(sh==='butterfly'){tfStripes(ctx,'#c66d36',4,.19,'disc');ctx.fillStyle='#e3e4a1';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(.82,-.03);ctx.lineTo(1.38,.1);ctx.lineTo(.80,.20);ctx.fill();}
  if(sh==='tang'){ctx.strokeStyle='#151d72';ctx.lineWidth=.14;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.7,-.17);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(.1,-.75,.78,-.17);ctx.stroke();ctx.strokeStyle='#fbdf2e';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.60,.24);ctx.lineTo(.28,.38);ctx.stroke();}
  if(sh==='trout'){ctx.strokeStyle='#f68da2';ctx.lineWidth=.17;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.8,.07);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0,.25,.9,.05);ctx.stroke();tfSpots(ctx,'#55604b',20,.045,.76,.32);}
  if(sh==='guppy'){tfSpots(ctx,'#f4e47d',9,.075,.7,.30);}
  if(sh==='snapper'){ctx.fillStyle='#fbb9bd';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-.20,.39);ctx.lineTo(.35,.75);ctx.lineTo(.32,.31);ctx.fill();}
  tfEye(ctx,isDisc?.54:.67,-.13,.095);
 }
 ctx.restore();
}
function tfDrawFish(ctx,f,t,scale=1){
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(f.x,f.y+Math.sin(t*1.7+f.phase)*f.bob);
 if(f.lucky){
  ctx.save();ctx.shadowColor='#fef08a';ctx.shadowBlur=22;
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,230,91,.8)';ctx.lineWidth=2.5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,0,f.size*1.40+6,f.size*.85+6,0,0,7);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff3a1';ctx.font='bold 17px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('★',0,-f.size*.9-10+Math.sin(t*4)*3);ctx.restore();
 }
 if(f.vx<0)ctx.scale(-1,1);
 ctx.rotate(Math.sin(t*1.6+f.phase)*.027);
 const k=f.size*scale;ctx.scale(k,k);
 if(f.s.zone>=2){ctx.shadowColor=f.s.zone===3?'#a1b4ff':'#65bcf9';ctx.shadowBlur=.12;}
 tfDrawSpecies(ctx,f.s,t);
 ctx.restore();
}

function tfDrawBackground(ctx,t){
 const w=800,h=430,top=tf.cameraY,z=tfZone(top+220),zone=TF_ZONES[z];
 let gr=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,h);gr.addColorStop(0,zone.start);gr.addColorStop(1,zone.end);ctx.fillStyle=gr;ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);
 if(top<550){
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(.04,.19-top/3900);
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const xx=i*205+Math.sin(t*.28+i)*15;ctx.fillStyle='#b5f3fc';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(xx-15,0);ctx.lineTo(xx+45,0);ctx.lineTo(xx+178,430);ctx.lineTo(xx+80,430);ctx.fill();}
  ctx.restore();
 }
 // Sparse scenery is kept at the edges so fish have room in the middle.
 if(top<540){ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-top);for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
   for(const side of [0,1]){const bx=side?740+i*13:35+i*13,by=382+i%3*24;
    ctx.strokeStyle=i%2?'#21a5a5':'#327dac';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(bx,by+40);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(bx-13+Math.sin(t+i)*5,by+5,bx+4,by-17);ctx.stroke();
   }
  }ctx.restore();}
 if(top>790){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.45;for(let i=0;i<24;i++){
  const px=(i*163.7)%800,py=(i*89.33-top*.16+2000)%430;ctx.fillStyle=i%3?'#78dbf7':'#b29aff';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,1+(i%3)*.4,0,7);ctx.fill();
 }ctx.restore();}
 for(let i=0;i<16;i++){
  const bx=(i*117+Math.sin(t*.6+i)*9)%800;
  const by=((i*91-t*(12+(i%3)*6)-top*.42)%530+530)%530-45;
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(198,246,255,.18)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(bx,by,1.7+i%3,0,7);ctx.stroke();
 }
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-top);
 for(let i=1;i<TF_ZONES.length;i++){
  const y=TF_ZONES[i].min;if(y>top+430||y<top-60)continue;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(235,251,255,.65)';ctx.font='bold 14px system-ui';ctx.fillText('✦ '+TF_ZONES[i].name.toUpperCase(),27,y+24);
 }
 ctx.restore();
}

function tfDrawBoat(ctx,t){
 if(tf.cameraY>205)return;
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-tf.cameraY);let bob=Math.sin(t*1.9)*2;
 // The ocean surface, dock-free little fishing skiff, happy fisher and rod.
 ctx.fillStyle='#ffdb83';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(700,41,27,0,7);ctx.fill();
 ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(230,250,255,.55)';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<=800;i+=10)ctx.lineTo(i,108+Math.sin(i*.034+t*2.2)*3);ctx.stroke();
 ctx.translate(0,bob);
 ctx.fillStyle='#b96a30';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(304,80);ctx.lineTo(500,80);ctx.lineTo(473,111);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(401,129,332,109);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle='#eeaf62';ctx.fillRect(320,76,168,7);ctx.fillStyle='#783820';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(331,96);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(400,118,477,96);ctx.lineTo(466,109);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(400,126,342,107);ctx.fill();
 ctx.strokeStyle='#253650';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(419,80);ctx.lineTo(420,46);ctx.stroke();
 ctx.fillStyle='#f0c39c';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(420,36,11,0,7);ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle='#263e61';ctx.fillRect(410,50,21,30);
 ctx.fillStyle='#ffcb51';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(404,31);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(423,14,434,30);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
 ctx.strokeStyle='#e6bb6c';ctx.lineWidth=4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(430,55);ctx.lineTo(450,48);ctx.lineTo(484,11);ctx.stroke();
 ctx.restore();
}
function tfDraw(tMs,dt=0){
 const c=document.getElementById('tf-canvas');if(!c)return;const ctx=c.getContext('2d');if(!ctx)return;
 const t=tMs/1000,w=c.width,h=c.height;
 ctx.clearRect(0,0,w,h);tfDrawBackground(ctx,t);
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(0,-tf.cameraY);
 for(const f of tf.fish){if(f.caught||f.y<tf.cameraY-130||f.y>tf.cameraY+540)continue;tfDrawFish(ctx,f,t);}
 tfDrawPrize(ctx,tf.treasure,t);tfDrawPrize(ctx,tf.pearl,t);
 ctx.restore();tfDrawBoat(ctx,t);
 if(tf.active){
  const hy=tf.hookY-tf.cameraY,rodY=50-tf.cameraY;
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(225,250,255,.85)';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(tf.cameraY<145?484:tf.hookX,tf.cameraY<145?rodY:0);ctx.lineTo(tf.hookX,hy);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(tf.hookX,hy);
  if(tf.magnet>0){ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(146,248,254,'+(.5+.3*Math.sin(t*12))+')';ctx.lineWidth=3;
   ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,80+Math.sin(t*12)*7,0,7);ctx.stroke();}
  ctx.strokeStyle='#ffd968';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-9);ctx.lineTo(0,8);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-.5,22,15,24,15,8);ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle='#fffef4';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,-8,3.5,0,7);ctx.fill();
  // Caught fish become a small, tidy haul instead of overlapping giant drawings.
  const show=tf.caught.slice(-5);for(let i=0;i<show.length;i++){
   const f=show[i];ctx.save();ctx.translate(-23-(i%3)*25,-28-Math.floor(i/3)*23);
   ctx.scale(i%2?-1:1,1);ctx.scale(10,10);tfDrawSpecies(ctx,f.s,t,.8);ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  // Minimal active overlay, only depth and hook count.
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,27,47,.65)';tfRoundRect(ctx,614,12,171,45,13);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#edfaff';ctx.font='bold 14px system-ui';ctx.fillText(`${Math.max(0,Math.round(tf.hookY-95))} m`,628,39);
  ctx.fillStyle='#ffe68c';ctx.fillText(`🐟 ${tf.caught.length}/${tf.capacity}`,702,39);
  if(tf.streak>=2){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(10,29,52,.79)';tfRoundRect(ctx,12,12,147,41,13);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#ffeb86';ctx.font='900 18px system-ui';ctx.fillText(`🔥 ${tf.streak} COMBO`,24,39);}
 }else if(tf.celebrateUntil&&tMs<tf.celebrateUntil){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(4,25,45,.65)';tfRoundRect(ctx,236,140,328,57,18);ctx.fill();
  ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.font='900 23px system-ui';ctx.fillStyle='#ffe685';ctx.fillText(`NICE HAUL! +$${tf.lastCatchTotal.toLocaleString()}`,400,176);ctx.textAlign='left';
 }
 if(tf.active&&tf.phase==='down'){
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(5,33,54,.67)';tfRoundRect(ctx,292,h-55,216,34,15);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle='#e5faff';ctx.font='900 15px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('GET READY TO STEER!',400,h-32);ctx.textAlign='left';
 }
 tfDrawEffects(ctx,dt);
}

function tfCatchFish(f){
 f.caught=true;tf.caught.push(f);tf.streak++;tf.combo=Math.min(3,1+Math.floor((tf.streak-1)/2)*.5);
 if(f.lucky)tf.luckyCaught++;
 const multiplier=f.lucky?4:1;
 f.earned=Math.round(f.s.value*tf.value*(.75+f.size/f.s.size*.25)*multiplier*tf.combo);
 tfBurst(f.x,f.y,f.lucky?'#ffe477':tf.streak>1?'#9bf9e5':'#dcfaff',f.lucky?31:18,f.lucky?1.6:1);
 tfPopup(`${f.lucky?'★ GOLDEN! ':''}+$${f.earned}`,f.x,f.y-21,f.lucky?'#ffef76':'#fff',f.lucky?23:19);
 if(tf.streak===2){tfPopup('SWEET COMBO!',f.x,f.y-47,'#b6ffe0',22);tfSound('combo');}
 else tfSound(f.lucky?'chest':'pop');
 if(f.lucky){tf.shake=5;tfStatus('🌟 GOLDEN '+f.s.name+'! Huge bonus!');}
 else tfStatus(tf.caught.length>=tf.capacity?'🎉 Hooks full! Get ready to cash out!':`🐟 ${f.s.name}! Keep the streak going!`);
 const el=document.getElementById('tf-haul-count');if(el)el.textContent=String(tf.caught.length);
}

function tfFinishCast(){
 let total=tf.bonuses,newSpecies=[];const counts=new Map();
 for(const f of tf.caught){
  total+=f.earned||Math.round(f.s.value*tf.value);
  counts.set(f.s.id,(counts.get(f.s.id)||0)+1);
  if(!tf.discovered.includes(f.s.id)){tf.discovered.push(f.s.id);newSpecies.push(f.s.name);}
  if(!tf.biggest||f.size>(tf.biggest.size||0))tf.biggest={id:f.s.id,size:f.size};
 }
 total+=tfCheckMission(total,newSpecies);
 tf.cash+=total;tf.tokens+=total;tf.best=Math.max(total,tf.best);tf.casts++;
 tf.active=false;tf.phase='idle';tf.cameraY=0;tf.hookY=95;tf.haul=[...counts].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]);
 if(total&&typeof transferGamePoints==='function')transferGamePoints(total);
 tfSave();tfRenderHaul(total,newSpecies);tfRenderFishdex();tfUI();
 if(total){
  tf.lastCatchTotal=total;tf.celebrateUntil=performance.now()+1600;
  tfStatus(`🎉 +$${total.toLocaleString()}! ${tf.caught.length} fish${newSpecies.length?' · NEW: '+newSpecies.join(', '):''}`);
  const banner=document.getElementById('tf-catch-banner');if(banner)banner.textContent=`🏆 +$${total.toLocaleString()}  ·  ${tf.caught.length} fish caught  ·  ${tf.streak>1?'🔥 '+tf.streak+'-fish combo!':'Cast again for more!'}`;
  tfBurst(400,155,'#ffe38a',42,1.4);tfSound('coin');tf.last=performance.now();
  requestAnimationFrame(tfCelebrateFrame);
 }else{
  tfStatus('🐟 The big one got away! Try sweeping across a fish next cast.');tfSound('miss');
  const banner=document.getElementById('tf-catch-banner');if(banner)banner.textContent='✨ Golden fish are worth 4×! Try another cast.';
 }
}

function tfRenderHaul(total,discovered){
 const out=document.getElementById('tf-last-haul');if(!out)return;
 if(!tf.haul.length){out.innerHTML='<span class="text-slate-400 text-sm">No fish caught yet. Cast into the ocean and steer the hook on its way up!</span>';return;}
 out.innerHTML='';
 const heading=document.createElement('div');heading.className='w-full flex items-center flex-wrap gap-2 text-sm text-sky-100';
 heading.innerHTML=`<strong class="text-lime-300">+$${total.toLocaleString()} caught!</strong><span class="text-slate-400">${tf.caught.length} fish landed</span>`;out.appendChild(heading);
 for(const [id,n] of tf.haul){const s=TF_SPECIES.find(v=>v.id===id);if(!s)continue;
  const item=document.createElement('div');item.className='tf-species-pill';
  const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=70;cv.height=42;cv.style.cssText='width:52px;height:32px;flex-shrink:0';item.appendChild(cv);
  let label=document.createElement('span');label.textContent=`${s.name} ×${n}${discovered.includes(s.name)?' ★ NEW':''}`;item.appendChild(label);out.appendChild(item);
  tfDrawSpeciesPreview(cv,s);
 }
}
function tfDrawSpeciesPreview(canvas,s){
 const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!ctx)return;ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(canvas.width*.49,canvas.height*.52);
 const sz=['ray','manta','oarfish','dragon','sword'].includes(s.shape)?12:17;
 ctx.scale(sz,sz);tfDrawSpecies(ctx,s,1);ctx.restore();
}
function tfRenderFishdex(){
 const out=document.getElementById('tf-fishdex');if(!out)return;out.innerHTML='';
 for(const s of TF_SPECIES){const discovered=tf.discovered.includes(s.id);
  const item=document.createElement('div');item.className='tf-fishdex-card'+(discovered?'':' tf-undiscovered');
  const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.width=124;cv.height=70;cv.style.cssText='width:100%;max-width:124px;height:70px;margin:0 auto 4px;display:block';item.appendChild(cv);
  const name=document.createElement('div');name.className='text-sm font-bold text-slate-100';name.textContent=discovered?s.name:'???';item.appendChild(name);
  const details=document.createElement('div');details.className='text-xs text-slate-400';details.textContent=discovered?`${TF_ZONES[s.zone].name} · $${s.value}`:`Unlock in ${TF_ZONES[s.zone].name}`;item.appendChild(details);
  out.appendChild(item);tfDrawSpeciesPreview(cv,s);
 }
 const el=document.getElementById('tf-species-total');if(el)el.textContent=String(TF_SPECIES.length);
}
function tfFrame(ms){
 if(!tf.active){tfDraw(ms);return;}
 const dt=Math.min(.045,Math.max(0,(ms-(tf.last||ms))/1000));tf.last=ms;
 if(tf.keys.ArrowLeft||tf.keys.KeyA)tf.pointerX-=560*dt;
 if(tf.keys.ArrowRight||tf.keys.KeyD)tf.pointerX+=560*dt;
 tf.pointerX=Math.min(765,Math.max(35,tf.pointerX));
 tf.hookX+=(tf.pointerX-tf.hookX)*Math.min(1,dt*(tf.phase==='up'?11:5));
 if(tf.phase==='down'){
  tf.hookY+=775*dt;
  if(tf.hookY>=tf.reach){tf.hookY=tf.reach;tf.phase='up';tfStatus('🎯 REELING! Chase fish, the glowing pearl, and treasure!');tfUI();}
 }else{
  tf.hookY-=Math.max(205,Math.min(440,210+tf.depth*17))*dt*(tf.magnet>0?.77:1);
  tf.magnet=Math.max(0,tf.magnet-dt);tf.fever=Math.max(0,tf.fever-dt);
  if(tf.hookY<95)tf.hookY=95;
  // Magnetic pearl gently attracts nearby fish, without catching automatically.
  if(tf.magnet>0){for(const f of tf.fish){if(f.caught)continue;
   const dx=tf.hookX-f.x,dy=tf.hookY-f.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
   if(d<165&&d>1){f.x+=dx/d*165*dt;f.y+=dy/d*95*dt;}
  }}
  for(const f of tf.fish){if(f.caught||tf.caught.length>=tf.capacity)continue;
   const dx=(f.x-tf.hookX)/(f.size*1.13+17),dy=(f.y-tf.hookY)/(f.size*.68+21);
   if(dx*dx+dy*dy<1)tfCatchFish(f);
  }
  if(tf.treasure&&!tf.treasure.caught&&Math.abs(tf.treasure.x-tf.hookX)<36&&Math.abs(tf.treasure.y-tf.hookY)<34)tfCatchTreasure();
  if(tf.pearl&&!tf.pearl.caught&&Math.abs(tf.pearl.x-tf.hookX)<31&&Math.abs(tf.pearl.y-tf.hookY)<30)tfCatchPearl();
  if(tf.hookY<=95){tfFinishCast();tfDraw(ms);return;}
 }
 const zoneLabel=document.getElementById('tf-zone-label');if(zoneLabel)zoneLabel.textContent=TF_ZONES[tfZone(tf.hookY)].name;
 const follow=tf.hookY-216;
 tf.cameraY+=(Math.max(0,Math.min(2900,follow))-tf.cameraY)*Math.min(1,dt*7);
 for(const f of tf.fish){if(f.caught)continue;
  f.x+=f.vx*dt;
  if(f.x>830+f.size*2)f.x=-30-f.size*2;
  if(f.x<-30-f.size*2)f.x=830+f.size*2;
 }
 if(tf.catchFlash>0)tf.catchFlash=Math.max(0,tf.catchFlash-dt);
 tfDraw(ms,dt);
 const prog=document.getElementById('tf-depth-progress');if(prog)prog.style.width=Math.min(100,Math.max(0,100*(tf.hookY-95)/(tf.reach-95)))+'%';
 tf.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tfFrame);
}

function initTinyFishing(){
 const cv=document.getElementById('tf-canvas');if(!cv)return;
 if(!tf.initDone){tfLoad();tf.initDone=true;
  function move(e){const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();tf.pointerX=Math.min(765,Math.max(35,(e.clientX-r.left)*(800/r.width)));}
  cv.addEventListener('pointermove',move);
  cv.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{move(e);cv.setPointerCapture?.(e.pointerId);});
  window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','KeyA','KeyD','Space'].includes(e.code) && !document.getElementById('view-tiny-fishing')?.classList.contains('hidden')){
   if(e.code==='Space'&&!tf.active)tinyFishingCast();else tf.keys[e.code]=true;e.preventDefault();
  }});
  window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','KeyA','KeyD'].includes(e.code))tf.keys[e.code]=false;});
  tf.reach=tfMaxDepth();tfResetFish();tfRenderFishdex();tfRenderHaul(0,[]);
 }
 tfUI();tfStatus('🎯 Tap CAST! Move your finger, mouse, or arrow keys to catch fish.');tfDraw(performance.now());
}

function tinyFishingCast(){
 if(tf.active)return;
 tf.reach=tfMaxDepth();tfResetFish();tf.caught=[];tf.haul=[];tf.active=true;tf.phase='down';tf.streak=0;tf.combo=1;tf.magnet=0;tf.fever=0;tf.bonuses=0;tf.luckyCaught=0;tf.treasureCaught=0;tf.pearlCaught=0;
 tf.hookX=400;tf.pointerX=400;tf.hookY=95;tf.cameraY=0;tf.last=0;tf.celebrateUntil=0;
 tfStatus('⬇️ Going down! Get ready to steer when the hook rises.');tfSound('cast');tfUI();
 cancelAnimationFrame(tf.raf);tf.raf=requestAnimationFrame(tfFrame);
}

function tinyFishingUpgrade(kind){
 if(tf.active){tfStatus('Finish your current catch before upgrading.');return;}
 if(!['depth','capacity','value'].includes(kind))return;
 if(kind==='depth'&&tf.depth>=14){tfStatus('Maximum depth unlocked! Explore the entire abyss.');return;}
 if(kind==='capacity'&&tf.capacity>=15){tfStatus('Your hook capacity is already maxed out.');return;}
 const price=tfPrice(kind);if(tf.cash<price){tfStatus(`You need $${(price-tf.cash).toLocaleString()} more for this upgrade.`);return;}
 tf.cash-=price;if(kind==='depth')tf.depth++;if(kind==='capacity')tf.capacity++;if(kind==='value')tf.value++;
 tf.reach=tfMaxDepth();tfResetFish();tfSave();tfUI();tfSound('upgrade');
 tfStatus(kind==='depth'?`🌊 LEVEL UP! Dive to ${tfMaxDepth()-95} m and spot new species!`:kind==='capacity'?`🪝 LEVEL UP! Catch ${tf.capacity} fish per cast!`:`💎 LEVEL UP! Every fish sells for ${tf.value}× value!`);
 tfPopup('LEVEL UP!',400,180,'#e9ff9a',26);tfBurst(400,190,'#baffda',28,1.35);tf.celebrateUntil=performance.now()+1000;tf.last=performance.now();requestAnimationFrame(tfCelebrateFrame);
}

function stopTinyFishing(){
 cancelAnimationFrame(tf.raf);tf.raf=0;tf.keys={};
 if(tf.active){tf.active=false;tf.phase='idle';tf.cameraY=0;tfStatus('Cast cancelled. Press CAST! to fish again.');tfUI();}
}
</script>
<script>
// Web Dashers Arcade Edition. A self-contained, original dash-runner mini-game.
// Only this game's code is modified. No external game files or online services are used.
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const W=900,H=430,FLOOR=340,PW=30,PH=30,SPD=288,GRAV=1980,JUMP=-810,WAVE_SPEED=300,SHIP_THRUST=1550,SHIP_GRAVITY=1320,SHIP_MAX_SPEED=380;
  const TYPES=new Set(['spike','double','block','coin','pad','riser','wave-in','ship-in','wave-out','gate']);
  const STORAGE='blooket_web_dashers_arcade_v1';
  let stored={levels:[],records:{}};
  try {const value=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE)||'{}');
    if(Array.isArray(value.levels)&&value.records&&typeof value.records==='object') stored=value;
  } catch(e) {}
  const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
  const canvas=()=>$('wd-canvas');
  const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,v));
  let current=null,mode='menu',active=false,paused=false,dead=false,won=false;
  let player,offset=0,attempts=0,collected=new Set(),entered=new Set(),last=0,raf=0;
  let time=0,pressed=false,touchHeld=false,heldKeys=new Set(),trail=[];
  let maxProgress=0,lastRewardMilestone=0,lastStoredPercent=0;
  let editor={name:'My Dash Level',objects:[],length:2800,id:null,camera:0,tool:'spike'};
  let soundContext;
  const down=()=>pressed||touchHeld;
  function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(STORAGE,JSON.stringify(stored));}catch(e){}}
  function sound(freq=500,duration=.07){
    if(typeof gameState!=='undefined' && gameState.soundEnabled===false)return;
    try{const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)return;
      soundContext=soundContext||new AC();let a=soundContext,o=a.createOscillator(),g=a.createGain();
      o.type='sine';o.frequency.value=freq;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.032,a.currentTime);
      g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,a.currentTime+duration);
      o.connect(g).connect(a.destination);o.start();o.stop(a.currentTime+duration);
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function notify(m){if(typeof showToast==='function')showToast(m);else $('wd-editor-status').textContent=m;}
  // First three official tracks use ship flight in place of wave mode.
  // The final three keep their brutal wave sections and rising platforms.
  function generateLevel(idx){
    const names=['Voltage Gauntlet','Gravity Breaker','Neon Vortex','Rising Inferno','Wave Nightmare','Impossible Circuit'];
    const themes=[['#14b8a6','#071d36'],['#2563eb','#130d36'],['#c026d3','#260d3e'],['#f97316','#311126'],['#22c55e','#0b2933'],['#ef4444','#2b123d']];
    const difficulties=['Hard','Insane','Extreme','Demon','Insane Demon','Extreme Demon'];
    let x=415;const objects=[];
    const put=(type,xx,extra={})=>objects.push({type,x:Math.round(xx),...extra});
    // Unforgiving but physically jumpable opening.
    for(let i=0;i<4+idx;i++){
      put(i%4===2?'block':(i%3===1?'double':'spike'),x);
      if(i%2===1)put('coin',x+110,{y:FLOOR-125});
      x+=i%3===1?274:245;
    }
    const makeWave=(section)=>{
      const start=x+205;put(idx<3?'ship-in':'wave-in',start);
      const count=6+idx*2+(section===1?2:0);
      const step=203-idx*3;
      for(let j=0;j<count;j++){
        // Gates are offset vertically.  The wave must be steered, not merely held.
        let cy=[167,250,144,257,164,242][(j+section)%6];
        const aperture=Math.max(78,119-idx*7-(section===1?6:0));
        put('gate',start+205+j*step,{y:cy,gap:aperture,swing:idx>=2?6+idx*2:3,phase:j*1.43+section});
        if(j%3===1)put('coin',start+205+j*step+90,{y:205});
      }
      const end=start+205+count*step;
      put('wave-out',end);x=end+150;
    };
    const makeRisers=()=>{
      const count=5+idx;
      // Each moving platform is surrounded by ground-level spikes.  Staying low
      // is dangerous; holding Space makes the cube jump repeatedly on landings.
      for(let j=0;j<count;j++){
        let rx=x+110+j*182;
        put('riser',rx,{w:103,height:76+(j%3)*19,rise:24+idx*3,phase:j*1.18,speed:1.9+idx*.12});
        put(j%3===2?'double':'spike',rx+55);
        if(j%2===0)put('coin',rx+65,{y:FLOOR-171});
      }
      x+=130+count*182;
    };
    makeWave(0);
    makeRisers();
    makeWave(1);
    // Final cube sprint before the finish, with more obstacles at higher levels.
    for(let j=0;j<4+idx;j++){
      x+=j%3===1?278:244;
      put(j%4===2?'block':(j%2?'double':'spike'),x);
      if(j%3===0)put('coin',x+108,{y:FLOOR-110});
    }
    const length=x+350;
    return {id:'official-'+idx,name:names[idx],difficulty:difficulties[idx],length,objects,color:themes[idx]};
  }
  const officials=Array.from({length:6},(_,i)=>generateLevel(i));
  const allLevels=()=>[...officials,...stored.levels];
  function hidePanels(){['wd-levels-menu','wd-play-panel','wd-editor-panel'].forEach(id=>$(id).classList.add('hidden'));}
  function stop(){active=false;last=0;heldKeys.clear();pressed=false;touchHeld=false;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=0;}
  function startLoop(){if(raf)cancelAnimationFrame(raf);last=0;raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);}
  function showMenu(){stop();mode='menu';current=null;hidePanels();$('wd-levels-menu').classList.remove('hidden');$('wd-pause').classList.add('hidden');renderLevels();}
  function launch(){mode='play';hidePanels();$('wd-play-panel').classList.remove('hidden');$('wd-pause').classList.remove('hidden');$('wd-overlay').classList.add('hidden');}
  function levelStart(id){
    if(typeof currentGameMode==='undefined'||currentGameMode!=='web-dashers')return;
    const lv=allLevels().find(l=>l.id===id);if(!lv)return;
    current=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(lv));attempts=0;lastRewardMilestone=Number(stored.records[lv.id]?.bestMilestone||0);
    launch();restart();
  }
  function restart(){if(!current)return;
    attempts++;
    // Track final-level attempts across retries, menu returns and page reloads.
    // This makes the 25-attempt bonus an actual challenge, not a resettable session counter.
    if(current.id==='official-5'){
      const rec=stored.records[current.id]||{};
      rec.totalAttempts=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(rec.totalAttempts)||0))+1;
      stored.records[current.id]=rec;save();
    }
    time=0;maxProgress=0;offset=0;trail=[];pressed=false;touchHeld=false;heldKeys.clear();
    player={x:60,y:FLOOR-PH,vy:0,ground:true,onPlatform:null,kind:'cube',rot:0};
    paused=false;dead=false;won=false;active=true;collected=new Set();entered=new Set();last=0;
    lastStoredPercent=Number(stored.records[current.id]?.bestPercent||0);
    $('wd-pause').textContent='⏸ Pause';$('wd-overlay').classList.add('hidden');
    $('wd-level-title').textContent=current.name+'  •  '+current.difficulty;
    $('wd-attempts').textContent=current.id==='official-5'
      ?'Final track attempt '+stored.records[current.id].totalAttempts+' / 25'
      :'Attempt '+attempts;
    $('wd-coins').textContent='★ 0';$('wd-progress-fill').style.width='0%';$('wd-progress-text').textContent='0% complete';
    $('wd-control-mode').textContent='CUBE MODE · Hold Space to chain jumps';
    canvas().focus({preventScroll:true});startLoop();
  }
  function pauseResume(){if(mode!=='play'||!current||dead||won)return;
    paused=!paused;$('wd-pause').textContent=paused?'▶ Resume':'⏸ Pause';
    if(paused)overlay('⏸','Paused','Resume when you are ready.','▶ Resume');
    else {$('wd-overlay').classList.add('hidden');last=0;canvas().focus({preventScroll:true});}
  }
  function overlay(icon,head,body,action){
    $('wd-overlay-icon').textContent=icon;$('wd-overlay-heading').textContent=head;
    $('wd-overlay-copy').textContent=body;$('wd-overlay-retry').textContent=action||'↻ Retry';
    $('wd-overlay-retry').onclick=paused&&!dead&&!won?pauseResume:restart;
    $('wd-overlay').classList.remove('hidden');
  }
  function jump(){
    if(mode!=='play'||!current||!active||paused||dead||won||player.kind!=='cube')return;
    if(player.ground){player.vy=JUMP;player.ground=false;player.onPlatform=null;sound(745,.075);}
  }
  function hurt(reason){if(dead)return;dead=true;active=false;pressed=false;touchHeld=false;sound(155,.18);
    overlay('💥','Crash!',(reason||'That obstacle was brutal.')+' You reached '+maxProgress+'%. Try again!','↻ Retry');
  }
  function reward(n){
    if(Number.isFinite(n)&&n>0&&typeof transferGamePoints==='function' &&
       typeof currentGameMode!=='undefined'&&currentGameMode==='web-dashers')transferGamePoints(n);
  }
  function clearLevel(){
    if(won)return;
    won=true;active=false;
    const rec=stored.records[current.id]||{};
    const isOfficial=/^official-[0-5]$/.test(current.id);
    let message='You survived '+current.name+'!';
    let earned=0;
    // Full built-in track clears always pay 1,500, including replay victories.
    // Player-made levels are practice only and cannot mint free completion tokens.
    if(isOfficial){earned+=1500;message+=' +1,500 tokens to your main balance.';}
    // Pay this large prize only once and only if the final official track is
    // completed within 25 total attempts (persisted independently of retries).
    const attemptsUsed=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(rec.totalAttempts)||0));
    if(current.id==='official-5' && attemptsUsed>=1 && attemptsUsed<=25 && !rec.millionBonusClaimed){
      rec.millionBonusClaimed=true;
      earned+=1000000;
      message+=' MEGA BONUS: +1,000,000 tokens for finishing in '+attemptsUsed+' attempts!';
    } else if(current.id==='official-5' && !rec.millionBonusClaimed && attemptsUsed>25){
      message+=' The 1,000,000-token challenge required 25 attempts or fewer.';
    }
    rec.completed=true;
    rec.bestPercent=100;
    stored.records[current.id]=rec;
    if(earned)reward(earned); // Existing transfer function saves and updates the main balance.
    save();sound(1160,.28);
    overlay('🏆','Level Complete!',message,'↻ Replay');
  }
  const overlap=(a1,a2,b1,b2)=>a1<b2&&a2>b1;
  function platformTop(o){return FLOOR-(o.height||82)-(o.rise||26)*(0.5+0.5*Math.sin(time*(o.speed||2)+(o.phase||0)));}
  function gateCenter(o){return (o.y||200)+(o.swing||0)*Math.sin(time*1.6+(o.phase||0));}
  function enterFlight(kind){
    player.kind=kind;
    player.ground=false;player.onPlatform=null;player.vy=0;
    player.y=clamp(player.y,90,FLOOR-155);trail=[];sound(1020,.17);
    $('wd-control-mode').textContent=kind==='ship'
      ?'SHIP MODE · HOLD Space to thrust UP · RELEASE to descend'
      :'WAVE MODE · HOLD Space to rise · RELEASE to dive';
  }
  function leaveFlight(){player.kind='cube';player.ground=true;player.onPlatform=null;
    player.y=FLOOR-PH;player.vy=0;trail=[];sound(520,.15);
    $('wd-control-mode').textContent='CUBE MODE · HOLD Space to bounce across rising blocks';
  }
  function hazardHit(o){
    if(player.kind!=='cube')return false;
    const x=player.x,y=player.y;
    if(o.type==='spike'||o.type==='double'){
      const width=o.type==='double'?62:33;
      return overlap(x+6,x+PW-6,o.x+6,o.x+width-4)&&y+PH>FLOOR-30&&y<FLOOR-3;
    }
    if(o.type==='block')return overlap(x+4,x+PW-5,o.x+3,o.x+39)&&overlap(y+3,y+PH-3,FLOOR-48,FLOOR);
    return false;
  }
  function update(dt){
    if(!current)return;
    const oldX=player.x,oldBottom=player.y+PH;
    time+=dt;
    player.x+=SPD*dt;
    // Portal transitions are processed before physics to avoid passing through one.
    for(const [i,o] of current.objects.entries()){
      if(entered.has(i)||!['wave-in','ship-in','wave-out'].includes(o.type))continue;
      if(oldX+PW<o.x&&player.x+PW<o.x)continue;
      if(oldX>o.x+34||player.x>o.x+34)continue;
      if(overlap(player.x,player.x+PW,o.x,o.x+32)){
        entered.add(i);
        if(o.type==='wave-in'&&player.kind==='cube')enterFlight('wave');
        if(o.type==='ship-in'&&player.kind==='cube')enterFlight('ship');
        if(o.type==='wave-out'&&['wave','ship'].includes(player.kind))leaveFlight();
      }
    }
    if(player.kind==='wave'||player.kind==='ship'){
      if(player.kind==='ship'){
        // Ship has momentum: feather Space for precise thrust through moving gates.
        player.vy=clamp(player.vy+(down()?-SHIP_THRUST:SHIP_GRAVITY)*dt,-SHIP_MAX_SPEED,SHIP_MAX_SPEED);
        player.y+=player.vy*dt;
        player.rot=clamp(player.vy/SHIP_MAX_SPEED,-1,1)*0.48;
      }else{
        player.y+=(down()?-WAVE_SPEED:WAVE_SPEED)*dt;
        player.rot=down()?-Math.PI/4:Math.PI/4;
      }
      if(player.y<39||player.y+PH>FLOOR-6){hurt('You hit the edge of the flight tunnel.');return;}
      trail.push({x:player.x+PW/2,y:player.y+PH/2});if(trail.length>30)trail.shift();
    }else{
      // Ride rising platforms if standing on one; allow Space to auto-hop on landing.
      if(player.ground&&player.onPlatform!==null){
        const o=current.objects[player.onPlatform];
        if(o&&o.type==='riser'&&overlap(player.x+4,player.x+PW-4,o.x,o.x+(o.w||103))) {
          player.y=platformTop(o)-PH;
        }else{player.ground=false;player.onPlatform=null;}
      }
      if(down()&&player.ground)jump();
      if(!player.ground){
        player.vy+=GRAV*dt;
        const projected=player.y+player.vy*dt;
        let landed=null,landY=FLOOR;
        if(player.vy>=0){
          for(const [i,o] of current.objects.entries()){
            if(o.type!=='riser'||!overlap(player.x+4,player.x+PW-4,o.x,o.x+(o.w||103)))continue;
            const top=platformTop(o);
            if(oldBottom<=top+10&&projected+PH>=top&&top<landY){landed=i;landY=top;}
          }
        }
        if(projected+PH>=landY){
          player.y=landY-PH;player.ground=true;player.onPlatform=landed;player.vy=0;
          player.rot=Math.round(player.rot/(Math.PI/2))*(Math.PI/2);
          if(down())jump();
        }else{player.y=projected;player.rot+=7*dt;}
      }
    }
    offset=Math.max(0,player.x-180);
    for(const [i,o] of current.objects.entries()){
      if(o.x<player.x-150||o.x>player.x+80)continue;
      if(hazardHit(o)){hurt('Watch the spikes and blocks.');return;}
      if(o.type==='riser'&&player.kind==='cube'){
        const top=platformTop(o),right=o.x+(o.w||103);
        if(overlap(player.x+5,player.x+PW-5,o.x+2,right-2)&&
           overlap(player.y+2,player.y+PH-2,top+5,FLOOR-3)&&player.onPlatform!==i){
          hurt('A rising platform hit you from the side.');return;
        }
      }
      if(o.type==='gate'&&(player.kind==='wave'||player.kind==='ship')){
        const gap=o.gap||108,cy=gateCenter(o);
        if(overlap(player.x+4,player.x+PW-4,o.x,o.x+(o.w||50))&&
           (player.y+4<cy-gap/2||player.y+PH-4>cy+gap/2)){
          hurt('Fly through the glowing gap, not the wall.');return;
        }
      }
      if(o.type==='coin'&&!collected.has(i)&&Math.hypot(player.x+PW/2-o.x,player.y+PH/2-(o.y||FLOOR-88))<32){
        collected.add(i);$('wd-coins').textContent='★ '+collected.size;reward(25);sound(980,.095);
      }
      if(o.type==='pad'&&player.kind==='cube'&&player.ground&&
         overlap(player.x,player.x+PW,o.x,o.x+52)){
         player.vy=-940;player.ground=false;player.onPlatform=null;sound(680,.11);
      }
    }
    const pct=clamp(Math.floor(100*player.x/current.length),0,100);
    maxProgress=Math.max(maxProgress,pct);
    $('wd-progress-fill').style.width=pct+'%';$('wd-progress-text').textContent=pct+'% complete';
    const record=stored.records[current.id]||{};
    if(pct>lastStoredPercent){record.bestPercent=pct;stored.records[current.id]=record;lastStoredPercent=pct;save();}
    const milestone=Math.floor(pct/10);
    if(milestone>lastRewardMilestone&&milestone<=9){const gained=milestone-lastRewardMilestone;
      lastRewardMilestone=milestone;record.bestMilestone=milestone;stored.records[current.id]=record;save();reward(40*gained);
    }
    if(player.x>=current.length)clearLevel();
  }
  function roundedRect(c,x,y,w,h,r){c.beginPath();c.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);}
  function spikes(c,x,y,count){for(let a=0;a<count;a++){
    const left=x+a*30;c.fillStyle='#fb466e';c.strokeStyle='#ffb3c6';c.lineWidth=2;
    c.beginPath();c.moveTo(left,y);c.lineTo(left+16,y-33);c.lineTo(left+32,y);c.closePath();c.fill();c.stroke();
  }}
  function paint(c,lv,camera,w,h,isEditor){
    c.save();c.scale(w/W,h/H);
    const backdrop=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,H);
    backdrop.addColorStop(0,lv?.color?.[1]||'#111a3e');backdrop.addColorStop(1,'#0b3859');
    c.fillStyle=backdrop;c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
    c.strokeStyle='rgba(166,239,255,.11)';c.lineWidth=1;
    for(let x=Math.floor(camera/52)*52;x<=camera+W+52;x+=52){const sx=Math.round(x-camera);c.beginPath();c.moveTo(sx,0);c.lineTo(sx,H);c.stroke();}
    for(let y=28;y<FLOOR;y+=52){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(0,y);c.lineTo(W,y);c.stroke();}
    c.fillStyle='#091529';c.fillRect(0,FLOOR,W,H-FLOOR);
    c.fillStyle='#a3e635';c.fillRect(0,FLOOR-4,W,4);
    if(lv){
      const fin=lv.length-camera;
      if(fin>-20&&fin<W+40){c.fillStyle='rgba(163,230,53,.2)';c.fillRect(fin,FLOOR-230,24,230);
        c.fillStyle='#d9f99d';c.fillRect(fin,FLOOR-230,6,230);c.font='bold 15px sans-serif';c.fillText('FINISH',fin-10,FLOOR-243);}
      for(const [i,o] of lv.objects.entries()){
        const x=o.x-camera;if(x<-130||x>W+100)continue;
        if(o.type==='spike')spikes(c,x,FLOOR,1);
        if(o.type==='double')spikes(c,x,FLOOR,2);
        if(o.type==='block'){
          c.fillStyle='#7c3aed';c.strokeStyle='#ddd6fe';c.lineWidth=3;
          roundedRect(c,x,FLOOR-48,42,48,4);c.fill();c.stroke();
          c.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.3)';c.strokeRect(x+10,FLOOR-40,23,28);
        }
        if(o.type==='riser'){
          const top=platformTop(o),width=o.w||103;
          c.fillStyle='rgba(34,211,238,.15)';c.fillRect(x+10,top+8,width-20,FLOOR-top-8);
          c.setLineDash([6,7]);c.strokeStyle='rgba(147,197,253,.35)';c.strokeRect(x+14,FLOOR-(o.height||82)-(o.rise||26),width-28,(o.rise||26)+22);c.setLineDash([]);
          const bar=c.createLinearGradient(x,top,x,top+27);bar.addColorStop(0,'#67e8f9');bar.addColorStop(1,'#0369a1');
          c.fillStyle=bar;c.strokeStyle='#cffafe';c.lineWidth=3;
          roundedRect(c,x,top,width,24,6);c.fill();c.stroke();
          c.fillStyle='#082f49';c.font='bold 18px sans-serif';c.fillText('↑',x+width/2-7,top+18);
        }
        if(o.type==='coin'&&(isEditor||!collected.has(i))){
          const y=o.y??FLOOR-88;c.fillStyle='#fde047';c.strokeStyle='#fff7ad';c.lineWidth=3;
          c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,15,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.stroke();
          c.font='bold 18px sans-serif';c.fillStyle='#854d0e';c.fillText('★',x-9,y+6);
        }
        if(o.type==='pad'){
          c.fillStyle='#06b6d4';c.strokeStyle='#a5f3fc';c.lineWidth=2;
          roundedRect(c,x,FLOOR-13,48,13,5);c.fill();c.stroke();
          c.fillStyle='#e0f2fe';c.font='bold 13px sans-serif';c.fillText('↑',x+18,FLOOR-16);
        }
        if(['wave-in','ship-in','wave-out'].includes(o.type)){
          const into=o.type!=='wave-out',isShip=o.type==='ship-in';
          const portalColor=isShip?'#fbbf24':into?'#f472b6':'#bef264';
          c.save();c.shadowColor=portalColor;c.shadowBlur=18;
          c.strokeStyle=portalColor;c.lineWidth=5;
          c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x+17,FLOOR-140,22,135,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();c.restore();
          c.fillStyle=portalColor;c.font='bold 13px sans-serif';
          c.fillText(isShip?'SHIP':into?'WAVE':'CUBE',x-7,FLOOR-291);
        }
        if(o.type==='gate'){
          const cy=gateCenter(o),gap=o.gap||108,ww=o.w||50,a=Math.max(38,cy-gap/2),b=Math.min(FLOOR,cy+gap/2);
          const fill=c.createLinearGradient(x,0,x+ww,0);
          fill.addColorStop(0,'#7c3aed');fill.addColorStop(.5,'#e879f9');fill.addColorStop(1,'#7c3aed');
          c.fillStyle=fill;c.strokeStyle='#f5d0fe';c.lineWidth=2;
          c.fillRect(x,38,ww,Math.max(0,a-38));c.strokeRect(x,38,ww,Math.max(0,a-38));
          c.fillRect(x,b,ww,Math.max(0,FLOOR-b));c.strokeRect(x,b,ww,Math.max(0,FLOOR-b));
          c.fillStyle='#a5f3fc';c.fillRect(x,a-3,ww,3);c.fillRect(x,b,ww,3);
        }
      }
    }
    if(!isEditor&&mode==='play'&&player){
      if(player.kind==='wave'||player.kind==='ship'){
        if(trail.length>1){c.beginPath();trail.forEach((p,i)=>{if(i)c.lineTo(p.x-camera,p.y);else c.moveTo(p.x-camera,p.y);});
          c.strokeStyle=player.kind==='ship'?'#fbbf24':'#67e8f9';c.lineWidth=5;
          c.shadowBlur=12;c.shadowColor=player.kind==='ship'?'#f97316':'#22d3ee';c.stroke();c.shadowBlur=0;}
        const px=player.x-camera,py=player.y;
        if(player.kind==='ship'){
          // Visible spacecraft, angled by vertical velocity (unlike sharp wave triangle).
          c.save();c.translate(px+PW/2,py+PH/2);c.rotate(player.rot);
          c.fillStyle='#fbbf24';c.strokeStyle='#fff7ed';c.lineWidth=2.5;
          c.shadowColor='#f97316';c.shadowBlur=14;
          c.beginPath();c.moveTo(16,0);c.lineTo(-12,-12);c.lineTo(-7,0);c.lineTo(-12,12);c.closePath();c.fill();c.stroke();
          c.shadowBlur=0;c.fillStyle='#38bdf8';c.beginPath();c.arc(2,0,5,0,2*Math.PI);c.fill();
          if(down()){
            c.fillStyle='#fb923c';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-11,-6);c.lineTo(-27,0);c.lineTo(-11,6);c.fill();
          }
          c.restore();
        }else{
          c.fillStyle='#a5f3fc';c.strokeStyle='#f8fafc';c.lineWidth=3;c.shadowColor='#67e8f9';c.shadowBlur=16;
          c.beginPath();c.moveTo(px,py+PH/2);c.lineTo(px+PW,py+3);c.lineTo(px+PW-3,py+PH-3);c.closePath();c.fill();c.stroke();c.shadowBlur=0;
        }
      }else{
        c.save();c.translate(player.x-camera+PW/2,player.y+PH/2);c.rotate(player.rot);
        c.shadowColor='#a3e635';c.shadowBlur=23;c.fillStyle='#a3e635';c.strokeStyle='#f8fafc';c.lineWidth=3;
        roundedRect(c,-PW/2,-PH/2,PW,PH,5);c.fill();c.stroke();c.shadowBlur=0;
        c.fillStyle='#182138';c.fillRect(-8,-5,6,6);c.fillRect(4,-5,6,6);c.restore();
      }
    }
    c.restore();
  }
  function frame(t){
    if(mode!=='play'){raf=0;return;}
    const c=canvas().getContext('2d');const dt=last?clamp((t-last)/1000,0,.045):0;last=t;
    if(active&&!paused&&!document.hidden&&typeof currentGameMode!=='undefined'&&currentGameMode==='web-dashers'){
      const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(dt/.009));for(let i=0;i<steps;i++){update(dt/steps);if(!active)break;}
    }
    paint(c,current,offset,W,H,false);raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }
  function renderLevels(){
    const q=($('wd-search')?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase(),grid=$('wd-level-grid');grid.replaceChildren();
    for(const lv of allLevels().filter(l=>l.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))){
      const rec=stored.records[lv.id]||{},div=document.createElement('div');
      div.className='p-4 border border-slate-700 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/70 flex flex-col gap-3';
      const heading=document.createElement('div');heading.className='flex items-center gap-3';
      const ico=document.createElement('div');ico.className='text-3xl';ico.textContent=lv.id.startsWith('official-')?'⚡':'🛠';
      const words=document.createElement('div'),nm=document.createElement('h4'),label=document.createElement('p');
      nm.className='font-fredoka font-bold text-lg text-lime-200';nm.textContent=lv.name;
      label.className='text-slate-400 text-xs';
      const flight=lv.id.startsWith('official-')?(Number(lv.id.slice(9))<3?'Ship + Rising Platforms':'Wave + Rising Platforms'):'Custom';
      const finalAttempts=lv.id==='official-5'?' • Final attempts '+(Number(rec.totalAttempts)||0)+'/25'+(rec.millionBonusClaimed?' • 1M claimed ✓':''):'';
      label.textContent=(lv.difficulty||'Custom')+' • '+flight+' • Best '+(rec.bestPercent||0)+'%'+(rec.completed?' • Complete ✓':'')+finalAttempts;
      if(lv.id.startsWith('official-')){
        const rewardLabel=document.createElement('p');rewardLabel.className='text-amber-300 text-xs font-bold';
        rewardLabel.textContent=lv.id==='official-5'?'+1,500 per finish • +1,000,000 once if cleared in 25 attempts':'+1,500 tokens per completed track';
        words.append(rewardLabel);
      }
      words.append(nm,label);heading.append(ico,words);div.append(heading);
      const actions=document.createElement('div');actions.className='flex gap-2';
      const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='flex-1 px-3 py-2 bg-lime-500 hover:bg-lime-400 rounded-xl text-slate-950 font-bold';b.textContent='▶ Play';b.onclick=()=>levelStart(lv.id);actions.append(b);
      if(!lv.id.startsWith('official-')){
        const e=document.createElement('button');e.textContent='Edit';e.className='px-3 py-2 bg-slate-700 rounded-xl text-white';e.onclick=()=>openEditor(lv.id);actions.append(e);
        const d=document.createElement('button');d.textContent='✕';d.title='Delete level';d.className='px-3 py-2 bg-rose-900/70 rounded-xl text-white';
        d.onclick=()=>{if(confirm('Delete '+lv.name+'?')){stored.levels=stored.levels.filter(a=>a.id!==lv.id);save();renderLevels();}};
        actions.append(d);
      }
      div.append(actions);grid.append(div);
    }
    if(!grid.children.length){const p=document.createElement('p');p.className='text-slate-400';p.textContent='No matching levels. Try another search.';grid.append(p);}
  }
  function openEditor(id){stop();mode='editor';hidePanels();$('wd-editor-panel').classList.remove('hidden');$('wd-pause').classList.add('hidden');
    const lv=stored.levels.find(l=>l.id===id);
    editor={id:lv?.id||null,name:lv?.name||'My Dash Level',objects:lv?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(lv.objects)):[],length:lv?.length||2800,camera:0,tool:'spike'};
    $('wd-editor-name').value=editor.name;tool('spike');drawEditor();
  }
  function editorNew(){openEditor(null);}
  function tool(k){editor.tool=k;document.querySelectorAll('.wd-tool').forEach(b=>{const selected=b.dataset.tool===k;
    b.classList.toggle('bg-lime-600',selected);b.classList.toggle('text-slate-950',selected);b.classList.toggle('bg-slate-700',!selected);});}
  function drawEditor(){if(mode!=='editor')return;
    paint($('wd-editor-canvas').getContext('2d'),{objects:editor.objects,length:editor.length,color:['#84cc16','#10213d']},editor.camera,900,350,true);
    $('wd-editor-position').textContent=`Track ${Math.floor(editor.camera/680)+1} / ${Math.ceil(editor.length/680)}`;
  }
  function moveEditor(n){editor.camera=clamp(editor.camera+n*680,0,Math.max(0,editor.length-850));drawEditor();}
  function editorClick(event){if(mode!=='editor')return;
    const r=$('wd-editor-canvas').getBoundingClientRect();
    const worldX=clamp(Math.round((editor.camera+(event.clientX-r.left)/r.width*W)/50)*50,300,editor.length-80);
    const yy=clamp((event.clientY-r.top)/r.height*H,110,270);
    editor.objects=editor.objects.filter(o=>Math.abs(o.x-worldX)>30);
    if(editor.tool!=='erase'){
      const obj={type:editor.tool,x:worldX};
      if(editor.tool==='coin')obj.y=Math.round(yy);
      if(editor.tool==='gate'){obj.y=Math.round(yy);obj.gap=104;obj.swing=10;}
      if(editor.tool==='riser'){obj.height=85;obj.rise=38;obj.w=103;obj.speed=2;obj.phase=0;}
      editor.objects.push(obj);
    }
    $('wd-editor-status').textContent=(editor.tool==='erase'?'Removed':'Placed '+editor.tool)+' at '+worldX+'px';drawEditor();
  }
  function cleanObject(o){
    const x=Number(o.x),type=o.type;
    if(!TYPES.has(type)||!Number.isFinite(x))return null;
    const item={type,x:Math.round(x)};
    if(type==='coin')item.y=clamp(Number(o.y)||FLOOR-88,30,FLOOR-15);
    if(type==='gate'){
      item.y=clamp(Number(o.y)||200,95,280);item.gap=clamp(Number(o.gap)||104,72,160);
      item.swing=clamp(Number(o.swing)||0,0,25);item.phase=clamp(Number(o.phase)||0,-30,30);
    }
    if(type==='riser'){
      item.w=clamp(Number(o.w)||103,55,160);item.height=clamp(Number(o.height)||85,55,150);
      item.rise=clamp(Number(o.rise)||38,0,80);item.speed=clamp(Number(o.speed)||2,.5,4);
      item.phase=clamp(Number(o.phase)||0,-30,30);
    }
    return item;
  }
  function editorSave(){const name=$('wd-editor-name').value.trim()||'My Dash Level';
    const lv={id:editor.id||'custom-'+Date.now(),name:name.slice(0,36),difficulty:'Custom',length:editor.length,
      objects:editor.objects.map(cleanObject).filter(o=>o&&o.x>=300&&o.x<editor.length-80).slice(0,400),color:['#a3e635','#172554']};
    stored.levels=stored.levels.filter(l=>l.id!==lv.id);stored.levels.push(lv);stored.levels=stored.levels.slice(-80);
    editor.id=lv.id;editor.name=lv.name;save();$('wd-editor-status').textContent='Saved locally: '+name;return lv.id;
  }
  function editorPlay(){const id=editorSave();levelStart(id);}
  function exportLevel(){editorSave();const lv=stored.levels.find(l=>l.id===editor.id);
    $('wd-level-code').value=JSON.stringify({name:lv.name,length:lv.length,objects:lv.objects});
    $('wd-editor-status').textContent='Code ready to copy.';
  }
  function importLevel(){try{
    const data=JSON.parse($('wd-level-code').value);if(!data||!Array.isArray(data.objects))throw Error('Missing objects');
    const length=clamp(Number(data.length)||2800,1000,12000);
    const objects=data.objects.map(cleanObject).filter(o=>o&&o.x>=300&&o.x<=length-80).slice(0,400);
    editor={id:null,name:String(data.name||'Imported Level').slice(0,36),objects,length,camera:0,tool:'spike'};
    $('wd-editor-name').value=editor.name;tool('spike');drawEditor();
    $('wd-editor-status').textContent='Level imported. Click Save to keep it.';
  }catch(e){$('wd-editor-status').textContent='Invalid level code. Use exported JSON.';}}
  function copyLevel(){if(!$('wd-level-code').value)exportLevel();const el=$('wd-level-code');el.select();
    try{navigator.clipboard?.writeText(el.value);}catch(e){}
    $('wd-editor-status').textContent='Selected level code. Press Ctrl+C if copy is unavailable.';
  }
  function keydown(e){
    if(mode!=='play'||typeof currentGameMode==='undefined'||currentGameMode!=='web-dashers')return;
    if(['Space','ArrowUp'].includes(e.code)){
      e.preventDefault();heldKeys.add(e.code);pressed=heldKeys.size>0;
      if(!e.repeat)jump();
    }
    if(e.code==='KeyP'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)pauseResume();}
    if(e.code==='KeyR'){e.preventDefault();if(!e.repeat)restart();}
  }
  function keyup(e){if(!['Space','ArrowUp'].includes(e.code))return;
    heldKeys.delete(e.code);pressed=heldKeys.size>0;
    if(mode==='play'&&typeof currentGameMode!=='undefined'&&currentGameMode==='web-dashers')e.preventDefault();
  }
  function releaseTouch(){touchHeld=false;}
  function init(){if(canvas().dataset.wdBound)return;canvas().dataset.wdBound='1';
    const c=canvas();
    c.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(mode==='play'&&!paused){e.preventDefault();touchHeld=true;try{c.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);}catch(err){}jump();}});
    c.addEventListener('pointerup',releaseTouch);c.addEventListener('pointercancel',releaseTouch);c.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',releaseTouch);
    $('wd-editor-canvas').addEventListener('pointerdown',editorClick);
    document.addEventListener('keydown',keydown);document.addEventListener('keyup',keyup);
    window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{pressed=false;touchHeld=false;heldKeys.clear();});
  }
  function open(){init();showMenu();}
  window.wdOpen=open;window.wdStop=()=>{stop();mode='menu';};window.wdShowMenu=showMenu;
  window.wdRenderLevels=renderLevels;window.wdRestart=restart;window.wdPauseResume=pauseResume;
  window.wdOpenEditor=()=>openEditor(null);window.wdEditorNew=editorNew;
  window.wdEditorSave=editorSave;window.wdEditorPlay=editorPlay;window.wdTool=tool;
  window.wdMoveEditor=moveEditor;window.wdExportLevel=exportLevel;
  window.wdImportLevel=importLevel;window.wdCopyLevel=copyLevel;
  // Limited test hooks for sanity checks in a local browser; they do not affect gameplay.
  window.wdModeInfo=()=>({level:current?.name,mode:player?.kind,active,dead,attempts,progress:maxProgress,
    finalAttempts:stored.records['official-5']?.totalAttempts||0,
    millionBonusClaimed:!!stored.records['official-5']?.millionBonusClaimed});
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
